```python
"""Runtime configuration.

Every secret and integration setting comes from environment variables (or a local `.env`
file next to run.py). Nothing secret is hard-coded. See `.env.example` for the full list.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent          # aurelia/
APP_DIR = ROOT / "app"
STATIC_DIR = ROOT / "static"


def _load_dotenv(path: Path) -> None:
    """Minimal .env reader: KEY=value lines, # comments, optional quotes. Real env wins."""
    if not path.is_file():
        return
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()
        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "\"'":
            value = value[1:-1]
        os.environ.setdefault(key, value)


_load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")


def env(key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    """A setting from the environment. Empty or blank counts as not set, so the default applies
    (hosts often keep a variable that was pasted without a value)."""
    v = os.environ.get(key)
    return default if v is None or not v.strip() else v


def env_bool(key: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    v = os.environ.get(key)
    if v is None or not v.strip():
        return default
    return v.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def env_int(key: str, default: int) -> int:
    v = os.environ.get(key)
    if v is None or not v.strip():
        return default
    try:
        return int(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


DATA_DIR = Path(env("AURELIA_DATA_DIR", str(ROOT / "data"))).resolve()
DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
UPLOAD_DIR = DATA_DIR / "uploads"
OUTBOX_DIR = DATA_DIR / "outbox"
REPORT_DIR = DATA_DIR / "reports"
for _d in (UPLOAD_DIR, OUTBOX_DIR, REPORT_DIR):
    _d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def _secret_key() -> str:
    """SECRET_KEY from env; otherwise a random key, created once and kept in the data folder (on Railway,
    the /data volume), so sign-ins survive restarts and updates."""
    key = env("SECRET_KEY")
    if key:
        return key
    f = DATA_DIR / ".secret_key"
    if f.is_file():
        return f.read_text().strip()
    key = secrets.token_hex(32)
    f.write_text(key)
    try:
        f.chmod(0o600)
    except OSError:
        pass
    return key


# --- Brand ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BRAND_NAME = env("BRAND_NAME", "Aurelia Studios")
BRAND_TAGLINE = env("BRAND_TAGLINE", "Affordable luxury. Everything for your event in one place.")
BRAND_LINE = "One event. One platform. One link. Everything organised."
SUPPORT_EMAIL = env("SUPPORT_EMAIL", "invitesaurelia@gmail.com")
COMPANY_ADDRESS = env("COMPANY_ADDRESS", "Johannesburg, South Africa")  # [TBC]
INFORMATION_OFFICER = env("INFORMATION_OFFICER_EMAIL", SUPPORT_EMAIL)   # POPIA contact
# Support on WhatsApp: set a number (e.g. 082 123 4567) to show a chat button on every page. Empty hides it.
WHATSAPP_NUMBER = env("WHATSAPP_NUMBER", "")
# Footer social links: full web addresses. Each one shows only when it is set.
SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM = env("SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM", "")
SOCIAL_FACEBOOK = env("SOCIAL_FACEBOOK", "")
SOCIAL_TIKTOK = env("SOCIAL_TIKTOK", "")


def whatsapp_link(text: str = "") -> str:
    """wa.me link to the support number (South African 0XX numbers become 27XX), or "" when none is set."""
    import re
    from urllib.parse import quote
    d = re.sub(r"\D", "", WHATSAPP_NUMBER)
    if d.startswith("0") and len(d) == 10:
        d = "27" + d[1:]
    if not d:
        return ""
    return f"https://wa.me/{d}" + (f"?text={quote(text)}" if text else "")
CURRENCY = "ZAR"
TIMEZONE = env("TIMEZONE", "Africa/Johannesburg")

# --- Server -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# On Railway the web address and the proxy in front of the app are known, so they need no settings:
# BASE_URL falls back to the domain Railway generated (set BASE_URL once your own domain is connected).
ON_RAILWAY = any(env(k) for k in ("RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME", "RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT", "RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID"))
APP_ENV = env("APP_ENV", "production" if ON_RAILWAY else "development")   # development | production
DEBUG = APP_ENV != "production"
_RAILWAY_URL = f"https://{env('RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN')}" if env("RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN") else ""
BASE_URL = env("BASE_URL", _RAILWAY_URL or "http://127.0.0.1:8040").rstrip("/")
# The site's own domain (e.g. aureliastudios.co.za), once BASE_URL is set to it. Visitors who arrive on
# www. or on Railway's generated address are then sent there (page views only; see app._canonical_redirect).
_BASE_HOST = (BASE_URL.split("://", 1)[-1].split("/", 1)[0].split(":", 1)[0]).lower()
CANONICAL_HOST = (_BASE_HOST if env("BASE_URL") and BASE_URL.startswith("https://")
                  and not _BASE_HOST.endswith(".up.railway.app") and env_bool("CANONICAL_REDIRECT", True) else "")
SECRET_KEY = _secret_key()
DATABASE_PATH = Path(env("DATABASE_PATH", str(DATA_DIR / "aurelia.sqlite3")))
SESSION_DAYS = env_int("SESSION_DAYS", 14)
MAX_BODY_BYTES = env_int("MAX_BODY_BYTES", 25 * 1024 * 1024)
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = env_int("MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES", 6 * 1024 * 1024)
SECURE_COOKIES = env_bool("SECURE_COOKIES", BASE_URL.startswith("https://"))
# Only trust X-Forwarded-For when a reverse proxy you control (Caddy, Nginx, the host's router) sets it.
# Railway always runs one in front of the app. The address that proxy adds (the last one) is used.
TRUST_PROXY = env_bool("TRUST_PROXY", ON_RAILWAY)

# --- Email ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EMAIL_PROVIDER: "outbox" (development: writes HTML files to data/outbox, nothing is sent),
# "resend" (needs RESEND_API_KEY) or "smtp" (needs SMTP_HOST etc.)
EMAIL_PROVIDER = env("EMAIL_PROVIDER", "outbox")
EMAIL_FROM = env("EMAIL_FROM", f"{BRAND_NAME} <no-reply@aurelia.example>")
EMAIL_REPLY_TO = env("EMAIL_REPLY_TO", SUPPORT_EMAIL)
RESEND_API_KEY = env("RESEND_API_KEY")
SMTP_HOST = env("SMTP_HOST")
SMTP_PORT = env_int("SMTP_PORT", 587)
SMTP_USER = env("SMTP_USER")
SMTP_PASSWORD = env("SMTP_PASSWORD")
SMTP_STARTTLS = env_bool("SMTP_STARTTLS", True)

# --- Payments ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PAYMENT_GATEWAY: "sandbox" (built-in test checkout, no money moves) or "payfast"
PAYMENT_GATEWAY = env("PAYMENT_GATEWAY", "sandbox")
PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID = env("PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID")
PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY = env("PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY")
PAYFAST_PASSPHRASE = env("PAYFAST_PASSPHRASE")
PAYFAST_SANDBOX = env_bool("PAYFAST_SANDBOX", True)
# The built-in test checkout publishes events without real payment, so production refuses it
# unless this is set (use only on a private staging/demo copy).
ALLOW_SANDBOX_PAYMENTS = env_bool("ALLOW_SANDBOX_PAYMENTS", DEBUG)
VAT_RATE = float(env("VAT_RATE", "0.15"))
VAT_NUMBER = env("VAT_NUMBER", "")                 # [TBC] shown on receipts when set
# Only a VAT-registered business may charge VAT or issue tax invoices (SARS). Until VAT_NUMBER is set,
# prices and receipts say nothing about VAT and receipts are plain receipts, not tax invoices.
VAT_REGISTERED = bool(VAT_NUMBER)

# --- Background jobs --------------------------------------------------------------------
SCHEDULER_ENABLED = env_bool("SCHEDULER_ENABLED", True)
```

### `app/db.py`

<!-- FILE: app/db.py sha256=464a0f076b571911eae78a98d6b879aa2e93e6a0bc5d564825e9d257df0b3ec3 nl=1 -->
```python
"""SQLite access: one connection per thread, numbered SQL migrations, small query helpers.

The SQL is kept close to ANSI so that moving to PostgreSQL later is a driver swap plus
small type changes (see README "Moving to PostgreSQL").
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable, Optional

from . import config

MIGRATIONS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "migrations"
_local = threading.local()
_db_path: Path = config.DATABASE_PATH


def set_path(path: Path) -> None:
    """Point the module at another database file (tests use a temp file)."""
    global _db_path
    close()
    _db_path = Path(path)


def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = getattr(_local, "conn", None)
    if conn is not None and getattr(_local, "path", None) == _db_path:
        return conn
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(_db_path), timeout=15, isolation_level=None,
                           detect_types=0, check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 8000")
    _local.conn = conn
    _local.path = _db_path
    return conn


def close() -> None:
    conn = getattr(_local, "conn", None)
    if conn is not None:
        conn.close()
        _local.conn = None


def now() -> str:
    """UTC timestamp, ISO 8601, second precision."""
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()


def q(sql: str, params: Iterable[Any] = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return connect().execute(sql, tuple(params)).fetchall()


def one(sql: str, params: Iterable[Any] = ()) -> Optional[sqlite3.Row]:
    return connect().execute(sql, tuple(params)).fetchone()


def val(sql: str, params: Iterable[Any] = (), default: Any = None) -> Any:
    row = connect().execute(sql, tuple(params)).fetchone()
    return default if row is None or row[0] is None else row[0]


def run(sql: str, params: Iterable[Any] = ()) -> int:
    """Execute a write; returns lastrowid."""
    cur = connect().execute(sql, tuple(params))
    return cur.lastrowid


def insert(table: str, data: dict) -> int:
    cols = ", ".join(data)
    marks = ", ".join("?" for _ in data)
    return run(f"INSERT INTO {table} ({cols}) VALUES ({marks})", list(data.values()))


def update(table: str, row_id: int, data: dict, key: str = "id") -> None:
    if not data:
        return
    sets = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in data)
    run(f"UPDATE {table} SET {sets} WHERE {key} = ?", [*data.values(), row_id])


class transaction:
    """`with db.transaction():` — BEGIN IMMEDIATE / COMMIT / ROLLBACK."""

    def __enter__(self):
        self.conn = connect()
        self.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        return self.conn

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        if exc_type is None:
            self.conn.execute("COMMIT")
        else:
            self.conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        return False


def loads(text: Optional[str], default: Any = None) -> Any:
    if not text:
        return {} if default is None else default
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return {} if default is None else default


def dumps(obj: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def migrate() -> list[str]:
    """Apply every migrations/NNN_*.sql file not yet recorded. Returns names applied."""
    conn = connect()
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)")
    done = {r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM schema_migrations")}
    applied = []
    for f in sorted(MIGRATIONS_DIR.glob("*.sql")):
        if f.name in done:
            continue
        conn.executescript("BEGIN;\n" + f.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "\nCOMMIT;")
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO schema_migrations (name, applied_at) VALUES (?, ?)", (f.name, now()))
        applied.append(f.name)
    return applied
```

```python
"""Event model helpers shared by the wizard, dashboard, event websites, admin and emails."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import secrets
from typing import Optional

from . import catalog, config, db

SECTION_KEYS = [
    # key, label, feature needed (None = every package)
    ("welcome", "Welcome", None),
    ("invitation", "Invitation", "invitation"),
    ("countdown", "Countdown", "countdown"),
    ("venue", "Venue and directions", "maps"),
    ("programme", "Programme", "programme"),
    ("menu", "Menu", "menu"),
    ("dress_code", "Dress code", None),
    ("rsvp", "RSVP", "rsvp"),
    ("seating", "Your table (personal links only)", "seating"),
    ("accommodation", "Accommodation", None),
    ("registry", "Gift registry", None),
    ("gallery", "Photo gallery", "gallery"),
    ("contact", "Contact", None),
]
SECTION_LABELS = {k: label for k, label, _ in SECTION_KEYS}
SECTION_FEATURE = {k: f for k, _, f in SECTION_KEYS}

STATUS_LABELS = {"draft": "Draft", "published": "Published", "unpublished": "Unpublished",
                 "suspended": "Suspended", "archived": "Archived"}

DIETARY_OPTIONS = ["Vegetarian", "Vegan", "Halal", "Kosher", "Gluten-free", "Dairy-free", "Nut allergy",
                   "Seafood allergy", "Diabetic", "No pork", "No red meat"]

JSON_FIELDS = ("venue", "design", "guest_settings", "info", "sections", "report_prefs", "wizard_done")


def parse(row) -> Optional[dict]:
    if row is None:
        return None
    ev = dict(row)
    for k in JSON_FIELDS:
        ev[k] = db.loads(ev.get(k), [] if k == "wizard_done" else {})
    return ev


def get(uid: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    return parse(db.one("SELECT * FROM events WHERE uid = ?", (uid,)))


def by_id(event_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    return parse(db.one("SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = ?", (event_id,)))


def by_slug(slug: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    return parse(db.one("SELECT * FROM events WHERE slug = ?", (slug,)))


def save_json(event_id: int, field: str, value) -> None:
    assert field in JSON_FIELDS
    db.run(f"UPDATE events SET {field} = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (db.dumps(value), db.now(), event_id))


def touch(event_id: int, **fields) -> None:
    fields["updated_at"] = db.now()
    db.update("events", event_id, fields)


RESERVED_SLUGS = {"new", "admin", "api", "static", "media", "dashboard", "login", "logout", "create", "templates"}


def unique_slug(base: str, exclude_id: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
    from .views.forms import slugify
    slug = slugify(base, 50)
    if slug in RESERVED_SLUGS:
        slug += "-event"
    candidate, n = slug, 2
    while True:
        row = db.one("SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = ?", (candidate,))
        if row is None or row["id"] == exclude_id:
            return candidate
        candidate = f"{slug}-{n}"
        n += 1


def default_sections() -> dict:
    return {k: True for k, _, _ in SECTION_KEYS}


def create(owner_id: int, category: str, template: str, name: str, hosts: str = "", is_demo: bool = False) -> dict:
    uid = secrets.token_hex(6)
    slug = unique_slug(hosts or name)
    now = db.now()
    feats = catalog.category_features(category)
    gs = {"estimated": 0, "categories": ["Family", "Friends"], "family_groups": [],
          "children_allowed": False, "max_children": 0, "plus_one_policy": "per_guest",
          "plus_ones_default": 0, "rsvp_deadline": ""}
    if "family_sides" in feats:
        gs["sides"] = ["Bride's family", "Groom's family"]
    event_id = db.insert("events", {
        "uid": uid, "owner_id": owner_id, "slug": slug, "status": "draft", "category": category,
        "template": template, "name": name, "hosts": hosts, "venue": "{}", "design": "{}",
        "guest_settings": db.dumps(gs), "info": "{}", "sections": db.dumps(default_sections()),
        "report_prefs": db.dumps({"summary": "weekly", "new_rsvp": True, "auto_reminders": True}),
        "selected_package": "premium", "wizard_step": 1, "wizard_done": "[]", "is_demo": 1 if is_demo else 0,
        "created_at": now, "updated_at": now,
    })
    return by_id(event_id)


def public_url(ev) -> str:
    return f"{config.BASE_URL}/events/{ev['slug']}"


def public_path(ev) -> str:
    return f"/events/{ev['slug']}"


def invite_url(ev, guest) -> str:
    return f"{config.BASE_URL}/events/{ev['slug']}/i/{guest['token']}"


def new_guest_token() -> str:
    return secrets.token_urlsafe(12)


def add_pasted_guests(ev, people: list[dict]) -> int:
    """Add guests from suggestions.parse_guest_list(). People already on the list (same name, or same
    email or mobile) are skipped. Returns how many were added."""
    have = db.q("SELECT first_name, last_name, email, phone FROM guests WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
    names = {f"{g['first_name']} {g['last_name']}".strip().lower() for g in have}
    emails = {g["email"].lower() for g in have if g["email"]}
    phones = {re.sub(r"\D", "", g["phone"]) for g in have if g["phone"]}
    now, added = db.now(), 0
    for p in people:
        digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", p.get("phone", ""))
        if p["name"].lower() in names or (p.get("email") and p["email"] in emails) or (digits and digits in phones):
            continue
        couple = re.match(r"^(\S+\s+(?:&|and)\s+\S+)\s*(.*)$", p["name"], re.I)    # "Thabo & Lindi Mokoena": one invitation for two
        first, last = (couple.group(1), couple.group(2)) if couple else (p["name"].partition(" ")[0], p["name"].partition(" ")[2])
        db.insert("guests", {"event_id": ev["id"], "token": new_guest_token(), "first_name": first[:60], "last_name": last[:80],
                             "plus_ones_allowed": 1 if couple else 0,
                             "email": p.get("email", "")[:200], "phone": p.get("phone", "")[:40], "family_group": p.get("group", "")[:60], "source": "import",
                             "email_consent": 1, "created_at": now, "updated_at": now})
        names.add(p["name"].lower())
        if p.get("email"):
            emails.add(p["email"])
        if digits:
            phones.add(digits)
        added += 1
    return added


def is_live(ev) -> bool:
    """Guests can open the website."""
    return ev["status"] == "published" and bool(ev["paid_package"])


def title(ev) -> str:
    return ev["hosts"] or ev["name"]


# --- related records -------------------------------------------------------------------------
def functions(event_id: int):
    return db.q("SELECT * FROM event_functions WHERE event_id = ? ORDER BY sort, func_date, start_time, id", (event_id,))


def schedule(event_id: int):
    return db.q("""SELECT s.*, f.name AS function_name, f.func_date AS function_date FROM schedule_items s
                   LEFT JOIN event_functions f ON f.id = s.function_id
                   WHERE s.event_id = ? ORDER BY COALESCE(f.sort, 0), s.sort, s.item_time, s.id""", (event_id,))


def menus(event_id: int) -> list[dict]:
    out = []
    for m in db.q("SELECT * FROM menus WHERE event_id = ? ORDER BY sort, id", (event_id,)):
        items = [dict(r, tags=db.loads(r["tags"], [])) for r in
                 db.q("SELECT * FROM menu_items WHERE menu_id = ? ORDER BY sort, id", (m["id"],))]
        out.append(dict(m, items=items))
    return out


def meal_options(event_id: int):
    return db.q("SELECT * FROM menu_items WHERE event_id = ? AND selectable = 1 ORDER BY sort, id", (event_id,))


def uploads(event_id: int, kind: Optional[str] = None):
    if kind:
        return db.q("SELECT * FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ? AND kind = ? ORDER BY sort, id", (event_id, kind))
    return db.q("SELECT * FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ? ORDER BY kind, sort, id", (event_id,))


def upload_url(upload) -> str:
    return f"/media/{upload['storage_key']}" if upload else ""


def tables(event_id: int) -> list[dict]:
    rows = db.q("""SELECT t.*,
                     COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.status != 'declined' THEN 1 + g.plus_ones + g.children ELSE 0 END), 0) AS seated,
                     COUNT(g.id) AS parties
                   FROM seating_tables t
                   LEFT JOIN seat_assignments a ON a.table_id = t.id
                   LEFT JOIN guests g ON g.id = a.guest_id
                   WHERE t.event_id = ? GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY t.sort, t.id""", (event_id,))
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def party_size(g) -> int:
    return 1 + int(g["plus_ones"] or 0) + int(g["children"] or 0)


def stats(event_id: int) -> dict:
    r = db.one("""SELECT COUNT(*) AS invited,
                    SUM(status = 'attending') AS attending, SUM(status = 'declined') AS declined,
                    SUM(status = 'pending') AS pending,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'attending' THEN plus_ones ELSE 0 END) AS plus_ones,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'attending' THEN children ELSE 0 END) AS children
                  FROM guests WHERE event_id = ?""", (event_id,))
    invited = r["invited"] or 0
    attending = r["attending"] or 0
    declined = r["declined"] or 0
    pending = r["pending"] or 0
    plus = r["plus_ones"] or 0
    kids = r["children"] or 0
    responded = attending + declined
    seated = db.val("""SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_assignments a JOIN guests g ON g.id = a.guest_id
                       WHERE a.event_id = ? AND g.status = 'attending'""", (event_id,), 0)
    return {
        "invited": invited, "attending": attending, "declined": declined, "pending": pending,
        "plus_ones": plus, "children": kids, "headcount": attending + plus + kids,
        "responded": responded, "completion": round(100 * responded / invited) if invited else 0,
        "seated_parties": seated, "unseated_parties": max(0, attending - seated),
    }


def guest_name(g) -> str:
    return f"{g['first_name']} {g['last_name']}".strip()


def visible_sections(ev, public: bool = True) -> dict:
    """Sections switched on by the organiser and allowed by the package (paid one when public)."""
    chosen = {**default_sections(), **(ev.get("sections") or {})}
    out = {}
    for key, _, feature in SECTION_KEYS:
        allowed = feature is None or catalog.has_feature(ev, feature, public=public)
        out[key] = bool(chosen.get(key)) and allowed
    return out


def email_quota(ev) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """(used, allowed) guest emails for this event."""
    allowed = catalog.limit(ev, "email_sends", 0)
    used = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_logs WHERE event_id = ? AND audience = 'guest' AND status = 'sent'",
                  (ev["id"],), 0)
    return used, allowed


def package_gaps(ev, code: str) -> list[str]:
    """What this event already has that package `code` would not show guests, in plain words.
    Used on the review and package steps so nobody pays for less than they set up."""
    feats, lim = catalog.package_features(code), catalog.package_limits(code)
    gaps = []
    n = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_items WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],), 0)
    if n and "programme" not in feats:
        gaps.append(f"your programme ({n} item{'s' if n != 1 else ''})")
    n = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_items WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],), 0)
    if n and "menu" not in feats:
        gaps.append(f"your menu ({n} dish{'es' if n != 1 else ''})")
    if db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seating_tables WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],), 0) and "seating" not in feats:
        gaps.append("the seating chart")
    n = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ? AND kind = 'gallery'", (ev["id"],), 0)
    allowed = int(lim.get("gallery_photos", 0)) if "gallery" in feats else 0
    if n > allowed:
        gaps.append(f"your photo gallery ({n} photos)" if not allowed else f"{n - allowed} of your {n} gallery photos")
    n = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_functions WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],), 0)
    allowed = int(lim.get("functions", 1)) if "multi_functions" in feats else 1
    if n > allowed:
        gaps.append(f"{n - allowed} of your {n} event functions")
    design = ev["design"] if isinstance(ev["design"], dict) else db.loads(ev["design"], {})
    if (design or {}).get("colors") and "advanced_design" not in feats:
        gaps.append("your own colours")
    return gaps


DRAFT_COOKIE = "aurelia_draft"


def draft_token(ev) -> str:
    """Token for the shareable draft preview (/events/<slug>/draft/<token>). Tied to the event's uid
    and creation time, so it stays the same for the event's life and works for nothing else."""
    from . import auth
    return auth.sign(f"{ev['uid']}~{ev['created_at']}", "draft-preview").rpartition(".")[2]


def draft_url(ev) -> str:
    return f"{config.BASE_URL}/events/{ev['slug']}/draft/{draft_token(ev)}"


def draft_token_ok(ev, token: str) -> bool:
    import hmac
    return bool(token) and hmac.compare_digest(token, draft_token(ev))


def hosting_end(ev, months: int, start=None) -> str:
    """When the website goes offline: `months` after `start` (default today), but never before one month
    after the event date, so a client who books early never loses the site before the day."""
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    start = start or date.today()
    end = start + timedelta(days=int(months * 30.5))
    if ev.get("event_date"):
        try:
            end = max(end, date.fromisoformat(ev["event_date"]) + timedelta(days=31))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return end.isoformat()


def keep_online_past_event(ev) -> None:
    """After the event date changes on a live site, push hosting_until out if it would end too soon."""
    if ev.get("hosting_until") and ev.get("event_date"):
        from datetime import date, timedelta
        try:
            floor = (date.fromisoformat(ev["event_date"]) + timedelta(days=31)).isoformat()
        except ValueError:
            return
        if ev["hosting_until"] < floor:
            touch(ev["id"], hosting_until=floor)


TOP_TABLE_NOTE = "Top table"


def seating_layout(ev) -> dict:
    info = ev["info"] if isinstance(ev["info"], dict) else db.loads(ev["info"], {})
    lay = dict((info or {}).get("seating_layout") or {})
    lay.setdefault("top", "head" if catalog.category(ev["category"]) and catalog.category(ev["category"])["group_slug"] == "weddings" else "none")
    lay.setdefault("guest", "round")
    lay.setdefault("capacity", 10)
    return lay


# Floor plan coordinates: pos_x is the table card's centre as a percent of the floor's width; pos_y is the
# card's top edge in pixels from the top of the floor. The seating editor grows the floor to fit every card.
FLOOR_TOP = 44         # px: first row, just below the "Floor plan" label
FLOOR_TOP_ROW = 290    # px: the top table's row
FLOOR_ROW = 320        # px between rows: a full table card (four names, then "+N more") fits with room to spare
FLOOR_COLS = 3         # tables across: three fit a laptop screen beside the guest list


def floor_slots(event_id: int, n: int, cols: int = FLOOR_COLS) -> list:
    """(x, y) for n new guest tables: the first free places on a grid below the top table (if any), so a
    new table never lands on an existing one, and gaps left by deleted tables fill up first."""
    rows = db.q("SELECT pos_x, pos_y, notes FROM seating_tables WHERE event_id = ?", (event_id,))
    taken = [(r["pos_x"], r["pos_y"]) for r in rows]
    base = FLOOR_TOP + (FLOOR_TOP_ROW if any(r["notes"] == TOP_TABLE_NOTE for r in rows) else 0)
    cols = max(1, cols)
    width = 100 / cols
    out, i = [], 0
    while len(out) < n:
        x, y = round(width * (i % cols + 0.5), 1), base + FLOOR_ROW * (i // cols)
        if not any(abs(x - tx) < min(20, width * 0.8) and abs(y - ty) < FLOOR_ROW * 0.8 for tx, ty in taken):
            out.append((x, y))
            taken.append((x, y))
        i += 1
    return out


def create_layout_tables(ev, layout: dict, count: int) -> int:
    """Create the top table (if any) and `count` guest tables in the chosen shapes, laid out on the floor
    plan with the top table at the front. Returns how many tables were made."""
    cap = max(2, min(40, int(layout.get("capacity") or 10)))
    made, sort = 0, db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seating_tables WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],), 0)
    if layout.get("top") in ("head", "sweetheart"):
        head = layout["top"] == "head"
        db.insert("seating_tables", {"event_id": ev["id"], "name": "Head table" if head else "Sweetheart table",
                                     "capacity": 10 if head else 2, "shape": "long" if head else "round",
                                     "pos_x": 50, "pos_y": FLOOR_TOP, "notes": TOP_TABLE_NOTE, "sort": sort})
        made, sort = 1, sort + 1
    count = max(0, min(120, count))
    cols = min(2 if layout.get("guest") == "long" else FLOOR_COLS, max(1, count))    # two tables spread across the room, not bunched left
    for k, (x, y) in enumerate(floor_slots(ev["id"], count, cols)):
        long = layout.get("guest") == "long" or (layout.get("guest") == "mixed" and k % 3 == 2)
        db.insert("seating_tables", {"event_id": ev["id"], "name": f"Table {k + 1}", "capacity": cap, "shape": "long" if long else "round",
                                     "pos_x": x, "pos_y": y, "sort": sort + k})
        made += 1
    return made


def suggested_rsvp_deadline(event_date: str) -> str:
    """Six weeks before the event (a week before if the event is close); "" if that would already be past."""
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    try:
        d = date.fromisoformat(event_date or "")
    except ValueError:
        return ""
    for weeks in (6, 4, 2, 1):
        cand = d - timedelta(weeks=weeks)
        if cand > date.today():
            return cand.isoformat()
    return ""
```

```python
"""Sample events for the template gallery. All names and venues are fictional."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, timedelta

from .. import catalog

SAMPLES = {
    "weddings": {

def demo_event(template_slug: str, group: str = "weddings") -> dict:
    if group not in SAMPLES:
        group = "weddings"
    t = catalog.template(template_slug)
    design = t["design"] if t else template_slug
    s = SAMPLES[group]
    today = date.today()
    ev_date = today + timedelta(days=s["event_days"])
    first_time = s["functions"][0][1] if s["functions"] else s["schedule"][0][0]
    functions = [{"id": k + 1, "name": n, "func_date": ev_date.isoformat(), "start_time": st, "end_time": en,
                  "venue_name": vn, "address": ad, "map_url": "", "description": "", "dress_code": ""}
                 for k, (n, st, en, vn, ad) in enumerate(s["functions"])]
    schedule = [{"item_time": tm, "title": ti, "description": de, "kind": kd,
                 "function_name": (functions[0]["name"] if functions and tm < "17:00" else functions[-1]["name"]) if functions else ""}
                for tm, ti, de, kd in s["schedule"]]
    items = [{"id": k + 1, "course": c, "name": n, "description": d, "tags": tags, "selectable": sel}
             for k, (c, n, d, tags, sel) in enumerate(s["menu"])]
    menus = [{"name": "Menu" if group != "weddings" else "Reception menu", "description": "", "items": items}] if items else []
    return {
        "_demo": True, "_design": design, "_group": group,
        "_functions": functions, "_schedule": schedule, "_menus": menus, "_hero": _stock_hero(template_slug, group),
        "_gallery": _stock_gallery(template_slug, group),
        "id": 0, "uid": "demo", "slug": f"sample-{template_slug}", "status": "published", "owner_id": 0,
        "template": template_slug, "category": s["category"], "name": s["name"], "hosts": s["hosts"],
        "description": s["description"], "event_date": ev_date.isoformat(), "start_time": first_time,
        "end_time": "23:00" if group in ("weddings", "parties") else "16:00",
        "venue": dict(s["venue"], map_url=""),
        "design": {}, "guest_settings": {
            "estimated": 150, "categories": ["Family", "Friends"], "sides": s["sides"],
            "children_allowed": group == "baby", "max_children": 2, "plus_one_policy": "per_guest",
            "plus_ones_default": 1, "rsvp_deadline": (today + timedelta(days=s["deadline_days"])).isoformat()},
        "info": {"dress_code": s["dress"][0], "dress_code_notes": s["dress"][1],
                 "registry": [{"name": n, "url": u, "note": no} for n, u, no in s["registry"]],
                 "gift_note": s["gift_note"],
                 "contacts": [{"name": n, "role": r, "phone": ph, "email": em} for n, r, ph, em in s["contacts"]],
                 "accommodation": [{"name": n, "url": u, "note": no} for n, u, no in s["accommodation"]],
                 "instructions": s["instructions"], "drinks": s["drinks"], "catering_notes": "",
                 "dietary_options": []},
        "sections": {}, "report_prefs": {}, "selected_package": "signature", "paid_package": "signature",
        "hosting_until": None, "rsvp_open": 1, "published_at": None, "wizard_done": [],
    }


def _stock_hero(slug: str, group: str) -> str:
    from .. import stock
    if slug == "heritage" and stock.url("traditional"):
        return stock.url("traditional")
    return stock.url(group)


def _stock_gallery(slug: str, group: str) -> list:
    """Real photos when they have been added (static/img/stock/gallery/<slot>/), else six art tiles."""
    from .. import stock
    slot = "traditional" if slug == "heritage" and stock.gallery("traditional") else group
    photos = stock.gallery(slot) or (stock.gallery("weddings") if group == "weddings" else [])
    if photos:
        return [{"url": u, "caption": ""} for u in photos[:9]]
    return [{"url": "", "caption": ""} for _ in range(6)]
```

<!-- FILE: app/eventsite/designs.py sha256=155fe0f2545f6a63f92953563cc5d44ab07daf30d2c6bb4cdfea31637e0e964e nl=1 -->
```python
"""The eleven event-website designs.

Shared section builders turn the render context into semantic HTML (only for sections that are
visible and have content). Each design then arranges them in its own structure: a different
hero, different navigation, different section containers and ornaments. Styling lives in
static/css/eventsite.css, scoped by `.d-<design>`.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ..web import esc
from ..views.forms import fmt_date, fmt_time
from .. import events

ORDER = ["invitation", "countdown", "venue", "programme", "menu", "dress_code", "rsvp", "seating",
         "accommodation", "registry", "gallery", "contact"]

TITLES = {
    "invitation": "The invitation", "countdown": "Counting down", "venue": "Where and when",
    "programme": "Programme", "menu": "Menu", "dress_code": "Dress code", "rsvp": "RSVP",
    "seating": "Your table", "accommodation": "Where to stay", "registry": "Gifts",
    "gallery": "Gallery", "contact": "Questions",
}
NAV_LABELS = {"invitation": "Invitation", "countdown": "Countdown", "venue": "Venue", "programme": "Programme",
              "menu": "Menu", "dress_code": "Dress code", "rsvp": "RSVP", "seating": "Seating",
              "accommodation": "Stay", "registry": "Gifts", "gallery": "Gallery", "contact": "Contact"}


def p(text: str, cls: str = "") -> str:
    """Escaped text → paragraphs (blank lines) with line breaks."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    paras = [x.strip() for x in str(text).replace("\r", "").split("\n\n") if x.strip()]
    c = f' class="{cls}"' if cls else ""
    return "".join(f"<p{c}>{esc(x).replace(chr(10), '<br>')}</p>" for x in paras)


def names_html(ctx, amp: str = "&amp;") -> str:
    n = ctx["names"]
    if len(n) == 2:
        return (f'<span class="ev-name">{esc(n[0])}</span><span class="ev-amp" aria-hidden="true">{amp}</span>'
                f'<span class="sr-only"> and </span><span class="ev-name">{esc(n[1])}</span>')
    return f'<span class="ev-name">{esc(n[0])}</span>'


def date_parts(ctx) -> dict:
    d = ctx["date"]
    if not d:
        return {"day": "", "dd": "", "month": "", "mon": "", "year": "", "weekday": ""}
    return {"day": str(d.day), "dd": f"{d.day:02d}", "month": d.strftime("%B"), "mon": d.strftime("%b"),
            "year": str(d.year), "weekday": d.strftime("%A")}


def btn(href: str, label: str, cls: str = "", external: bool = False) -> str:
    ext = ' target="_blank" rel="noopener"' if external else ""
    return f'<a class="ev-btn {cls}" href="{esc(href)}"{ext}>{esc(label)}</a>'


def hero_image(ctx, cls: str = "ev-photo", art: str = "") -> str:
    if ctx["hero"]:
        return f'<div class="{cls}"><img src="{esc(ctx["hero"])}" alt="" loading="eager"></div>'
    return f'<div class="{cls} ev-photo--art" aria-hidden="true">{art}</div>'


# --- section content builders -------------------------------------------------------------------
def s_invitation(ctx) -> str:
    w = ctx["wording"]
    out = f'<p class="ev-lead">{esc(w["invitation"])}</p>'
    if ctx["description"]:
        out += p(ctx["description"], "ev-text")
    return out


def when_list(ctx) -> str:
    v = ctx["venue"]
    rows = [("Date", ctx["date_text"])]
    if ctx["time_text"]:
        rows.append(("Time", ctx["time_text"]))
    if v.get("name"):
        rows.append(("Venue", v["name"]))
    return '<dl class="ev-when">' + "".join(f"<div><dt>{k}</dt><dd>{esc(x)}</dd></div>" for k, x in rows) + "</dl>"


def s_countdown(ctx) -> str:
    if not ctx["countdown_iso"]:
        return ""
    units = [("d", "Days"), ("h", "Hours"), ("m", "Minutes"), ("s", "Seconds")]
    cells = "".join(f'<div class="ev-count__cell"><b data-u="{u}">00</b><span>{lab}</span></div>' for u, lab in units)
    return (f'<div class="ev-count" data-countdown="{esc(ctx["countdown_iso"])}" role="timer" aria-live="off">{cells}</div>'
            f'<p class="ev-count__done" hidden>The celebration has begun.</p>')


def s_venue(ctx) -> str:
    v = ctx["venue"]
    funcs = ctx["functions"]
    out = ""
    if v.get("name") or v.get("address"):
        out += '<div class="ev-venue">'
        if v.get("name"):
            out += f'<h3 class="ev-venue__name">{esc(v["name"])}</h3>'
        if v.get("address"):
            out += f'<p class="ev-venue__addr">{esc(v["address"])}</p>'
        out += f'<p class="ev-venue__time">{esc(ctx["date_text"])}{(" · " + esc(ctx["time_text"])) if ctx["time_text"] else ""}</p>'
        if ctx["map_url"]:
            out += f'<div class="ev-actions">{btn(ctx["map_url"], "Open in Google Maps", "", True)}'
            if ctx["mode"] != "demo" and ctx["ev"].get("slug"):
                out += f'<a class="ev-btn ev-btn--ghost" href="{esc(ctx["path"])}/calendar.ics">Add to calendar</a>'
            out += "</div>"
        out += "</div>"
    extras = []
    if v.get("parking"):
        extras.append(("Parking", v["parking"]))
    if v.get("directions"):
        extras.append(("Directions", v["directions"]))
    if extras:
        out += '<div class="ev-notes">' + "".join(
            f'<div class="ev-note"><h4>{k}</h4>{p(x)}</div>' for k, x in extras) + "</div>"
    if len(funcs) > 1:
        out += '<ol class="ev-funcs">'
        for f in funcs:
            when = " · ".join(x for x in (fmt_date(f.get("func_date"), False) if f.get("func_date") else "",
                                          " – ".join(y for y in (fmt_time(f.get("start_time")), fmt_time(f.get("end_time"))) if y)) if x)
            murl = f.get("map_url") or (
                "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" + __import__("urllib.parse").parse.quote_plus(
                    ", ".join(x for x in (f.get("venue_name"), f.get("address")) if x))
                if (f.get("venue_name") or f.get("address")) else "")
            out += (f'<li class="ev-func"><h3>{esc(f["name"])}</h3>'
                    f'{f"<p class=ev-func__when>{esc(when)}</p>" if when else ""}'
                    f'{("<p class=ev-func__venue>" + esc(f.get("venue_name") or "") + ("<br>" + esc(f["address"]) if f.get("address") else "") + "</p>") if (f.get("venue_name") or f.get("address")) else ""}'
                    f'{p(f.get("description") or "", "ev-small")}'
                    f'{("<p class=ev-small><b>Dress:</b> " + esc(f["dress_code"]) + "</p>") if f.get("dress_code") else ""}'
                    f'{btn(murl, "Map", "ev-btn--ghost ev-btn--sm", True) if murl else ""}</li>')
        out += "</ol>"
    return out


def s_programme(ctx) -> str:
    items = ctx["schedule"]
    if not items:
        return ""
    groups: list = []
    for it in items:
        name = it.get("function_name") or ""
        if not groups or groups[-1][0] != name:
            groups.append((name, [], it.get("function_date") or ""))
        groups[-1][1].append(it)
    out = ""
    for name, rows, day in groups:
        if name and len(groups) > 1:
            when = fmt_date(day, False) if day else ""
            out += f'<h3 class="ev-prog__group">{esc(name)}{(" <small>" + esc(when) + "</small>") if when else ""}</h3>'
        out += '<ol class="ev-prog">' + "".join(
            f'<li class="ev-prog__item ev-kind-{esc(it.get("kind") or "other")}"><time>{esc(fmt_time(it.get("item_time")))}</time>'
            f'<div><h4>{esc(it["title"])}</h4>{p(it.get("description") or "", "ev-small")}</div></li>' for it in rows) + "</ol>"
    return out


def s_menu(ctx) -> str:
    menus = ctx["menus"]
    info = ctx["info"]
    if not menus and not info.get("drinks"):
        return ""
    out = ""
    for m in menus:
        out += f'<div class="ev-menu"><h3 class="ev-menu__name">{esc(m["name"])}</h3>{p(m.get("description") or "", "ev-small ev-muted")}'
        course = None
        for it in m["items"]:
            if it.get("course") != course:
                if course is not None:
                    out += "</ul>"
                course = it.get("course")
                out += f'<h4 class="ev-menu__course">{esc(course or "")}</h4><ul class="ev-menu__items">'
            tags = it.get("tags") or []
            tag_html = "".join(f'<span class="ev-tag">{esc(t)}</span>' for t in tags)
            choice = '<span class="ev-tag ev-tag--choice">Choose on RSVP</span>' if it.get("selectable") else ""
            out += (f'<li><span class="ev-menu__dish">{esc(it["name"])}</span>{p(it.get("description") or "", "ev-small")}'
                    f'{("<span class=ev-tags>" + tag_html + choice + "</span>") if (tag_html or choice) else ""}</li>')
        if course is not None:
            out += "</ul>"
        out += "</div>"
    if info.get("drinks"):
        out += f'<div class="ev-note"><h4>Drinks</h4>{p(info["drinks"])}</div>'
    if info.get("catering_notes"):
        out += f'<div class="ev-note"><h4>Catering notes</h4>{p(info["catering_notes"])}</div>'
    return out


def s_dress(ctx) -> str:
    info = ctx["info"]
    if not info.get("dress_code"):
        return ""
    return f'<p class="ev-dress">{esc(info["dress_code"])}</p>{p(info.get("dress_code_notes") or "", "ev-text")}'


def s_seating(ctx) -> str:
    if not ctx["table"]:
        return ""
    who = esc(events.guest_name(ctx["guest"])) if ctx["guest"] is not None else "Your guest"
    return (f'<div class="ev-table"><span class="ev-table__label">{who}, you are seated at</span>'
            f'<strong class="ev-table__name">{esc(ctx["table"])}</strong>'
            f'<span class="ev-small ev-muted">Your seat is shown only on your personal invitation link.</span></div>')


def s_accommodation(ctx) -> str:
    v, info = ctx["venue"], ctx["info"]
    items = info.get("accommodation") or []
    if not v.get("accommodation") and not items:
        return ""
    out = p(v.get("accommodation") or "", "ev-text")
    if items:
        out += '<ul class="ev-list">' + "".join(
            f'<li><h4>{(("<a href=" + chr(34) + esc(a["url"]) + chr(34) + " target=_blank rel=noopener>" + esc(a.get("name") or "Link") + "</a>") if a.get("url") else esc(a.get("name") or ""))}</h4>{p(a.get("note") or "", "ev-small")}</li>'
            for a in items) + "</ul>"
    return out


def s_registry(ctx) -> str:
    info = ctx["info"]
    items = info.get("registry") or []
    if not items and not info.get("gift_note"):
        return ""
    out = p(info.get("gift_note") or "", "ev-text")
    if items:
        out += '<ul class="ev-list ev-list--reg">' + "".join(
            f'<li><h4>{esc(r.get("name") or "Registry")}</h4>{p(r.get("note") or "", "ev-small")}'
            f'{btn(r["url"], "View registry", "ev-btn--ghost ev-btn--sm", True) if r.get("url") else ""}</li>'
            for r in items) + "</ul>"
    return out


ART_TILES = 6


def s_gallery(ctx) -> str:
    imgs = ctx["gallery"]
    if not imgs:
        return ""
    cells = []
    for k, g in enumerate(imgs[:60]):
        if g.get("url"):
            cells.append(f'<figure class="ev-gal__item"><img src="{esc(g["url"])}" alt="{esc(g.get("caption") or "Event photo")}" loading="lazy">'
                         f'{("<figcaption>" + esc(g["caption"]) + "</figcaption>") if g.get("caption") else ""}</figure>')
        else:
            cells.append(f'<figure class="ev-gal__item ev-gal__art ev-art-{k % ART_TILES}" aria-hidden="true">'
                         f'{("<figcaption>" + esc(g.get("caption")) + "</figcaption>") if g.get("caption") else ""}</figure>')
    return f'<div class="ev-gal">{"".join(cells)}</div>'


def s_contact(ctx) -> str:
    info = ctx["info"]
    contacts = info.get("contacts") or []
    if not contacts and not info.get("instructions"):
        return ""
    out = ""
    if info.get("instructions"):
        out += f'<div class="ev-note"><h4>Good to know</h4>{p(info["instructions"])}</div>'
    if contacts:
        out += '<ul class="ev-contacts">'
        for c in contacts:
            links = ""
            if c.get("phone"):
                tel = "".join(ch for ch in c["phone"] if ch.isdigit() or ch == "+")
                wa = tel.lstrip("+")
                if wa.startswith("0"):
                    wa = "27" + wa[1:]
                links += f'<a class="ev-btn ev-btn--ghost ev-btn--sm" href="tel:{esc(tel)}">Call {esc(c["phone"])}</a>'
                links += f'<a class="ev-btn ev-btn--ghost ev-btn--sm" href="https://wa.me/{esc(wa)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp</a>'
            if c.get("email"):
                links += f'<a class="ev-btn ev-btn--ghost ev-btn--sm" href="mailto:{esc(c["email"])}">Email</a>'
            out += (f'<li><h4>{esc(c.get("name") or "")}</h4>'
                    f'{("<p class=ev-small>" + esc(c["role"]) + "</p>") if c.get("role") else ""}'
                    f'<div class="ev-actions">{links}</div></li>')
        out += "</ul>"
    return out


# --- RSVP ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _val(ctx, name: str, default=""):
    vals = (ctx["form"] or {}).get("values") or {}
    if name in vals:
        return vals[name]
    g = ctx["guest"]
    if g is not None:
        try:
            v = g[name]
            return default if v is None else v
        except (KeyError, IndexError):
            return default
    return default


def _err(ctx, name: str) -> str:
    e = ((ctx["form"] or {}).get("errors") or {}).get(name)
    return f'<span class="ev-err" id="err-{name}">{esc(e)}</span>' if e else ""


def _field(ctx, name, label, type_="text", required=False, auto="", hint="") -> str:
    req = " required" if required else ""
    ac = f' autocomplete="{auto}"' if auto else ""
    inv = ' aria-invalid="true"' if ((ctx["form"] or {}).get("errors") or {}).get(name) else ""
    return (f'<div class="ev-field"><label for="r-{name}">{esc(label)}{" <span aria-hidden=true>*</span>" if required else ""}</label>'
            f'<input class="ev-input" id="r-{name}" name="{name}" type="{type_}" value="{esc(_val(ctx, name))}"{req}{ac}{inv}>'
            f'{("<span class=ev-hint>" + esc(hint) + "</span>") if hint else ""}{_err(ctx, name)}</div>')


def _number_select(ctx, name, label, maximum) -> str:
    cur = str(_val(ctx, name, 0) or 0)
    opts = "".join(f'<option value="{n}"{" selected" if str(n) == cur else ""}>{n}</option>' for n in range(maximum + 1))
    return (f'<div class="ev-field"><label for="r-{name}">{esc(label)}</label>'
            f'<select class="ev-input" id="r-{name}" name="{name}">{opts}</select>{_err(ctx, name)}</div>')


def rsvp_form(ctx) -> str:
    ev, guest, mode = ctx["ev"], ctx["guest"], ctx["mode"]
    w = ctx["wording"]
    errors = (ctx["form"] or {}).get("errors") or {}
    if ctx["thanks"]:
        if guest is not None:
            status = guest["status"]
            msg = ("Thank you, we can't wait to see you." if status == "attending"
                   else "Thank you for letting us know. You'll be missed." if status == "declined" else "Thank you.")
            change = f'<a class="ev-btn ev-btn--ghost" href="{esc(ctx["path"])}/i/{esc(guest["token"])}#rsvp">Change my answer</a>'
        else:
            msg, change = "Thank you, your reply has been sent to the hosts.", ""
        conf = " A confirmation is on its way to your inbox." if (guest is not None and guest["email"]) else ""
        return f'<div class="ev-thanks" role="status" tabindex="-1" data-focus-me><h3>Reply received</h3><p>{esc(msg)}{conf}</p>{change}</div>'
    if ctx["closed"]:
        return f'<div class="ev-thanks"><p>{esc(ctx["closed"])}</p><p class="ev-small">Please contact the hosts if your plans have changed.</p></div>'
    demo = mode == "demo"
    allow = ctx["allow"]
    status = str(_val(ctx, "status", ""))
    if status == "pending":
        status = ""
    parts = [f'<p class="ev-rsvp__note">{esc(w["rsvp_note"])}</p>']
    if errors:
        parts.append('<div class="ev-errors" role="alert"><b>Please check the highlighted fields.</b><ul>'
                     + "".join(f"<li>{esc(m)}</li>" for m in errors.values()) + "</ul></div>")
    if guest is not None:
        replied = ""
        if guest["status"] in ("attending", "declined") and guest["responded_at"]:
            replied = f' You replied <b>{"attending" if guest["status"] == "attending" else "not attending"}</b>; you can change it below.'
        parts.append(f'<p class="ev-rsvp__as">Replying as <b>{esc(events.guest_name(guest))}</b>.{replied}</p>'
                     f'<input type="hidden" name="token" value="{esc(guest["token"])}">')
    else:
        parts.append('<div class="ev-grid2">' + _field(ctx, "first_name", "First name", required=True, auto="given-name")
                     + _field(ctx, "last_name", "Surname", required=True, auto="family-name") + "</div>"
                     + '<div class="ev-grid2">' + _field(ctx, "email", "Email", "email", True, "email",
                                                          "We'll send your confirmation here.")
                     + _field(ctx, "phone", "Mobile (optional)", "tel", False, "tel") + "</div>")
    a_chk = " checked" if status == "attending" else ""
    d_chk = " checked" if status == "declined" else ""
    parts.append(f'<fieldset class="ev-choice"><legend>Will you attend?</legend>'
                 f'<label class="ev-radio"><input type="radio" name="status" value="attending" required{a_chk}><span>Joyfully accepts</span></label>'
                 f'<label class="ev-radio"><input type="radio" name="status" value="declined"{d_chk}><span>Regretfully declines</span></label>'
                 f'{_err(ctx, "status")}</fieldset>')
    att = []
    if allow["plus_ones"]:
        att.append('<div class="ev-grid2">' + _number_select(ctx, "plus_ones", f"Guests joining you (up to {allow['plus_ones']})", allow["plus_ones"])
                   + _field(ctx, "plus_one_names", "Their names") + "</div>")
    if allow["children"]:
        att.append(_number_select(ctx, "children", f"Children attending (up to {allow['children']})", allow["children"]))
    funcs = ctx["functions"]
    if len(funcs) > 1 and ctx["feat"]("multi_functions"):
        sel = ctx["guest_functions"]
        boxes = "".join(
            f'<label class="ev-check"><input type="checkbox" name="functions" value="{esc(f.get("id", k))}"'
            f'{" checked" if (sel.get(f.get("id"), 1) if sel else True) else ""}><span>{esc(f["name"])}'
            f'{(" · " + esc(fmt_date(f.get("func_date"), False))) if f.get("func_date") else ""}</span></label>'
            for k, f in enumerate(funcs))
        att.append(f'<fieldset class="ev-choice"><legend>Which parts will you attend?</legend>{boxes}</fieldset>')
    if ctx["meals"]:
        cur = str(_val(ctx, "meal_item_id", "") or "")
        opts = '<option value="">Choose a meal</option>' + "".join(
            f'<option value="{esc(m.get("id", k))}"{" selected" if str(m.get("id", k)) == cur else ""}>{esc(m["name"])}</option>'
            for k, m in enumerate(ctx["meals"]))
        att.append(f'<div class="ev-field"><label for="r-meal">Meal choice</label><select class="ev-input" id="r-meal" name="meal_item_id">{opts}</select>{_err(ctx, "meal_item_id")}</div>')
    if ctx["feat"]("dietary"):
        chosen = {x.strip() for x in str(_val(ctx, "dietary", "")).split(",") if x.strip()}
        offered = ctx["info"].get("dietary_options") or events.DIETARY_OPTIONS
        boxes = "".join(f'<label class="ev-check"><input type="checkbox" name="dietary" value="{esc(o)}"{" checked" if o in chosen else ""}><span>{esc(o)}</span></label>'
                        for o in offered)
        att.append(f'<fieldset class="ev-choice ev-choice--wrap"><legend>Dietary requirements</legend>{boxes}</fieldset>'
                   + _field(ctx, "allergies", "Allergies we should know about"))
    if att:
        parts.append('<div class="ev-attending" data-attending>' + "".join(att) + "</div>")
    parts.append(f'<div class="ev-field"><label for="r-req">Message or special requests</label>'
                 f'<textarea class="ev-input" id="r-req" name="special_requests" rows="3" maxlength="1000">{esc(_val(ctx, "special_requests"))}</textarea></div>')
    parts.append('<div class="ev-hp" aria-hidden="true"><label>Leave empty <input name="website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></label></div>')
    privacy = ('<p class="ev-small ev-muted">Your reply is shared only with the hosts. '
               'It is never shown to other guests.</p>')
    if demo:
        return (f'<form class="ev-rsvp" onsubmit="return false"><fieldset disabled>{"".join(parts)}'
                f'<button class="ev-btn ev-btn--wide" type="button">Send my reply</button></fieldset>'
                f'<p class="ev-small ev-muted">This is a sample. RSVPs work on your own published event.</p></form>')
    action = f'{ctx["path"]}/rsvp'
    disabled = ""
    if mode == "preview":
        disabled = " disabled"
        privacy += '<p class="ev-small ev-muted">Preview only: guests can reply once the website is published.</p>'
    return (f'<form class="ev-rsvp" method="post" action="{esc(action)}" novalidate>'
            f'<input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{esc(ctx["csrf"])}">{"".join(parts)}'
            f'<button class="ev-btn ev-btn--wide" type="submit"{disabled}>Send my reply</button>{privacy}</form>')


BUILDERS = {
    "invitation": s_invitation, "countdown": s_countdown, "venue": s_venue, "programme": s_programme,
    "menu": s_menu, "dress_code": s_dress, "rsvp": rsvp_form, "seating": s_seating,
    "accommodation": s_accommodation, "registry": s_registry, "gallery": s_gallery, "contact": s_contact,
}


def collect(ctx, order=None) -> list:
    """[(key, inner_html)] for visible sections that have content."""
    out = []
    for key in order or ORDER:
        if not ctx["show"].get(key):
            continue
        html = BUILDERS[key](ctx)
        if html:
            out.append((key, html))
    return out


def head(key: str, title: str, kicker: str = "", tag: str = "h2") -> str:
    k = f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(kicker)}</p>' if kicker else ""
    return f'<header class="ev-h">{k}<{tag} id="{key}-h">{esc(title)}</{tag}></header>'


def section(key: str, inner: str, title: str = "", kicker: str = "", cls: str = "", heading: bool = True) -> str:
    h = head(key, title or TITLES[key], kicker) if heading else f'<h2 id="{key}-h" class="sr-only">{esc(title or TITLES[key])}</h2>'
    return (f'<section class="ev-sec ev-sec--{key} {cls}" id="{key}" aria-labelledby="{key}-h">'
            f'<div class="ev-sec__in">{h}<div class="ev-sec__body">{inner}</div></div></section>')


def nav(ctx, secs, cls: str = "ev-nav", numbered: bool = False) -> str:
    if len(secs) < 3:
        return ""
    items = "".join(
        f'<li><a href="#{k}">{f"<span class=ev-nav__n>{n:02d}</span>" if numbered else ""}{esc(NAV_LABELS[k])}</a></li>'
        for n, (k, _) in enumerate(secs, 1) if k != "countdown")
    return f'<nav class="{cls}" aria-label="Event sections"><ul>{items}</ul></nav>'


def rsvp_cta(ctx, label: str = "RSVP") -> str:
    if ctx["show"].get("rsvp"):
        return f'<a class="ev-btn" href="#rsvp">{esc(label)}</a>'
    return ""


def greeting(ctx) -> str:
    g = ctx["guest"]
    if g is None:
        return ""
    return f'<p class="ev-greet">Dear {esc(g["first_name"])},</p>'

def beads(cls: str = "") -> str:
    tri = "".join(
        f'<path class="{"bd-a" if k % 3 == 0 else "bd-b" if k % 3 == 1 else "bd-c"}" d="M{k*24} 22l12-18 12 18Z"/>'
        f'<path class="bd-d" d="M{k*24+12} 4l6 9-6 9-6-9Z"/>' for k in range(4))
    return (f'<div class="orn-beads {cls}" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="100%" height="26"><defs>'
            f'<pattern id="bd{cls or "x"}" width="96" height="26" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">{tri}'
            f'<rect class="bd-c" y="23" width="96" height="3"/></pattern></defs>'
            f'<rect width="100%" height="26" fill="url(#bd{cls or "x"})"/></svg></div>')
```
