```python
CONFETTI = "".join(f'<i class="cf cf-{k}" aria-hidden="true"></i>' for k in range(14))


def monogram_ring(ctx, cls: str = "ev-mono") -> str:
    if ctx["logo"]:
        return f'<div class="{cls} {cls}--logo"><img src="{esc(ctx["logo"])}" alt="{esc(ctx["hosts"])} logo"></div>'
    return f'<div class="{cls}" aria-hidden="true"><span>{esc(ctx["monogram"])}</span></div>'


# --- layouts ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def atelier(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    hero = (f'<header class="at-hero" id="welcome">{monogram_ring(ctx)}'
            f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="at-names">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>'
            f'<div class="at-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>'
            f'<p class="at-date">{esc(dp["weekday"])}{", " if dp["weekday"] else ""}{esc(dp["day"])} {esc(dp["month"])} {esc(dp["year"])}</p>'
            f'<p class="at-place">{esc(ctx["venue"].get("name") or "")}</p>{rsvp_cta(ctx, "Reply")}</header>')
    body = "".join(section(k, html, cls="at-sec") for k, html in secs)
    photo = f'<div class="at-photo">{hero_image(ctx)}</div>' if ctx["hero"] else ""
    return hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav at-nav") + photo + f'<div class="at-col">{body}</div>'


def folio(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    issue = {"weddings": "The Wedding Issue", "baby": "The Baby Issue", "parties": "The Party Issue"}.get(ctx["group"], "The Occasion Issue")
    art = '<span class="fo-art__mark">' + esc(ctx["monogram"]) + "</span>"
    hero = (f'<header class="fo-hero" id="welcome"><div class="fo-mast"><span>{esc(issue)}</span>'
            f'<span class="mono">{esc(dp["dd"])}.{esc(dp["mon"]).upper()}.{esc(dp["year"])}</span></div>'
            f'<div class="fo-hero__grid"><div class="fo-hero__text"><p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="fo-title">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>'
            f'<p class="fo-deck">{esc(ctx["wording"]["invitation"])}</p>'
            f'<div class="ev-actions">{rsvp_cta(ctx, "Reply to the invitation")}</div></div>'
            f'<figure class="fo-hero__fig">{hero_image(ctx, "ev-photo fo-photo", art)}'
            f'<figcaption>{esc(ctx["venue"].get("name") or ctx["title"])} · {esc(ctx["date_text"])}</figcaption></figure></div></header>')
    body = "".join(section(k, html, kicker=f"{n:02d}", cls="fo-sec") for n, (k, html) in enumerate(secs, 1))
    return hero + f'<div class="fo-body">{nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav fo-index", numbered=True)}<div class="fo-main">{body}</div></div>'


def bloom(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    hero = (f'<header class="bl-hero" id="welcome">{SPRIG.replace("orn-sprig", "orn-sprig bl-tl")}{SPRIG.replace("orn-sprig", "orn-sprig bl-br")}'
            f'<div class="bl-hero__in"><p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<div class="bl-arch">{hero_image(ctx, "ev-photo bl-arch__img", SPRIG)}</div>'
            f'<h1 class="bl-names">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>'
            f'<p class="bl-date"><span>{esc(dp["weekday"])}</span><b>{esc(dp["day"])}</b><span>{esc(dp["month"])} {esc(dp["year"])}</span></p>'
            f'{rsvp_cta(ctx, "Kindly reply")}</div></header>')
    body = "".join(section(k, html, cls="bl-sec") + ('<div class="bl-div" aria-hidden="true">❀</div>' if n < len(secs) else "")
                   for n, (k, html) in enumerate(secs, 1))
    return hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav bl-nav") + f'<div class="bl-body">{body}</div>'


def heritage(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    sides = (ctx["gs"].get("sides") or [])
    fam = ""
    if sides and ctx["group"] in ("weddings", "other"):
        fam_items = "".join(f'<li><span class="hr-fam__mark" aria-hidden="true">◆</span><h3>{esc(s)}</h3></li>' for s in sides[:4])
        fam = (f'<section class="ev-sec hr-fam" aria-labelledby="fam-h"><div class="ev-sec__in">{head("fam", "Two families, one celebration", "Umndeni")}'
               f'<p class="ev-text">{esc(ctx["wording"].get("families") or "With the blessing of our elders and the joy of both families, we welcome you.")}</p>'
               f'<ul class="hr-fam__list">{fam_items}</ul></div></section>')
    hero = (f'{beads("hr-top")}<header class="hr-hero" id="welcome"><div class="hr-hero__text">'
            f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}<h1 class="hr-names">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>'
            f'<p class="hr-date">{esc(dp["day"])} · {esc(dp["month"])} · {esc(dp["year"])}</p>'
            f'<p class="ev-text">{esc(ctx["venue"].get("name") or "")}</p><div class="ev-actions">{rsvp_cta(ctx, "Respond")}</div></div>'
            f'<div class="hr-hero__mark"><div class="hr-diamond">{hero_image(ctx, "ev-photo hr-photo", "<span>" + esc(ctx["monogram"]) + "</span>")}</div></div></header>{beads("hr-mid")}')
    body = ""
    for n, (k, html) in enumerate(secs):
        if k == "venue" and len(ctx["functions"]) > 1:
            title = "The ceremonies"
        else:
            title = TITLES[k]
        body += section(k, html, title=title, cls="hr-sec" + (" hr-sec--alt" if n % 2 else ""))
        if k in ("invitation",) and fam:
            body += fam
            fam = ""
    return hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav hr-nav") + fam + body + beads("hr-bottom")


def champagne(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    hero = (f'<header class="ch-hero" id="welcome">{FAN}<div class="ch-hero__in">'
            f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="ch-names foil">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>{DECO_RULE}'
            f'<p class="ch-date"><span>{esc(dp["weekday"])}</span><b class="foil">{esc(dp["dd"])}</b><span>{esc(dp["month"])} {esc(dp["year"])}</span></p>'
            f'<p class="ch-place">{esc(ctx["venue"].get("name") or "")}</p>{rsvp_cta(ctx, "RSVP")}</div></header>')
    body = "".join(section(k, html, cls="ch-sec ch-glass") for k, html in secs)
    photo = f'<div class="ch-photo">{hero_image(ctx)}</div>' if ctx["hero"] else ""
    return hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav ch-nav") + photo + f'<div class="ch-body">{body}</div>'


def linea(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    v = ctx["venue"]
    meta = (f'<dl class="li-meta"><div><dt>Date</dt><dd>{esc(dp["day"])} {esc(dp["month"])} {esc(dp["year"])}</dd></div>'
            f'<div><dt>Time</dt><dd>{esc(ctx["time_text"] or "To be confirmed")}</dd></div>'
            f'<div><dt>Place</dt><dd>{esc(v.get("name") or "To be confirmed")}</dd></div></dl>')
    hero = (f'<header class="li-hero" id="welcome"><div class="li-hero__top"><span class="li-mono">{esc(ctx["monogram"])}</span>'
            f'{nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav li-nav")}</div>'
            f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}<h1 class="li-names">{names_html(ctx, "+")}</h1>{meta}'
            f'{("<div class=li-photo>" + hero_image(ctx) + "</div>") if ctx["hero"] else ""}</header>')
    rows = "".join(
        f'<section class="ev-sec li-row ev-sec--{k}" id="{k}" aria-labelledby="{k}-h"><div class="li-row__label">'
        f'<span class="li-row__n">{n:02d}</span><h2 id="{k}-h">{esc(TITLES[k])}</h2></div>'
        f'<div class="li-row__body ev-sec__body">{html}</div></section>'
        for n, (k, html) in enumerate(secs, 1))
    return hero + f'<div class="li-body">{rows}</div>'


def confetti(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    hero = (f'<header class="cf-hero" id="welcome"><div class="cf-sky">{CONFETTI}</div><div class="cf-card">'
            f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="cf-names">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>'
            f'<div class="cf-sticker"><b>{esc(dp["day"])}</b><span>{esc(dp["mon"])}</span></div>'
            f'<p class="cf-when">{esc(ctx["date_text"])}{(" · " + esc(ctx["time_text"])) if ctx["time_text"] else ""}</p>'
            f'{rsvp_cta(ctx, "Count me in")}</div></header>')
    cards = "".join(section(k, html, cls=f"cf-sec cf-tone-{n % 4}") for n, (k, html) in enumerate(secs))
    photo = f'<div class="cf-photo">{hero_image(ctx)}</div>' if ctx["hero"] else ""
    return hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav cf-nav") + photo + f'<div class="cf-board">{cards}</div>'


def pulse(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    tick_items = [ctx["hosts"], ctx["date_text"], ctx["venue"].get("name") or "", "RSVP by " + ctx["deadline_text"]]
    tick = " ✦ ".join(esc(x) for x in tick_items if x)
    hero = (f'<header class="pu-hero" id="welcome"><p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="pu-names">{names_html(ctx, "+")}</h1>'
            f'<div class="pu-date"><b>{esc(dp["dd"])}</b><span>{esc(dp["month"])}<br>{esc(dp["year"])}</span>'
            f'<div class="ev-actions">{rsvp_cta(ctx, "I am in")}</div></div></header>'
            f'<div class="pu-ticker" aria-hidden="true"><div class="pu-ticker__track"><span>{tick} ✦ </span><span>{tick} ✦ </span><span>{tick} ✦ </span></div></div>')
    blocks = "".join(section(k, html, title=TITLES[k], kicker=f"{n:02d}/{len(secs):02d}", cls=f"pu-sec pu-tone-{n % 3}")
                     for n, (k, html) in enumerate(secs, 1))
    photo = f'<div class="pu-photo">{hero_image(ctx)}</div>' if ctx["hero"] else ""
    return hero + photo + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav pu-nav") + blocks


def aurora(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    field = '<div class="au-field" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>'
    chips = "".join(f'<span class="au-chip">{esc(x)}</span>' for x in
                    (f'{dp["weekday"]} {dp["day"]} {dp["month"]} {dp["year"]}'.strip(), ctx["time_text"],
                     ctx["venue"].get("name") or "") if x)
    hero = (f'<header class="au-hero" id="welcome"><div class="au-glass au-hero__card">'
            f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="au-names">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1><div class="au-chips">{chips}</div>'
            f'<div class="ev-actions">{rsvp_cta(ctx, "RSVP")}</div></div></header>')
    wide = {"invitation", "rsvp", "programme", "gallery", "menu", "venue"}
    cards = "".join(section(k, html, cls="au-glass au-card" + (" au-card--wide" if k in wide else "")) for k, html in secs)
    photo = f'<div class="au-glass au-photo">{hero_image(ctx)}</div>' if ctx["hero"] else ""
    return field + hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav au-nav au-glass") + f'<div class="au-bento">{photo}{cards}</div>'


def laureate(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    crest = (f'<div class="la-crest">{CREST}<span class="la-crest__mono">{esc(ctx["monogram"])}</span></div>'
             if not ctx["logo"] else monogram_ring(ctx, "la-logo"))
    hero = (f'<header class="la-hero" id="welcome"><div class="la-frame">{crest}'
            f'<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="la-names">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>'
            f'<p class="la-formal">{esc(ctx["wording"]["invitation"])}</p>'
            f'<p class="la-date">{esc(dp["weekday"])} the {esc(dp["day"])} of {esc(dp["month"])}, {esc(dp["year"])}</p>'
            f'{rsvp_cta(ctx, "Respond")}</div></header>')
    main_keys = {"invitation", "programme", "menu", "rsvp", "gallery", "countdown"}
    main = "".join(section(k, html, cls="la-sec") for k, html in secs if k in main_keys and k != "invitation")
    inv = next((html for k, html in secs if k == "invitation"), "")
    side = "".join(section(k, html, cls="la-sec la-side") for k, html in secs if k not in main_keys)
    photo = f'<div class="la-photo">{hero_image(ctx)}</div>' if ctx["hero"] else ""
    invsec = section("invitation", inv, title="With pleasure", cls="la-sec la-inv") if inv else ""
    return (hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav la-nav") + photo + invsec +
            f'<div class="la-cols"><div class="la-main">{main}</div><aside class="la-aside" aria-label="Details">{side}</aside></div>')


def cradle(ctx) -> str:
    dp = date_parts(ctx)
    secs = collect(ctx)
    hero = (f'<header class="cr-hero cr-page" id="welcome">{MOON}<p class="ev-kicker">{esc(ctx["wording"]["welcome"])}</p>{greeting(ctx)}'
            f'<h1 class="cr-names">{names_html(ctx, "&amp;")}</h1>'
            f'<p class="cr-date">{esc(dp["weekday"])}, {esc(dp["day"])} {esc(dp["month"])} {esc(dp["year"])}</p>'
            f'{("<div class=cr-photo>" + hero_image(ctx) + "</div>") if ctx["hero"] else ""}'
            f'{rsvp_cta(ctx, "Reply")}<span class="cr-pageno">i</span></header>')
    pages = "".join(
        section(k, html, kicker=f"Chapter {n}", cls="cr-page cr-sec").replace(
            "</div></section>", f'</div><span class="cr-pageno">{n}</span>{STAR}</section>', 1)
        for n, (k, html) in enumerate(secs, 1))
    return hero + nav(ctx, secs, "ev-nav cr-nav") + f'<div class="cr-book">{pages}</div>'


LAYOUTS = {
    "atelier": atelier, "folio": folio, "bloom": bloom, "heritage": heritage, "champagne": champagne,
    "linea": linea, "confetti": confetti, "pulse": pulse, "aurora": aurora, "laureate": laureate, "cradle": cradle,
}
```

### `app/eventsite/render.py`

<!-- FILE: app/eventsite/render.py sha256=5d024672fbf74e4fb5d0d7370fe73dca1fdafe5ffb7946ab6825f93300ad76a4 nl=1 -->
```python
"""Turn an event (from the database or a demo dict) into a complete event website.

`render(ev, mode, guest, req, notice)` is the single entry point used by the public site, the
organiser preview and the template gallery. It builds a context of everything the page may show
(respecting section visibility and the package), then hands it to the design's layout function
in designs.py.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing import Optional
from urllib.parse import quote_plus

from .. import catalog, config, db, events
from ..views.forms import fmt_date, fmt_time
from ..web import esc
from . import themes

GROUP_WORDING = {
    "weddings": {"welcome": "We're getting married",
                 "invitation": "Together with their families, {hosts} invite you to share in the joy of their celebration.",
                 "rsvp_note": "Kindly reply by {deadline} so we can plan every detail.",
                 "closing": "We can't wait to celebrate with you."},
    "baby": {"welcome": "A little one is on the way",
             "invitation": "Please join us to celebrate {hosts} and the newest member of the family.",
             "rsvp_note": "Let us know by {deadline} if you can make it.",
             "closing": "With love and gratitude."},
    "parties": {"welcome": "Let's celebrate",
                "invitation": "{hosts} would love you to join the celebration.",
                "rsvp_note": "Reply by {deadline} so we save you a seat.",
                "closing": "See you there."},
    "other": {"welcome": "You're invited",
              "invitation": "{hosts} request the pleasure of your company.",
              "rsvp_note": "Please respond by {deadline}.",
              "closing": "We look forward to welcoming you."},
}

SAST = "+02:00"


def _group(ev) -> str:
    if ev.get("_group"):
        return ev["_group"]
    c = catalog.category(ev.get("category") or "")
    return c["group_slug"] if c else "other"


def design_key(ev) -> str:
    if ev.get("_design"):
        return ev["_design"]
    t = catalog.template(ev.get("template") or "")
    key = t["design"] if t else (ev.get("template") or "atelier")
    return key if key in themes.DESIGNS else "atelier"


def split_names(text: str) -> list[str]:
    for sep in (" & ", " and ", " + "):
        if sep in text:
            a, b = text.split(sep, 1)
            return [a.strip(), b.strip()]
    return [text.strip()]


def maps_link(name: str, address: str, url: str = "") -> str:
    if url:
        return url
    q = ", ".join(x for x in (name, address) if x)
    return "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" + quote_plus(q) if q else ""


def _related(ev) -> dict:
    """Functions, schedule, menus and images, from demo keys or the database."""
    if ev.get("_demo"):
        menus = ev.get("_menus", [])
        meals = [it for m in menus for it in m["items"] if it.get("selectable")]
        return {"functions": ev.get("_functions", []), "schedule": ev.get("_schedule", []), "menus": menus,
                "meals": meals, "hero": ev.get("_hero", ""), "logo": "", "background": "",
                "gallery": ev.get("_gallery", [])}
    eid = ev["id"]
    first = lambda kind: (events.uploads(eid, kind) or [None])[0]  # noqa: E731
    hero, logo, bg = first("hero"), first("logo"), first("background")
    menus = events.menus(eid)
    return {
        "functions": [dict(r) for r in events.functions(eid)],
        "schedule": [dict(r) for r in events.schedule(eid)],
        "menus": menus,
        "meals": [dict(r) for r in events.meal_options(eid)],
        "hero": events.upload_url(hero), "logo": events.upload_url(logo), "background": events.upload_url(bg),
        "gallery": [{"url": events.upload_url(u), "caption": u["caption"]} for u in events.uploads(eid, "gallery")],
    }


def guest_table(ev, guest) -> str:
    if not guest or ev.get("_demo"):
        return ""
    row = db.one("""SELECT t.name FROM seat_assignments a JOIN seating_tables t ON t.id = a.table_id
                    WHERE a.guest_id = ?""", (guest["id"],))
    return row["name"] if row else ""


def rsvp_closed(ev) -> str:
    """Reason RSVPs are closed, or '' when open."""
    if not ev.get("rsvp_open", 1):
        return "RSVPs for this event are closed."
    deadline = (ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("rsvp_deadline")
    if deadline:
        try:
            if date.today() > date.fromisoformat(deadline):
                return f"RSVPs closed on {fmt_date(deadline)}."
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return ""


def allowances(ev, guest=None) -> dict:
    """Plus-ones and children a guest may bring."""
    gs = ev.get("guest_settings") or {}
    policy = gs.get("plus_one_policy", "per_guest")
    default_plus = int(gs.get("plus_ones_default") or 0)
    if policy == "none":
        plus = 0
    elif guest is not None:
        plus = int(guest["plus_ones_allowed"] or 0)
        if policy == "open":
            plus = max(plus, default_plus, 1)
    else:
        plus = max(default_plus, 1) if policy == "open" else default_plus
    kids = 0
    if gs.get("children_allowed"):
        kids = int(gs.get("max_children") or 0)
        if guest is not None and int(guest["children_allowed"] or 0) > 0:
            kids = int(guest["children_allowed"])
    return {"plus_ones": max(0, min(plus, 10)), "children": max(0, min(kids, 10))}


def build_context(ev, mode: str = "public", guest=None, req=None, notice: str = "", form: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
    public = mode != "preview"
    group = _group(ev)
    dkey = design_key(ev)
    design = ev.get("design") or {}
    theme = themes.resolve(dkey, design)
    rel = _related(ev)
    show = events.visible_sections(ev, public=public)
    if mode == "demo":
        show = {k: True for k in show}
    feat = lambda key: mode == "demo" or catalog.has_feature(ev, key, public=public)  # noqa: E731
    gs = ev.get("guest_settings") or {}
    venue = ev.get("venue") or {}
    info = ev.get("info") or {}
    hosts = events.title(ev)
    deadline = fmt_date(gs.get("rsvp_deadline")) if gs.get("rsvp_deadline") else "the date on your invitation"
    defaults = GROUP_WORDING.get(group, GROUP_WORDING["other"])
    raw_w = design.get("wording") or {}
    wording = {}
    for k, v in defaults.items():
        text = (raw_w.get(k) or "").strip() or v
        wording[k] = text.replace("{hosts}", hosts).replace("{deadline}", deadline)
    d = None
    if ev.get("event_date"):
        try:
            d = date.fromisoformat(ev["event_date"])
        except ValueError:
            d = None
    start = ev.get("start_time") or "12:00"
    countdown_iso = f"{d.isoformat()}T{start}:00{SAST}" if d else ""
    functions = rel["functions"]
    meals = rel["meals"] if (show.get("menu") or mode == "demo") and feat("menu") else []
    ctx = {
        "ev": ev, "mode": mode, "guest": guest, "req": req, "notice": notice, "form": form or {},
        "design": dkey, "theme": theme, "group": group, "show": show, "feat": feat,
        "hosts": hosts, "names": split_names(hosts), "title": ev.get("name") or hosts,
        "description": ev.get("description") or "",
        "date": d, "date_text": fmt_date(ev.get("event_date")) if d else "Date to be announced",
        "time_text": " – ".join(x for x in (fmt_time(ev.get("start_time")), fmt_time(ev.get("end_time"))) if x),
        "countdown_iso": countdown_iso, "venue": venue, "info": info, "gs": gs,
        "map_url": maps_link(venue.get("name", ""), venue.get("address", ""), venue.get("map_url", "")),
        "functions": functions, "schedule": rel["schedule"], "menus": rel["menus"], "meals": meals,
        "hero": rel["hero"], "logo": rel["logo"], "background": rel["background"], "gallery": rel["gallery"],
        "monogram": (design.get("monogram") or "").strip() or "".join(n[:1] for n in split_names(hosts) if n)[:3].upper(),
        "wording": wording, "deadline_text": deadline,
        "table": guest_table(ev, guest) if guest else ("Table 4 · Jacaranda" if mode == "demo" else ""),
        "closed": "" if mode == "demo" else rsvp_closed(ev),
        "allow": allowances(ev, guest),
        "csrf": getattr(req, "csrf", "") if req is not None else "",
        "thanks": bool(req is not None and req.arg("rsvp") == "thanks"),
        "path": f"/events/{ev.get('slug', '')}",
    }
    ctx["guest_functions"] = {}
    if guest is not None and not ev.get("_demo"):
        ctx["guest_functions"] = {r["function_id"]: r["attending"] for r in
                                  db.q("SELECT * FROM guest_functions WHERE guest_id = ?", (guest["id"],))}
    return ctx


def render(ev: dict, mode: str = "public", guest=None, req=None, notice: str = "", form: Optional[dict] = None) -> str:
    from . import designs
    ctx = build_context(ev, mode, guest, req, notice, form)
    body = designs.LAYOUTS.get(ctx["design"], designs.LAYOUTS["atelier"])(ctx)
    return document(ctx, body)


# --- colour contrast (keeps buttons and accent text at WCAG AA whatever palette is chosen) ----
def _rgb(h: str) -> tuple:
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))


def _hex(rgb) -> str:
    return "#" + "".join(f"{max(0, min(255, round(c))):02X}" for c in rgb)


def luminance(h: str) -> float:
    def ch(c):
        c = c / 255
        return c / 12.92 if c <= 0.03928 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
    r, g, b = _rgb(h)
    return 0.2126 * ch(r) + 0.7152 * ch(g) + 0.0722 * ch(b)


def contrast(a: str, b: str) -> float:
    la, lb = sorted((luminance(a), luminance(b)), reverse=True)
    return (la + 0.05) / (lb + 0.05)


def mix(a: str, b: str, t: float) -> str:
    ra, rb = _rgb(a), _rgb(b)
    return _hex([ra[i] + (rb[i] - ra[i]) * t for i in range(3)])


def ink(color: str, against: str, target: float = 4.5) -> str:
    """Shift `color` toward black or white until it reaches `target` contrast with `against`."""
    toward = "#000000" if luminance(against) > 0.25 else "#FFFFFF"
    t = 0.0
    out = color
    while contrast(out, against) < target and t < 1:
        t += 0.05
        out = mix(color, toward, t)
    return out


def contrast_vars(c: dict) -> str:
    try:
        dark = luminance(c["bg"]) < 0.2
        if dark:
            btn = c["accent"]
            btn_text = c["bg"] if contrast(btn, c["bg"]) >= 4.5 else "#111111"
        else:
            btn = ink(c["accent"], "#FFFFFF")
            btn_text = "#FFFFFF"
        acc_ink = ink(c["accent"], c["bg"])
        acc_ink_s = ink(c["accent"], c["surface"])
        muted = ink(c["muted"], c["bg"])
        return (f"--ev-btn:{btn};--ev-btn-text:{btn_text};--ev-ink:{acc_ink};--ev-ink-s:{acc_ink_s};"
                f"--ev-muted:{muted};")
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return ""


WATERMARK = ("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='520' height='300'>"
             "<text x='260' y='160' text-anchor='middle' transform='rotate(-24 260 150)' font-family='Arial,sans-serif' "
             "font-size='24' font-weight='700' letter-spacing='3' fill='rgb(128,128,128)' fill-opacity='.26'>"
             "PREVIEW · NOT PUBLISHED</text></svg>")


def banner(ctx) -> str:
    if ctx["mode"] == "preview":
        ev = ctx["ev"]
        if not ev.get("paid_package"):
            # Unpaid: an unmissable strip and a watermark over the whole page (on screen and in print),
            # so a draft can't stand in for the real invitation.
            from .. import auth
            req = ctx.get("req")
            owner = bool(req and getattr(req, "user", None)) and auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev)
            pay = (f' <a class="ev-banner__btn" href="/dashboard/events/{esc(ev["uid"])}/setup/8" target="_top">Pay to publish</a>'
                   if owner else "")
            if owner:
                extra = ctx["notice"] + ". " if ctx["notice"].startswith("Personal link") else ""
                text = extra + "Only you can see this. Guests can open it once you pay and publish."
            else:
                text = (ctx["notice"] + ". " if ctx["notice"] else "") + "Guests can't reply until this website is paid for and published."
            return (f'<div class="ev-banner ev-banner--draft" role="note"><b>Preview only: not published.</b> '
                    f'<span>{esc(text)}</span>{pay}</div>'
                    f'<div class="ev-watermark" aria-hidden="true" style="background-image:url(&quot;{WATERMARK}&quot;)"></div>')
        status = "Draft" if ev.get("status") == "draft" else events.STATUS_LABELS.get(ev.get("status"), "")
        return (f'<div class="ev-banner" role="note">Preview · {esc(status)} · not visible to guests'
                f'{(" · " + esc(ctx["notice"])) if ctx["notice"] else ""}</div>')
    if ctx["mode"] == "demo":
        return '<div class="ev-ribbon" role="note">Sample content</div>'
    if ctx["notice"]:
        return f'<div class="ev-banner ev-banner--notice" role="status">{esc(ctx["notice"])}</div>'
    return ""


def document(ctx, body: str) -> str:
    t = ctx["theme"]
    ev = ctx["ev"]
    title = f"{ctx['title']} · {ctx['date_text']}" if ctx["date"] else ctx["title"]
    desc = (ctx["wording"]["invitation"] or "")[:180]
    robots = '<meta name="robots" content="noindex">'  # event pages are private by default
    bg_img = ctx["background"] or (ctx["hero"] if t["background"] == "image" else "")
    style = themes.css_vars(t) + contrast_vars(t["colors"]) + (f"--ev-bg-image:url('{esc(bg_img)}');" if bg_img else "")
    classes = f"ev d-{ctx['design']} bg-{t['background']} grp-{ctx['group']}" + (" has-hero" if ctx["hero"] else "")
    return f"""<!doctype html><html lang="en-ZA"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>{esc(title)}</title>
<meta name="description" content="{esc(desc)}">{robots}
<meta property="og:title" content="{esc(title)}"><meta property="og:description" content="{esc(desc)}">
<meta name="theme-color" content="{esc(t['colors']['bg'])}">
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{esc(themes.fonts_url(t['display'], t['body']))}">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/eventsite.css">
</head><body class="{classes}" style="{style}">
<a class="ev-skip" href="#ev-main">Skip to content</a>{banner(ctx)}
<main id="ev-main">{body}</main>
<footer class="ev-foot"><p>{esc(ctx['wording']['closing'])}</p>
<p class="ev-made"><a href="/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Made with {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)}</a></p></footer>
<script src="/static/js/eventsite.js" defer></script></body></html>"""
```

### `app/eventsite/themes.py`

<!-- FILE: app/eventsite/themes.py sha256=81cca69e08d0f9530c9f4bf08d1ce17124084411ea32a875df081ec7809d64f6 nl=1 -->
```python
"""Palettes, font pairings and background options for each event-website design.

Shared by the wizard (design step) and the renderer. A customer's choices are stored in
events.design as {palette, font_pair, background, colors{...}}; `resolve()` merges them with
the design defaults into CSS variables.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional
from urllib.parse import quote_plus

FONTS = {
    # family: google axis spec
    "Cormorant Garamond": "ital,wght@0,300..700;1,300..700",
    "Jost": "wght@300..600",
    "Bodoni Moda": "ital,opsz,wght@0,6..96,400..800;1,6..96,400..800",
    "Inter": "wght@300..700",
    "Pinyon Script": "",
    "Cinzel": "wght@400..800",
    "Marcellus": "",
    "Italiana": "",
    "Montserrat": "wght@300..700",
    "Outfit": "wght@200..700",
    "Fredoka": "wght@400..700",
    "Nunito": "wght@400..800",
    "Syne": "wght@500..800",
    "Space Grotesk": "wght@400..700",
    "EB Garamond": "ital,wght@0,400..700;1,400..700",

BACKGROUND_LABELS = {
    "plain": "Plain colour", "paper": "Soft paper texture", "pattern": "Signature pattern",
    "image": "Your photo behind the welcome", "aurora": "Aurora light field",
}


def design(key: str) -> dict:
    return DESIGNS.get(key) or DESIGNS["atelier"]


def palettes(key: str) -> list:
    return design(key)["palettes"]


def resolve(design_key: str, choices: Optional[dict]) -> dict:
    """Merge saved choices with design defaults → {colors, font_pair, display, body, background}."""
    d = design(design_key)
    choices = choices or {}
    pal_key = choices.get("palette") or d["palettes"][0][0]
    base = next((p[2] for p in d["palettes"] if p[0] == pal_key), d["palettes"][0][2])
    colors = dict(base)
    for k, v in (choices.get("colors") or {}).items():
        if k in colors and isinstance(v, str) and len(v) == 7 and v.startswith("#"):
            colors[k] = v
    fp = choices.get("font_pair") if choices.get("font_pair") in FONT_PAIRS else d["font_pair"]
    bg = choices.get("background") if choices.get("background") in BACKGROUND_LABELS else d["background"]
    _, display, body = FONT_PAIRS[fp]
    return {"palette": pal_key, "colors": colors, "font_pair": fp, "display": display, "body": body, "background": bg}


def fonts_url(*families: str) -> str:
    parts = []
    for fam in dict.fromkeys(families):
        spec = FONTS.get(fam, "")
        parts.append("family=" + quote_plus(fam) + (":" + spec if spec else ""))
    return "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?" + "&".join(parts) + "&display=swap"


def css_vars(resolved: dict) -> str:
    c = resolved["colors"]
    return (f"--ev-bg:{c['bg']};--ev-surface:{c['surface']};--ev-text:{c['text']};--ev-muted:{c['muted']};"
            f"--ev-accent:{c['accent']};--ev-accent2:{c['accent2']};"
            f"--ev-display:'{resolved['display']}',Georgia,serif;--ev-body:'{resolved['body']}',system-ui,sans-serif;")
```

```python
def svg(name: str, stroke: str = "currentColor", size: int = 20, width: float = 1.6) -> str:
    body = ICONS.get(name, ICONS["info"])
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{size}" height="{size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" '
            f'stroke="{stroke}" stroke-width="{width}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">{body}</svg>')


def write_css() -> None:
    lines = ["/* Generated by app/icons.py. Do not edit by hand. */"]
    for name in ICONS:
        data = quote(svg(name, stroke="#000").replace('"', "'"), safe=" =:/'-.,()")
        lines.append(f'.i--{name} {{ --icon: url("data:image/svg+xml,{data}"); }}')
    (config.STATIC_DIR / "css" / "icons.css").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def i(name: str, extra: str = "") -> str:
    """HTML for a mask icon."""
    return f'<i class="i i--{name}{(" " + extra) if extra else ""}" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
```

### `app/migrations/001_init.sql`

```sql
-- Aurelia core schema. Money is stored in cents (ZAR). Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC text.
-- JSON columns hold flexible per-event settings; relational data (guests, tables, menus,
-- orders, payments, emails) lives in proper tables with foreign keys.

CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'customer' CHECK (role IN ('customer','admin')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','suspended')),
  email_verified_at TEXT,
  marketing_consent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_demo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_login_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                      -- sha256 of the cookie token
  user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  csrf TEXT NOT NULL,
  data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  ip TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_user ON sessions(user_id);

CREATE TABLE user_tokens (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('verify','reset')),
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  used_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  group_slug TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- weddings | baby | parties | other
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  features TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',      -- JSON list of hints (e.g. "family_sides", "multi_function")
  sort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);

CREATE TABLE templates (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  design TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- renderer key in app/eventsite/designs.py
  direction TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- design direction label
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  groups TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',        -- JSON list of category group slugs
  tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  sort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  updated_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE packages (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                -- essential | premium | signature
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  tagline TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_cents >= 0),
  features TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',      -- JSON list of feature keys (gates functionality)
  bullets TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',       -- JSON list of display lines
  limits TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',        -- JSON {email_sends, hosting_months, functions, admins, gallery_photos}
  rank INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- upgrade order
  highlight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  updated_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  uid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                 -- private identifier used in dashboard URLs
  owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,                -- public URL /events/<slug>
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
    CHECK (status IN ('draft','published','unpublished','suspended','archived')),
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  template TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  hosts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  event_date TEXT,                          -- YYYY-MM-DD
  start_time TEXT,                          -- HH:MM
  end_time TEXT,
  venue TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',         -- JSON {name,address,map_url,parking,directions,accommodation}
  design TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',        -- JSON {palette,colors,fonts,background,images,wording,monogram,logo}
  guest_settings TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',-- JSON {estimated,categories,family_groups,vip_note,children_allowed,...}
  info TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',          -- JSON {dress_code,registry,gifts,contacts,accommodation,instructions,catering_notes,drinks,dietary_options,seating_notes}
  sections TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',      -- JSON visibility map
  report_prefs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON {summary: none|daily|weekly, new_rsvp: bool, auto_reminders: bool}
  selected_package TEXT,                    -- chosen in step 10, before payment
  paid_package TEXT,                        -- set only by a verified payment
  hosting_until TEXT,
  wizard_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  wizard_done TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',   -- JSON list of completed step numbers
  rsvp_open INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  suspended_reason TEXT,
  is_demo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  published_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_owner ON events(owner_id);

CREATE TABLE event_admins (
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'editor',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (event_id, user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE event_functions (               -- ceremonies / receptions / multi-day parts
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  func_date TEXT,
  start_time TEXT,
  end_time TEXT,
  venue_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  address TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  map_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  dress_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  sort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX idx_functions_event ON event_functions(event_id);

CREATE TABLE schedule_items (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  function_id INTEGER REFERENCES event_functions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  item_time TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other',      -- ceremony | reception | speech | entertainment | activity | other
  sort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX idx_schedule_event ON schedule_items(event_id);

CREATE TABLE menus (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  sort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE menu_items (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  menu_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES menus(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  course TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Main',
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',          -- JSON: vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free...
  selectable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- 1 = guests choose this as their meal
  sort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_items_event ON menu_items(event_id);

CREATE TABLE guests (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,               -- personal invitation link token
  first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COLLATE NOCASE,
  phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',        -- e.g. Family, Friends, Colleagues
  family_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',    -- e.g. "Mokoena family"
  side TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',            -- e.g. Bride's family / Groom's family
  is_vip INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_child INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  plus_ones_allowed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  children_allowed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','attending','declined')),
  plus_ones INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  plus_one_names TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  children INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  meal_item_id INTEGER REFERENCES menu_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  dietary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  allergies TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  special_requests TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- organiser-only
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'organiser', -- organiser | import | general_link
  email_consent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  unsubscribed_at TEXT,
  invited_at TEXT,
  responded_at TEXT,
  checked_in_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_guests_event ON guests(event_id, status);

CREATE TABLE guest_functions (               -- per-function attendance for multi-function events
  guest_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  function_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES event_functions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  attending INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (guest_id, function_id)
);

CREATE TABLE rsvp_responses (                -- history of every RSVP submission
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  guest_id INTEGER REFERENCES guests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  via TEXT NOT NULL,                        -- personal | general
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_rsvp_event ON rsvp_responses(event_id, created_at);

CREATE TABLE seating_tables (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  capacity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK (capacity > 0),
  shape TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'round',      -- round | long
  pos_x REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,            -- percent of the floor plan
  pos_y REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  sort INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX idx_tables_event ON seating_tables(event_id);

CREATE TABLE seat_assignments (
  guest_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES guests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  table_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES seating_tables(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  assigned_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_seats_table ON seat_assignments(table_id);

CREATE TABLE uploads (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id INTEGER REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- hero | gallery | logo | background
  storage_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,         -- path relative to the storage root
  mime TEXT NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX idx_uploads_event ON uploads(event_id, kind);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

  description TEXT NOT NULL,

  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ZAR',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (status IN ('pending','paid','failed','cancelled','refunded')),
  gateway TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- sandbox | live
  gateway_ref TEXT,
  invoice_no TEXT UNIQUE,

CREATE TABLE payments (                      -- every verified gateway notification

CREATE TABLE email_templates (

  key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

CREATE TABLE email_logs (

  event_id INTEGER REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

);

CREATE TABLE report_runs (                   -- log of generated reports
```

### `app/migrations/002_login_links.sql`

<!-- FILE: app/migrations/002_login_links.sql sha256=8996008a06a10a146a722449f970e31475e0cbb1e65aad5739425d14096b6098 nl=1 -->
```sql
-- Sign-in links by email (no password needed): allow a third token kind, 'login'.
-- SQLite can't change a CHECK constraint in place, so the table is rebuilt.
CREATE TABLE user_tokens_new (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('verify','reset','login')),
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  used_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
INSERT INTO user_tokens_new (id, user_id, kind, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at)
  SELECT id, user_id, kind, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at FROM user_tokens;
DROP TABLE user_tokens;
ALTER TABLE user_tokens_new RENAME TO user_tokens;
```

### `app/migrations/003_floor_pixels.sql`

<!-- FILE: app/migrations/003_floor_pixels.sql sha256=d420ada08971c43de9ad9e6c628bc2acbc0b5ba83eaddb0f33b1d3b26c7ef584 nl=1 -->
```sql
-- Seating floor plan: pos_y becomes the table card's top edge in pixels from the top of the floor
-- (pos_x stays the card's centre as a percent of the floor's width). The editor now grows the floor to
-- fit every table, so rows of tables are never cut off. Earlier percent values convert against the
-- editor's 640px starting height.
UPDATE seating_tables SET pos_y = ROUND(pos_y * 6.4);
```

### `app/notify.py`

<!-- FILE: app/notify.py sha256=c33c8f74469890286cbdfe8a4136383661d455b5d1964b6793277a0e917c606a nl=1 -->
```python
"""Common email variables and organiser/guest notification helpers."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from . import catalog, config, db, events
from .services import email as mail
from .views.forms import fmt_date, fmt_time
from .web import esc


def event_vars(ev) -> dict:
    base = f"{config.BASE_URL}/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}"
    venue = ev.get("venue") or {}
    gs = ev.get("guest_settings") or {}
    days = None
    try:
        from .views.forms import days_until
        days = days_until(ev.get("event_date"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    if days is None:
        days_text = "date to be confirmed"
    elif days > 1:
        days_text = f"{days} days to go"
    elif days == 1:
        days_text = "tomorrow"
    elif days == 0:
        days_text = "today"
    else:
        days_text = "the event has passed"
    return {
        "event_name": ev["name"], "hosts": events.title(ev),
        "event_date": fmt_date(ev.get("event_date")) or "date to be confirmed",
        "start_time": fmt_time(ev.get("start_time")) or "time to be confirmed",
        "venue_name": venue.get("name", ""), "venue_address": venue.get("address", ""),
        "public_url": events.public_url(ev), "dashboard_url": base, "rsvp_url": base + "/rsvps",
        "share_url": base + "/share", "reports_url": base + "/reports", "seating_url": base + "/seating",
        "comms_url": base + "/communications", "remind_url": base + "/communications?template=guest_reminder",
        "deadline": fmt_date(gs.get("rsvp_deadline")) or "the date on the invitation",
        "hosting_until": fmt_date(ev.get("hosting_until")) or "the end of your hosting period",
        "days_to_go": days_text,
    }


def guest_vars(ev, g) -> dict:
    return {"guest_first": g["first_name"], "guest_name": events.guest_name(g),
            "invite_url": events.invite_url(ev, g),
            "unsubscribe_url": f"{config.BASE_URL}/events/{ev['slug']}/u/{g['token']}"}


def can_email_guest(g) -> bool:
    return bool(g["email"]) and bool(g["email_consent"]) and not g["unsubscribed_at"]


def organiser_recipients(ev) -> list:
    owner = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (ev["owner_id"],))
    out = [owner] if owner else []
    if catalog.has_feature(ev, "co_admins"):
        out += list(db.q("""SELECT u.* FROM event_admins a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id
                            WHERE a.event_id = ?""", (ev["id"],)))
    return out


def organiser(ev, key: str, extra: Optional[dict] = None, attachments: Optional[list] = None,
              owner_only: bool = False) -> list:
    results = []
    recipients = organiser_recipients(ev)
    if owner_only:
        recipients = recipients[:1]
    for user in recipients:
        v = {**event_vars(ev), "first_name": mail.first_name(user["name"]), **(extra or {})}
        results.append(mail.send(user["email"], key, v, event_id=ev["id"], user_id=user["id"],
                                 attachments=attachments))
    return results


def summary_table_html(stats: dict) -> str:
    rows = [("Invited", stats["invited"]), ("Attending", stats["attending"]), ("Declined", stats["declined"]),
            ("Still to reply", stats["pending"]), ("Plus-ones", stats["plus_ones"]), ("Children", stats["children"]),
            ("Total headcount", stats["headcount"])]
    cells = "".join(
        f"<tr><td style='padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEE;color:#6A6152'>{esc(k)}</td>"
        f"<td style='padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #EEE;text-align:right;font-weight:600'>{v}</td></tr>"
        for k, v in rows)
    return f"<table role='presentation' width='100%' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='margin:0 0 18px'>{cells}</table>"


def steps_html(steps) -> str:
    """Numbered (title, why, url, link text) steps for the "Next steps" email."""
    rows = "".join(
        f"<tr><td style='padding:0 14px 18px 0;vertical-align:top;font-weight:600;color:#87651C'>{n}</td>"
        f"<td style='padding:0 0 18px;vertical-align:top'><b>{esc(t)}</b><br><span style='color:#6A6152'>{esc(w)}</span><br>"
        f"<a href='{esc(url)}' style='color:#87651C;font-weight:600'>{esc(link)}</a></td></tr>"
        for n, (t, w, url, link) in enumerate(steps, 1))
    return f"<table role='presentation' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='margin:0 0 18px'>{rows}</table>"


def rsvp_details_html(ev, g) -> str:
    parts = []
    if g["status"] == "attending":
        if g["plus_ones"]:
            parts.append(("Plus-ones", f"{g['plus_ones']} {('(' + g['plus_one_names'] + ')') if g['plus_one_names'] else ''}"))
        if g["children"]:
            parts.append(("Children", g["children"]))
        if g["meal_item_id"]:
            meal = db.one("SELECT name FROM menu_items WHERE id = ?", (g["meal_item_id"],))
            if meal:
                parts.append(("Meal", meal["name"]))
        if g["dietary"]:
            parts.append(("Dietary", g["dietary"]))
        if g["allergies"]:
            parts.append(("Allergies", g["allergies"]))
    if g["special_requests"]:
        parts.append(("Note", g["special_requests"]))
    if not parts:
        return ""
    cells = "".join(f"<tr><td style='padding:6px 12px 6px 0;color:#6A6152'>{esc(k)}</td><td style='padding:6px 0'>{esc(v)}</td></tr>"
                    for k, v in parts)
    return f"<table role='presentation' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='margin:0 0 18px'>{cells}</table>"


def publish(ev, actor_id: Optional[int] = None, send_emails: bool = True) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Make the event website public. Requires a verified payment and an unsuspended event."""
    ev = events.by_id(ev["id"])
    if not ev["paid_package"]:
        return False, "Publishing needs a confirmed payment."
    if ev["status"] == "suspended":
        return False, "This event is suspended. Contact support."
    first_time = not ev["published_at"]
    fields = {"status": "published"}
    if first_time:
        fields["published_at"] = db.now()
    if not ev["hosting_until"]:
        months = catalog.limit(ev, "hosting_months", 6)
        fields["hosting_until"] = events.hosting_end(ev, months)
    events.touch(ev["id"], **fields)
    db.insert("audit_log", {"actor_id": actor_id, "action": "event.publish", "target": ev["uid"], "meta": "{}",
                            "created_at": db.now()})
    if send_emails and first_time:
        ev = events.by_id(ev["id"])
        organiser(ev, "website_published", owner_only=True)    # next steps follow the next day, only if any are left
    return True, "Your event website is live."


def unpublish(ev, actor_id: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
    events.touch(ev["id"], status="unpublished")
    db.insert("audit_log", {"actor_id": actor_id, "action": "event.unpublish", "target": ev["uid"], "meta": "{}",
                            "created_at": db.now()})
```

```python
"""Demo data for development and demos. Every row is flagged is_demo = 1 and every email ends in
@demo.aurelia.example, so it is easy to tell apart from customer data and to remove.

    python3 run.py --seed-only

Demo logins (development only, never use in production):
    admin@demo.aurelia.example     / Demo-Admin-2026
    thandi@demo.aurelia.example    / Demo-Host-2026

Payments for the demo events go through the real sandbox checkout verification path, so they are
recorded as mode='sandbox' orders and never count as revenue.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import random
from datetime import date, timedelta

from . import auth, catalog, db, events
from .services import payments

DEMO_DOMAIN = "demo.aurelia.example"
ADMIN = ("admin@" + DEMO_DOMAIN, "Demo-Admin-2026", "Ayesha Patel (demo admin)")
HOST = ("thandi@" + DEMO_DOMAIN, "Demo-Host-2026", "Thandi Mokoena")

FIRST = ["Lerato", "Sipho", "Thabo", "Naledi", "Ayanda", "Kabelo", "Zanele", "Bongani", "Palesesa", "Mandla", "Nomvula", "Tshepo",
         "Lindiwe", "Sibusiso", "Refilwe", "Themba", "Karabo", "Nandi", "Lwazi", "Dineo", "Johan", "Annelie", "Pieter", "Marike",
         "Ravi", "Priya", "Yusuf", "Fatima", "Michael", "Sarah", "David", "Megan", "Kagiso", "Busisiwe", "Musa", "Ntombi",
         "Andile", "Keabetswe", "Tumelo", "Amahle", "Sizwe", "Hlengiwe", "Mpho", "Onthatile", "Riaan", "Chantel", "Imran", "Zainab"]
LAST = ["Mokoena", "Dlamini", "Nkosi", "Khumalo", "Mahlangu", "Ndlovu", "Botha", "van der Merwe", "Naidoo", "Pillay", "Jacobs",
        "Mthembu", "Zulu", "Molefe", "Sithole", "Maseko", "Smith", "Petersen", "Cele", "Mabaso", "Venter", "Govender", "Adams", "Radebe"]


def _reset() -> None:
    db.run("DELETE FROM orders WHERE event_id IN (SELECT id FROM events WHERE is_demo = 1)")
    db.run("DELETE FROM events WHERE is_demo = 1")
    db.run("DELETE FROM users WHERE is_demo = 1")


def _user(email, pw, name, role="customer"):
    uid = db.insert("users", {"email": email, "name": name, "password_hash": auth.hash_password(pw), "role": role,
                              "email_verified_at": db.now(), "is_demo": 1, "created_at": db.now()})
    return db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (uid,))


def _pay(ev, user, code):
    """Pay through the sandbox gateway's signed-notification path (sandbox mode, never revenue)."""
    order = payments.create_order(events.by_id(ev["id"]), user, code)
    gw = payments.SandboxGateway()
    body, sig = gw.build_notification(order, "approve")
    gw_name = "sandbox"
    db.run("UPDATE orders SET gateway = 'sandbox', mode = 'sandbox' WHERE id = ?", (order["id"],))
    payments.apply(gw.verify(body, sig), gw_name)


def _guests(ev, rng, n, sides=None, groups=None, cats=("Family", "Friends", "Colleagues")):
    meals = [m["id"] for m in events.meal_options(ev["id"])]
    diets = ["", "", "", "", "Vegetarian", "Halal", "Gluten-free", "Vegan", "No pork"]
    out = []
    now = db.now()
    for k in range(n):
        first, last = rng.choice(FIRST), rng.choice(LAST)
        r = rng.random()
        status = "attending" if r < 0.66 else "declined" if r < 0.8 else "pending"
        plus_allowed = 1 if rng.random() < 0.45 else 0
        kids_allowed = rng.choice([0, 0, 0, 1, 2])
        g = {"event_id": ev["id"], "token": events.new_guest_token(), "first_name": first, "last_name": last,
             "email": f"{first.lower()}.{last.lower().replace(' ', '')}{k}@{DEMO_DOMAIN}",
             "phone": f"+27 8{rng.randint(1, 4)} {rng.randint(100, 999)} {rng.randint(1000, 9999)}",
             "category": rng.choice(cats), "family_group": rng.choice(groups) if groups and rng.random() < .6 else "",
             "side": rng.choice(sides) if sides else "", "is_vip": 1 if rng.random() < .06 else 0,
             "plus_ones_allowed": plus_allowed, "children_allowed": kids_allowed, "status": status,
             "plus_ones": (1 if plus_allowed and rng.random() < .7 else 0) if status == "attending" else 0,
             "children": (rng.randint(0, kids_allowed) if kids_allowed else 0) if status == "attending" else 0,
             "meal_item_id": rng.choice(meals) if meals and status == "attending" else None,
             "dietary": rng.choice(diets) if status == "attending" else "",
             "allergies": "Peanuts" if status == "attending" and rng.random() < .04 else "",
             "special_requests": "Wheelchair access please" if status == "attending" and rng.random() < .03 else "",
             "source": "import", "email_consent": 1, "invited_at": now,
             "responded_at": now if status != "pending" else None, "created_at": now, "updated_at": now}
        g["plus_one_names"] = rng.choice(FIRST) + " " + last if g["plus_ones"] else ""
        gid = db.insert("guests", g)
        if status != "pending":
            db.insert("rsvp_responses", {"event_id": ev["id"], "guest_id": gid, "via": "personal", "created_at": now,
                                         "payload": db.dumps({"status": status, "plus_ones": g["plus_ones"], "children": g["children"]})})
        out.append((gid, g))
    return out


def _seat(ev, guests, leave_unseated=6):
    tables = events.tables(ev["id"])
    attending = [(gid, g) for gid, g in guests if g["status"] == "attending"]
    attending = attending[:max(0, len(attending) - leave_unseated)]
    t = 0
    load = {tb["id"]: 0 for tb in tables}
    for gid, g in attending:
        size = 1 + g["plus_ones"] + g["children"]
        tries = 0
        while load[tables[t]["id"]] + size > tables[t]["capacity"] and tries < len(tables):
            t = (t + 1) % len(tables)
            tries += 1
        if tries >= len(tables):
            break
        db.insert("seat_assignments", {"guest_id": gid, "table_id": tables[t]["id"], "event_id": ev["id"], "assigned_at": db.now()})
        load[tables[t]["id"]] += size


def _tables(ev, names, cap=10, shape="round"):
    for n, (name, (x, y)) in enumerate(zip(names, events.floor_slots(ev["id"], len(names)))):
        db.insert("seating_tables", {"event_id": ev["id"], "name": name, "capacity": cap, "shape": shape,
                                     "pos_x": x, "pos_y": y, "sort": n})


def _menu(ev, name, items):
    mid = db.insert("menus", {"event_id": ev["id"], "name": name, "sort": 0})
    for n, (course, dish, desc, tags, sel) in enumerate(items):
        db.insert("menu_items", {"menu_id": mid, "event_id": ev["id"], "course": course, "name": dish, "description": desc,
                                 "tags": db.dumps(tags), "selectable": 1 if sel else 0, "sort": n})


def run() -> None:
    rng = random.Random(2026)
    _reset()
    _user(*ADMIN, role="admin")
    host = _user(*HOST)

                     "welcome": "Together with their families", "invitation": "Lerato and Sipho request the pleasure of your company as they celebrate their marriage.",
                     "rsvp_note": "Kindly reply by the date below.", "closing": "We can't wait to celebrate with you."}}),
                 guest_settings=db.dumps({"estimated": 150, "categories": ["Family", "Friends", "Colleagues"], "family_groups": ["Dube family", "Nkosi family"],
                                          "children_allowed": True, "max_children": 2, "plus_one_policy": "per_guest", "plus_ones_default": 0,
                                          "rsvp_deadline": (d - timedelta(days=45)).isoformat()}),
                 info=db.dumps({"dress_code": "Black tie", "dress_code_notes": "Shades of emerald, black and gold.",
                                "registry": [{"name": "Honeymoon fund", "url": "https://example.com/registry", "note": "Zanzibar, here we come"}],
                                "gift_note": "Your presence is our present.", "contacts": [{"name": "Zanele Dube", "role": "Maid of honour", "phone": "+27 82 000 0101", "email": ""}],
                                "accommodation": [{"name": "Oakridge Guest Lodge (demo)", "url": "https://example.com/lodge", "note": "Quote DUBE-NKOSI for 10% off"}],
                                "dietary_options": ["Vegetarian", "Vegan", "Halal", "Gluten-free", "Nut allergy"], "drinks": "Welcome bubbles, open bar until 23:00."}),
                 wizard_step=8, wizard_done=db.dumps(list(range(1, 8))))
    f1 = db.insert("event_functions", {"event_id": ev["id"], "name": "Ceremony", "func_date": d.isoformat(), "start_time": "14:00", "end_time": "15:00",

    for n, (t, title, kind, fid) in enumerate([("13:30", "Guests arrive", "other", f1), ("14:00", "Ceremony", "ceremony", f1),

    _menu(ev, "Reception menu", [("Starter", "Butternut and coconut soup", "Toasted pumpkin seeds", ["Vegan"], False),

    g2 = _guests(events.by_id(ev2["id"]), rng, 90, sides=["Mahlangu family", "Khumalo family"], groups=["Mahlangu delegation", "Khumalo delegation"],
                 cats=("Family", "Friends", "Church", "Elders"))
    for gid, _ in g2[:60]:

            db.insert("guest_functions", {"guest_id": gid, "function_id": fid, "attending": 1})
    _seat(ev2, g2, leave_unseated=10)

    # 3. Baby shower, unpaid draft -------------------------------------------------------------------
    ev3 = events.create(host["id"], "baby-shower", "bloom", "Amahle's baby shower", "Amahle", is_demo=True)
    events.touch(ev3["id"], event_date=(today + timedelta(days=40)).isoformat(), start_time="11:00", end_time="15:00",
                 venue=db.dumps({"name": "Rosebank garden café (demo)", "address": "Rosebank, Johannesburg"}),
                 design=db.dumps({"palette": "blush"}), selected_package="essential", wizard_step=3, wizard_done=db.dumps([1, 2]))

    # 4. A second customer with a party, and a support request --------------------------------------

    ev4 = events.create(other["id"], "birthday", "pulse", "Kagiso turns 40", "Kagiso's 40th", is_demo=True)
    events.touch(ev4["id"], event_date=(today + timedelta(days=25)).isoformat(), start_time="19:00",
                 venue=db.dumps({"name": "Rooftop at 44 Stanley (demo)", "address": "44 Stanley Avenue, Milpark, Johannesburg"}),
                 info=db.dumps({"dress_code": "Cocktail"}), guest_settings=db.dumps({"rsvp_deadline": (today + timedelta(days=15)).isoformat(),
                                                                                    "plus_one_policy": "open", "plus_ones_default": 1}),
                 wizard_step=8, wizard_done=db.dumps(list(range(1, 8))))
    _pay(ev4, other, "essential")
    _guests(events.by_id(ev4["id"]), rng, 40, cats=("Friends", "Colleagues"))
    db.insert("support_requests", {"user_id": other["id"], "event_id": ev4["id"], "name": other["name"], "email": other["email"], "topic": "event",
                                   "message": "Can I change the date of my party after publishing? (demo request)", "created_at": db.now(), "updated_at": db.now()})
    db.run("UPDATE events SET is_demo = 1 WHERE owner_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE is_demo = 1)")
    # demo emails sent while seeding would clutter the outbox log: mark them clearly
    db.run("UPDATE email_logs SET status = 'skipped', error = 'Demo seed: not delivered' WHERE to_email LIKE ?", (f"%@{DEMO_DOMAIN}",))
    print(f"Demo data loaded: {db.val('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE is_demo = 1')} events, "
          f"{db.val('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guests g JOIN events e ON e.id = g.event_id WHERE e.is_demo = 1')} guests.")
    print(f"Demo host login: {HOST[0]}   Demo admin login: {ADMIN[0]}   (passwords are in app/seed.py)")
```

```python
Providers (EMAIL_PROVIDER):
  outbox  - development default. Writes each message to data/outbox/ as HTML; nothing leaves the machine.
  resend  - Resend HTTPS API (RESEND_API_KEY).
  smtp    - any SMTP server (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD).

Template bodies use light markup: blank-line paragraphs, {{variables}} (escaped), {{{raw}}}
(trusted HTML built by the app, e.g. report tables) and lines like `[button: Label | {{url}}]`.

def ensure_templates() -> None:
    have = {r["key"] for r in db.q("SELECT key FROM email_templates")}
    for key, (aud, name, subject, body) in DEFAULT_TEMPLATES.items():
        if key not in have:
            db.insert("email_templates", {"key": key, "audience": aud, "name": name, "subject": subject,
                                          "body": body, "updated_at": db.now()})


def template(key: str):
    row = db.one("SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE key = ?", (key,))
    if row is None and key in DEFAULT_TEMPLATES:
        ensure_templates()
        row = db.one("SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE key = ?", (key,))
    return row


# --- rendering -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_VAR = re.compile(r"\{\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}\}|\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}")


def fill(text: str, vars: dict, html: bool) -> str:
    def rep(m):
        if m.group(1):
            return str(vars.get(m.group(1), "")) if html else re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", str(vars.get(m.group(1), "")))
        v = vars.get(m.group(2), "")
        return esc(v) if html else str(v)
    return _VAR.sub(rep, text)


def render_body(body: str, vars: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Returns (inner_html, plain_text)."""
    blocks = re.split(r"\n\s*\n", body.strip())
    html_parts, text_parts = [], []
    for block in blocks:
        m = re.match(r"^\[button:\s*(.+?)\s*\|\s*(.+?)\s*\]$", block.strip())
        if m:
            label, href = fill(m.group(1), vars, True), fill(m.group(2), vars, False).strip()
            html_parts.append(
                f'<table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="margin:8px 0 22px"><tr><td style="border-radius:999px;background:#EDCF86;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#F8E7B9,#EDCF86 48%,#DDB563)">'
                f'<a href="{esc(href)}" style="display:inline-block;padding:14px 26px;color:#2A1F0A;font:600 15px/1 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;border-radius:999px">{label}</a></td></tr></table>')
            text_parts.append(f"{fill(m.group(1), vars, False)}: {href}")
            continue
        filled_html = fill(block, vars, True)
        if filled_html.lstrip().startswith(("<table", "<div", "<ul")):
            html_parts.append(filled_html)
        else:
            lines = filled_html.split("\n")
            if all(l.strip().startswith("- ") for l in lines if l.strip()):
                items = "".join(f"<li style='margin:0 0 6px'>{l.strip()[2:]}</li>" for l in lines if l.strip())
                html_parts.append(f"<ul style='margin:0 0 18px;padding-left:20px'>{items}</ul>")
            else:
                html_parts.append(f"<p style='margin:0 0 18px'>{'<br>'.join(lines)}</p>")
        text_parts.append(fill(block, vars, False))
    return "".join(html_parts), "\n\n".join(text_parts)


def wrap(inner: str, preheader: str = "", footer_note: str = "") -> str:
    brand = esc(config.BRAND_NAME)
    return f"""<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light"><title>{brand}</title></head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#FBF8F2">
<span style="display:none;max-height:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0">{esc(preheader)}</span>
<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background:#FBF8F2"><tr><td align="center" style="padding:32px 16px">
<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="max-width:600px">
<tr><td style="padding:0 8px 18px;font:italic 400 26px/1 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#1F1A12">
<span style="color:#C99A3C">&#10022;</span>&nbsp;{brand}</td></tr>
<tr><td style="background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #EDE4D2;border-radius:20px;padding:32px 30px;font:400 16px/1.6 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:#1F1A12">
<div style="height:2px;width:48px;margin:0 0 24px;background:linear-gradient(96deg,#C99A3C,#EBCB7E,#C99A3C);border-radius:2px"></div>
{inner}</td></tr>
<tr><td style="padding:20px 10px;font:400 12px/1.6 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:#6A6152;text-align:center">
{footer_note}{brand} · {esc(config.COMPANY_ADDRESS)} · <a href="mailto:{esc(config.SUPPORT_EMAIL)}" style="color:#87651C">{esc(config.SUPPORT_EMAIL)}</a></td></tr>
</table></td></tr></table></body></html>"""


def base_vars() -> dict:
    return {"brand": config.BRAND_NAME, "base_url": config.BASE_URL, "create_url": config.BASE_URL + "/create",
            "support_email": config.SUPPORT_EMAIL}


def compose(key: str, vars: dict, subject_override: str = "", body_override: str = "") -> dict:
    t = template(key)
    if t is None:
        raise KeyError(f"Unknown email template {key}")
    v = {**base_vars(), **vars}
    subject = fill(subject_override or t["subject"], v, False)
    inner, text = render_body(body_override or t["body"], v)
    note = ""
    if t["audience"] == "guest" and v.get("unsubscribe_url"):
        note = (f'You received this because {esc(v.get("hosts", "the host"))} invited you. '
                f'<a href="{esc(v["unsubscribe_url"])}" style="color:#87651C">Stop event emails</a>.<br>')
        text += f"\n\nStop event emails: {v['unsubscribe_url']}"
    return {"subject": subject, "html": wrap(inner, preheader=subject, footer_note=note), "text": text,
            "audience": t["audience"], "key": key}


# --- providers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class EmailError(Exception):
    pass


class OutboxProvider:
    name = "outbox"

    def send(self, to: str, msg: dict, attachments: list) -> str:
        ref = db.now().replace(":", "").replace("-", "")[:15] + "-" + secrets.token_hex(3)
        folder = config.OUTBOX_DIR
        (folder / f"{ref}.html").write_text(msg["html"], encoding="utf-8")
        meta = {"to": to, "subject": msg["subject"], "text": msg["text"], "attachments": []}
        for name, data, _ in attachments:
            safe = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "-", name)
            (folder / f"{ref}-{safe}").write_bytes(data)
            meta["attachments"].append(f"{ref}-{safe}")
        (folder / f"{ref}.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        return ref


class ResendProvider:
    name = "resend"

    def send(self, to: str, msg: dict, attachments: list) -> str:
        if not config.RESEND_API_KEY:
            raise EmailError("RESEND_API_KEY is not set.")
        payload = {"from": config.EMAIL_FROM, "to": [to], "subject": msg["subject"], "html": msg["html"],
                   "text": msg["text"], "reply_to": config.EMAIL_REPLY_TO}
        if attachments:
            payload["attachments"] = [{"filename": n, "content": base64.b64encode(d).decode()} for n, d, _ in attachments]
        req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.resend.com/emails", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
                                     headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {config.RESEND_API_KEY}",
                                              "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "aurelia-mailer/1.0"})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
                return json.loads(r.read().decode()).get("id", "")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            raise EmailError(f"Resend {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:300]}")
        except urllib.error.URLError as e:
            raise EmailError(f"Resend unreachable: {e.reason}")


class SMTPProvider:
    name = "smtp"

    def send(self, to: str, msg: dict, attachments: list) -> str:
        if not config.SMTP_HOST:
            raise EmailError("SMTP_HOST is not set.")
        m = EmailMessage()
        m["From"] = config.EMAIL_FROM
        m["To"] = to
        m["Subject"] = msg["subject"]
        m["Reply-To"] = config.EMAIL_REPLY_TO
        mid = make_msgid(domain=(config.EMAIL_FROM.split("@")[-1].rstrip(">") or "localhost"))
        m["Message-ID"] = mid
        m.set_content(msg["text"])
        m.add_alternative(msg["html"], subtype="html")
        for name, data, ctype in attachments:
            maintype, _, subtype = ctype.partition("/")
            m.add_attachment(data, maintype=maintype, subtype=subtype or "octet-stream", filename=name)
        try:
            with smtplib.SMTP(config.SMTP_HOST, config.SMTP_PORT, timeout=20) as s:
                if config.SMTP_STARTTLS:
                    s.starttls(context=ssl.create_default_context())
                if config.SMTP_USER:
                    s.login(config.SMTP_USER, config.SMTP_PASSWORD)
                s.send_message(m)
        except (smtplib.SMTPException, OSError) as e:
            raise EmailError(f"SMTP: {e}")
        return mid


def provider():
    return {"resend": ResendProvider, "smtp": SMTPProvider}.get(config.EMAIL_PROVIDER, OutboxProvider)()


def send(to: str, key: str, vars: dict, *, event_id: Optional[int] = None, user_id: Optional[int] = None,
         guest_id: Optional[int] = None, attachments: Optional[list] = None, batch_id: Optional[str] = None,
         subject_override: str = "", body_override: str = "") -> dict:
    """Render and deliver one email; always writes an email_logs row. Never raises for delivery errors.

    attachments: list of (filename, bytes, content_type).
    """
    msg = compose(key, vars, subject_override, body_override)
    p = provider()
    status, ref, error = "sent", None, None
    t = template(key)
    if t is not None and not t["active"]:
        status, error = "skipped", "Template switched off by an administrator."
    else:
        try:
            ref = p.send(to, msg, attachments or [])
        except Exception as e:  # provider failures are logged, not fatal
            status, error = "failed", str(e)[:500]
            print(f"[email] {key} to {to} failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    log_id = db.insert("email_logs", {
        "event_id": event_id, "user_id": user_id, "guest_id": guest_id, "to_email": to, "template_key": key,
        "subject": msg["subject"], "audience": msg["audience"], "status": status, "provider": p.name,
        "provider_id": ref, "error": error, "outbox_file": ref if p.name == "outbox" and status == "sent" else None,
        "batch_id": batch_id, "created_at": db.now()})
    return {"id": log_id, "status": status, "error": error, "subject": msg["subject"]}


def first_name(name: str) -> str:
    return (name or "").split(" ")[0] or "there"
```
