### `app/services/payments.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/payments.py sha256=d376a1967eb9d5f769e137312833af39970910163433403e3a277ae61923756a nl=1 -->
```python
"""Payments behind a gateway interface.

Rules:
- Only a verified server-to-server notification (webhook / PayFast ITN) can mark an order paid.
  The browser coming back to a "return" URL proves nothing and changes nothing.
- Notifications are idempotent: replays are recorded but applied once.
- The amount in the notification must equal the order amount.

Gateways (PAYMENT_GATEWAY):
  sandbox - built-in test checkout for development. No money moves. Its notification is signed with
            HMAC-SHA256 using SECRET_KEY and goes through the same verification path as a real webhook.
  payfast - PayFast (South Africa). PAYFAST_SANDBOX=1 uses sandbox.payfast.co.za.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import secrets
import socket
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional

from .. import auth, catalog, config, db, events, notify
from . import email as mail


@dataclass
class Notification:
    order_uid: str
    status: str                 # paid | failed | cancelled
    amount_cents: int
    gateway_payment_id: str = ""
    raw: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    valid: bool = False
    reason: str = ""


class PaymentError(Exception):
    pass


# --- gateways ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class SandboxGateway:
    name = "sandbox"
    mode = "sandbox"
    label = "built-in sandbox checkout"

    def checkout(self, order) -> dict:
        return {"redirect": f"/pay/sandbox/{order['uid']}"}

    @staticmethod
    def sign(body: bytes) -> str:
        return hmac.new(config.SECRET_KEY.encode(), b"sandbox-webhook:" + body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

    def build_notification(self, order, decision: str) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
        payload = {"order": order["uid"], "status": "paid" if decision == "approve" else "failed" if decision == "decline" else "cancelled",
                   "amount_cents": order["amount_cents"], "payment_id": "SBX-" + secrets.token_hex(6),
                   "ts": int(time.time()), "nonce": secrets.token_hex(8)}
        body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        return body, self.sign(body)

    def verify(self, body: bytes, signature: str) -> Notification:
        try:
            data = json.loads(body.decode())
        except ValueError:
            return Notification("", "failed", 0, valid=False, reason="Malformed body")
        n = Notification(str(data.get("order", "")), str(data.get("status", "")), int(data.get("amount_cents", -1)),
                         str(data.get("payment_id", "")), data)
        if not signature or not hmac.compare_digest(signature, self.sign(body)):
            n.reason = "Bad signature"
            return n
        if abs(time.time() - int(data.get("ts", 0))) > 600:
            n.reason = "Notification expired"
            return n
        if n.status not in ("paid", "failed", "cancelled"):
            n.reason = "Unknown status"
            return n
        n.valid = True
        return n


class PayFastGateway:
    name = "payfast"
    label = "PayFast"

    @property
    def mode(self) -> str:
        return "sandbox" if config.PAYFAST_SANDBOX else "live"

    @property
    def host(self) -> str:
        return "sandbox.payfast.co.za" if config.PAYFAST_SANDBOX else "www.payfast.co.za"

    @staticmethod
    def signature(pairs: list[tuple[str, str]], passphrase: str = "") -> str:
        """MD5 of the URL-encoded, non-empty fields in order, plus the passphrase when set."""
        parts = [f"{k}={urllib.parse.quote_plus(str(v).strip())}" for k, v in pairs if str(v).strip() != ""]
        s = "&".join(parts)
        if passphrase:
            s += "&passphrase=" + urllib.parse.quote_plus(passphrase.strip())
        return hashlib.md5(s.encode()).hexdigest()

    def checkout(self, order) -> dict:
        if not (config.PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID and config.PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY):
            raise PaymentError("PayFast is not configured (PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID / PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY).")
        user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (order["user_id"],))
        ev = db.one("SELECT uid FROM events WHERE id = ?", (order["event_id"],))
        first, _, last = (user["name"] or "").partition(" ")
        fields = [
            ("merchant_id", config.PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID), ("merchant_key", config.PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY),
            ("return_url", f"{config.BASE_URL}/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}/payment/{order['uid']}"),
            ("cancel_url", f"{config.BASE_URL}/pay/cancel/{order['uid']}"),
            ("notify_url", f"{config.BASE_URL}/webhooks/payments/payfast"),
            ("name_first", first[:100]), ("name_last", last[:100]), ("email_address", user["email"]),
            ("m_payment_id", order["uid"]), ("amount", f"{order['amount_cents'] / 100:.2f}"),
            ("item_name", order["description"][:100]),
        ]
        fields.append(("signature", self.signature(fields, config.PAYFAST_PASSPHRASE)))
        return {"post_to": f"https://{self.host}/eng/process", "fields": fields}

    def _valid_source(self, ip: str) -> bool:
        if not config.env_bool("PAYFAST_CHECK_IP", True):
            return True
        allowed = set()
        for host in ("www.payfast.co.za", "sandbox.payfast.co.za", "w1w.payfast.co.za", "w2w.payfast.co.za"):
            try:
                allowed.update(socket.gethostbyname_ex(host)[2])
            except OSError:
                pass
        return ip in allowed

    def _server_confirms(self, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> bool:
        body = urllib.parse.urlencode(pairs).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(f"https://{self.host}/eng/query/validate", data=body,
                                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "User-Agent": "aurelia/1.0"})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
                return r.read().decode().strip() == "VALID"
        except urllib.error.URLError:
            return False

    def verify_itn(self, raw_body: bytes, ip: str) -> Notification:
        pairs = urllib.parse.parse_qsl(raw_body.decode("utf-8", "replace"), keep_blank_values=True)
        data = dict(pairs)
        amount = data.get("amount_gross", "0")
        try:
            cents = round(float(amount) * 100)
        except ValueError:
            cents = -1
        status = {"COMPLETE": "paid", "FAILED": "failed", "CANCELLED": "cancelled"}.get(data.get("payment_status", ""), "")
        n = Notification(data.get("m_payment_id", ""), status, cents, data.get("pf_payment_id", ""), data)
        sig_pairs = [(k, v) for k, v in pairs if k != "signature"]
        if not hmac.compare_digest(data.get("signature", ""), self.signature(sig_pairs, config.PAYFAST_PASSPHRASE)):
            n.reason = "Bad signature"
            return n
        if not status:
            n.reason = "Unknown payment status"
            return n
        if not self._valid_source(ip):
            n.reason = f"Notification from unexpected IP {ip}"
            return n
        if not self._server_confirms(sig_pairs):
            n.reason = "PayFast did not confirm the notification"
            return n
        n.valid = True
        return n


def gateway():
    return PayFastGateway() if config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY == "payfast" else SandboxGateway()


# --- orders --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def quote(ev, package_code: str) -> tuple[Optional[dict], int, str]:
    """(package, amount_cents, error). Upgrades pay the difference."""
    pkg = catalog.package(package_code)
    if not pkg or not pkg["active"]:
        return None, 0, "Choose a package."
    paid = catalog.package(ev["paid_package"])
    if paid:
        if pkg["rank"] <= paid["rank"]:
            return None, 0, "That package is already covered by your payment."
        return dict(pkg), pkg["price_cents"] - paid["price_cents"], ""
    return dict(pkg), pkg["price_cents"], ""


def sandbox_allowed() -> bool:
    return config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY != "sandbox" or config.ALLOW_SANDBOX_PAYMENTS


def create_order(ev, user, package_code: str) -> dict:
    pkg, amount, err = quote(ev, package_code)
    if err:
        raise PaymentError(err)
    if not sandbox_allowed():
        raise PaymentError("Online payments aren't switched on yet. Please contact us to complete your booking.")
    gw = gateway()
    uid = "AUR-" + secrets.token_hex(5).upper()
    upgrade = bool(ev["paid_package"])
    desc = f"{pkg['name']}{' upgrade' if upgrade else ''}: {ev['name']}"
    now = db.now()
    # cancel older unpaid attempts for this event so only one pending order exists
    db.run("UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = ? WHERE event_id = ? AND status = 'pending'", (now, ev["id"]))
    oid = db.insert("orders", {"uid": uid, "user_id": user["id"], "event_id": ev["id"], "package_code": pkg["code"],
                               "description": desc[:200], "amount_cents": amount, "currency": "ZAR", "status": "pending",
                               "gateway": gw.name, "mode": gw.mode, "created_at": now, "updated_at": now})
    events.touch(ev["id"], selected_package=pkg["code"])
    auth.audit(user["id"], "order.create", uid, package=pkg["code"], amount=amount, gateway=gw.name)
    return dict(db.one("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (oid,)))


def _next_invoice_no() -> str:
    year = db.now()[:4]
    n = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE invoice_no LIKE ?", (f"INV-{year}-%",), 0) + 1
    return f"INV-{year}-{n:05d}"


def apply(notif: Notification, gateway_name: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Record a notification; apply it once if valid. Returns (applied, message)."""
    order = db.one("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE uid = ?", (notif.order_uid,))
    if order is None:
        return False, "Unknown order"
    db.insert("payments", {"order_id": order["id"], "gateway": gateway_name, "gateway_payment_id": notif.gateway_payment_id,
                           "status": notif.status or "unknown", "amount_cents": max(notif.amount_cents, 0),
                           "verified": 1 if notif.valid else 0, "raw": db.dumps(notif.raw), "created_at": db.now()})
    if not notif.valid:
        auth.audit(None, "payment.rejected", order["uid"], reason=notif.reason)
        return False, notif.reason
    if order["gateway"] != gateway_name:
        return False, "Gateway mismatch"
    if notif.amount_cents != order["amount_cents"]:
        auth.audit(None, "payment.amount_mismatch", order["uid"], got=notif.amount_cents, expected=order["amount_cents"])
        return False, "Amount mismatch"
    if order["status"] == "paid":
        return False, "Already paid"
    now = db.now()
    if notif.status == "paid":
        with db.transaction():
            fresh = db.one("SELECT status FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order["id"],))
            if fresh["status"] == "paid":
                return False, "Already paid"
            db.run("""UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid', paid_at = ?, updated_at = ?, gateway_ref = ?, invoice_no = ?
                      WHERE id = ?""", (now, now, notif.gateway_payment_id, _next_invoice_no(), order["id"]))
            ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
            prev = catalog.package(ev["paid_package"])
            fields = {"paid_package": order["package_code"], "selected_package": order["package_code"]}
            if prev and ev["hosting_until"]:
                # upgrade: extend hosting by the difference in included months
                from datetime import date, timedelta
                extra = catalog.package_limits(order["package_code"]).get("hosting_months", 0) - catalog.package_limits(prev["code"]).get("hosting_months", 0)
                if extra > 0:
                    fields["hosting_until"] = (date.fromisoformat(ev["hosting_until"]) + timedelta(days=int(extra * 30.5))).isoformat()
            events.touch(ev["id"], **fields)
        auth.audit(order["user_id"], "payment.paid", order["uid"], amount=order["amount_cents"], mode=order["mode"])
        order = db.one("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order["id"],))
        ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
        user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (order["user_id"],))
        pkg = catalog.package(order["package_code"])
        mail.send(user["email"], "payment_confirmation", {
            "first_name": mail.first_name(user["name"]), "event_name": ev["name"], "package": pkg["name"] if pkg else order["package_code"],
            "amount": catalog.money(order["amount_cents"], True), "invoice_no": order["invoice_no"], "order_ref": order["uid"],
            "receipt_url": f"{config.BASE_URL}/dashboard/orders/{order['uid']}/receipt"},
            event_id=ev["id"], user_id=user["id"])
        if ev["status"] in ("draft", "unpublished") or not ev["published_at"]:
            notify.publish(ev, order["user_id"])
        return True, "Paid"
    db.run("UPDATE orders SET status = ?, failure_reason = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
           (notif.status, notif.raw.get("reason", "") or notif.status, now, order["id"]))
    auth.audit(order["user_id"], f"payment.{notif.status}", order["uid"])
    return True, notif.status


def vat_breakdown(amount_cents: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Prices include VAT. Returns (excl, vat)."""
    excl = round(amount_cents / (1 + config.VAT_RATE))
    return excl, amount_cents - excl
```

### `app/services/pdf.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/pdf.py sha256=66cc1a5a0b4ec8391ceb07e8e8d0be2bd56f4248b7ce1206426880210382ac6d nl=1 -->
```python
"""A small hand-written PDF 1.4 writer for reports.

Base-14 Helvetica fonts with WinAnsi encoding, A4 pages, wrapped text, key/value blocks and
tables that break across pages with their header repeated. No dependencies.

    doc = PDF("Guest list", "Sarah & John · 12 December 2026")
    doc.heading("Totals"); doc.kv([("Invited", "150")])
    doc.table(["Name", "Status"], [["Thandi", "Attending"]])
    data = doc.output()
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import zlib
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 595.28, 841.89
MARGIN = 48
CONTENT_W = PAGE_W - 2 * MARGIN
TOP = PAGE_H - MARGIN
BOTTOM = MARGIN + 28          # leave room for the footer

INK = (0.122, 0.102, 0.071)        # #1F1A12
MUTED = (0.416, 0.380, 0.322)      # #6A6152
GOLD = (0.788, 0.604, 0.235)       # accent rule, gold #C99A3C
LINE = (0.929, 0.894, 0.824)       # #EDE4D2
FILL = (0.984, 0.961, 0.910)       # #FBF5E8

_REG = [278, 278, 355, 556, 556, 889, 667, 191, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278] + [556] * 10 + \
       [278, 278, 584, 584, 584, 556, 1015, 667, 667, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 500, 667, 556, 833, 722, 778,
        667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 278, 278, 278, 469, 556, 333, 556, 556, 500, 556, 556,
        278, 556, 556, 222, 222, 500, 222, 833, 556, 556, 556, 556, 333, 500, 278, 556, 500, 722, 500, 500, 500, 334,
        260, 334, 584]
_BOLD = [278, 333, 474, 556, 556, 889, 722, 238, 333, 333, 389, 584, 278, 333, 278, 278] + [556] * 10 + \
        [333, 333, 584, 584, 584, 611, 975, 722, 722, 722, 722, 667, 611, 778, 722, 278, 556, 722, 611, 833, 722, 778,
         667, 778, 722, 667, 611, 722, 667, 944, 667, 667, 611, 333, 278, 333, 584, 556, 333, 556, 611, 556, 611, 556,
         333, 611, 611, 278, 278, 556, 278, 889, 611, 611, 611, 611, 389, 556, 333, 611, 556, 778, 556, 556, 500, 389,
         280, 389, 584]


def _encode(text: str) -> bytes:
    text = str(text if text is not None else "")
    text = text.replace("\r", "").replace("\t", "    ")
    return text.encode("cp1252", errors="replace")


def width(text: str, size: float, bold: bool = False) -> float:
    table = _BOLD if bold else _REG
    total = 0
    for b in _encode(text):
        total += table[b - 32] if 32 <= b <= 126 else 556
    return total * size / 1000


def _pdf_str(raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray(b"(")
    for b in raw:
        if b in (0x28, 0x29, 0x5C):
            out += b"\\" + bytes([b])
        elif b < 32 or b > 126:
            out += b"\\%03o" % b
        else:
            out.append(b)
    out += b")"
    return bytes(out)


def wrap(text: str, size: float, max_w: float, bold: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    lines: list[str] = []
    for para in str(text if text is not None else "").split("\n"):
        words = para.split(" ")
        cur = ""
        for w in words:
            trial = (cur + " " + w) if cur else w
            if width(trial, size, bold) <= max_w:
                cur = trial
                continue
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            # break very long words
            while width(w, size, bold) > max_w and len(w) > 1:
                cut = len(w)
                while cut > 1 and width(w[:cut], size, bold) > max_w:
                    cut -= 1
                lines.append(w[:cut])
                w = w[cut:]
            cur = w
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines or [""]


def _fmt(n: float) -> str:
    return ("%.2f" % n).rstrip("0").rstrip(".")


class PDF:
    def __init__(self, title: str, subtitle: str = ""):
        self.title = title
        self.subtitle = subtitle
        self.pages: list[list[str]] = []
        self.y = TOP
        self._new_page(first=True)

    # --- low level --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _ops(self) -> list[str]:
        return self.pages[-1]

    def _text(self, x: float, y: float, text: str, size: float = 10, bold: bool = False, color=INK) -> None:
        raw = _pdf_str(_encode(text)).decode("latin-1")
        self._ops().append(f"BT /{'F2' if bold else 'F1'} {_fmt(size)} Tf {_fmt(color[0])} {_fmt(color[1])} {_fmt(color[2])} rg "
                           f"{_fmt(x)} {_fmt(y)} Td {raw} Tj ET")

    def _line(self, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=LINE, w: float = 0.6) -> None:
        self._ops().append(f"{_fmt(color[0])} {_fmt(color[1])} {_fmt(color[2])} RG {_fmt(w)} w "
                           f"{_fmt(x1)} {_fmt(y1)} m {_fmt(x2)} {_fmt(y2)} l S")

    def _rect(self, x, y, w, h, color=FILL) -> None:
        self._ops().append(f"{_fmt(color[0])} {_fmt(color[1])} {_fmt(color[2])} rg {_fmt(x)} {_fmt(y)} {_fmt(w)} {_fmt(h)} re f")

    def _new_page(self, first: bool = False) -> None:
        self.pages.append([])
        self.y = TOP
        if first:
            self._text(MARGIN, self.y - 20, self.title, 20, bold=True)
            self.y -= 30
            if self.subtitle:
                self._text(MARGIN, self.y - 10, self.subtitle, 10, color=MUTED)
                self.y -= 16
            self.y -= 6
            self._line(MARGIN, self.y, MARGIN + 56, self.y, GOLD, 1.6)
            self.y -= 22
        else:
            self._text(MARGIN, self.y - 9, self.title, 9, bold=True, color=MUTED)
            self.y -= 16
            self._line(MARGIN, self.y, PAGE_W - MARGIN, self.y, LINE, 0.5)
            self.y -= 16

    def _ensure(self, h: float) -> bool:
        """Start a new page if `h` points don't fit. Returns True when a page was added."""
        if self.y - h < BOTTOM:
            self._new_page()
            return True
        return False

    # --- public API ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def heading(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._ensure(40)
        self.y -= 6
        self._text(MARGIN, self.y - 12, text, 13, bold=True)
        self.y -= 24

    def text(self, text: str, size: float = 10, muted: bool = False) -> None:
        lead = size * 1.4
        for line in wrap(text, size, CONTENT_W):
            self._ensure(lead)
            self._text(MARGIN, self.y - size, line, size, color=MUTED if muted else INK)
            self.y -= lead
        self.y -= 4

    def kv(self, pairs: list) -> None:
        key_w = CONTENT_W * 0.36
        for k, v in pairs:
            vlines = wrap(str(v), 10, CONTENT_W - key_w - 8)
            h = 14 * len(vlines) + 6
            self._ensure(h)
            self._text(MARGIN, self.y - 10, str(k), 10, color=MUTED)
            for n, line in enumerate(vlines):
                self._text(MARGIN + key_w, self.y - 10 - n * 14, line, 10, bold=n == 0 and len(vlines) == 1)
            self.y -= h
            self._line(MARGIN, self.y + 2, PAGE_W - MARGIN, self.y + 2)
        self.y -= 8

    def table(self, headers: list, rows: list, widths: Optional[list] = None) -> None:
        n = len(headers)
        fr = widths or [1] * n
        total = float(sum(fr))
        cols = [CONTENT_W * f / total for f in fr]
        size, lead, pad = 8.5, 11, 5

        def draw_header():
            hl = [wrap(h, size, c - 2 * pad, bold=True) for h, c in zip(headers, cols)]
            h = max(len(x) for x in hl) * lead + 2 * pad
            self._ensure(h + lead + 2 * pad)
            self._rect(MARGIN, self.y - h, CONTENT_W, h)
            x = MARGIN
            for lines, c in zip(hl, cols):
                for k, line in enumerate(lines):
                    self._text(x + pad, self.y - pad - size - k * lead + 1, line, size, bold=True)
                x += c
            self.y -= h

        draw_header()
        if not rows:
            self._ensure(lead + 2 * pad)
            self._text(MARGIN + pad, self.y - pad - size, "Nothing to show yet.", size, color=MUTED)
            self.y -= lead + 2 * pad
        for row in rows:
            cells = [wrap("" if v is None else str(v), size, c - 2 * pad) for v, c in zip(list(row) + [""] * n, cols)]
            h = max(len(x) for x in cells) * lead + 2 * pad
            if self._ensure(h):
                draw_header()
            x = MARGIN
            for lines, c in zip(cells, cols):
                for k, line in enumerate(lines):
                    self._text(x + pad, self.y - pad - size - k * lead + 1, line, size)
                x += c
            self.y -= h
            self._line(MARGIN, self.y, PAGE_W - MARGIN, self.y)
        self.y -= 14

    def spacer(self, h: float = 8) -> None:
        self.y -= h
        if self.y < BOTTOM:
            self._new_page()

    def page_break(self) -> None:
        self._new_page()

    def output(self) -> bytes:
        total = len(self.pages)
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%d %b %Y, %H:%M")
        objs: list[bytes] = []
        # 1 catalog, 2 pages, 3 F1, 4 F2, 5 info, then (page, content) pairs
        page_ids = [6 + 2 * k for k in range(total)]
        objs.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
        kids = " ".join(f"{p} 0 R" for p in page_ids)
        objs.append(f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {total} >>".encode())
        objs.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>")
        objs.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>")
        objs.append(b"<< /Producer (Aurelia Studios reports) /Title " + _pdf_str(_encode(self.title)) + b" >>")
        for k, ops in enumerate(self.pages):
            self.pages[k] = ops  # keep list
            footer = [
                f"{_fmt(LINE[0])} {_fmt(LINE[1])} {_fmt(LINE[2])} RG 0.5 w {MARGIN} {MARGIN + 14} m {_fmt(PAGE_W - MARGIN)} {MARGIN + 14} l S",
                f"BT /F1 8 Tf {_fmt(MUTED[0])} {_fmt(MUTED[1])} {_fmt(MUTED[2])} rg {MARGIN} {MARGIN} Td "
                + _pdf_str(_encode(f"Generated {stamp}")).decode("latin-1") + " Tj ET",
            ]
            label = f"Page {k + 1} of {total}"
            footer.append(f"BT /F1 8 Tf {_fmt(MUTED[0])} {_fmt(MUTED[1])} {_fmt(MUTED[2])} rg "
                          f"{_fmt(PAGE_W - MARGIN - width(label, 8))} {MARGIN} Td "
                          + _pdf_str(_encode(label)).decode("latin-1") + " Tj ET")
            stream = zlib.compress("\n".join(ops + footer).encode("latin-1"))
            objs.append(f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {_fmt(PAGE_W)} {_fmt(PAGE_H)}] "
                        f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R >> >> /Contents {page_ids[k] + 1} 0 R >>".encode())
            objs.append(f"<< /Length {len(stream)} /Filter /FlateDecode >>\nstream\n".encode() + stream + b"\nendstream")
        out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
        offsets = []
        for n, body in enumerate(objs, start=1):
            offsets.append(len(out))
            out += f"{n} 0 obj\n".encode() + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        xref = len(out)
        out += f"xref\n0 {len(objs) + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n".encode()
        for off in offsets:
            out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
        out += f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs) + 1} /Root 1 0 R /Info 5 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n".encode()
        return bytes(out)
```

### `app/services/qr.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/qr.py sha256=1e5f3d70f0f46866afe8866ae11371f966f52a312c7445f5b9101f5cb357a631 nl=1 -->
```python
"""QR Code Model 2 encoder: byte mode, error correction level M, versions 1-10.

Enough for event URLs up to ~210 bytes. Produces a boolean matrix, an SVG or a PNG.
Follows ISO/IEC 18004 (structure after Project Nayuki's reference implementation).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import zlib

# version: (ec codewords per block, [(block count, data codewords per block), ...])
BLOCKS_M = {
    1: (10, [(1, 16)]), 2: (16, [(1, 28)]), 3: (26, [(1, 44)]), 4: (18, [(2, 32)]), 5: (24, [(2, 43)]),
    6: (16, [(4, 27)]), 7: (18, [(4, 31)]), 8: (22, [(2, 38), (2, 39)]), 9: (22, [(3, 36), (2, 37)]),
    10: (26, [(4, 43), (1, 44)]),
}
ALIGN = {1: [], 2: [6, 18], 3: [6, 22], 4: [6, 26], 5: [6, 30], 6: [6, 34], 7: [6, 22, 38], 8: [6, 24, 42],
         9: [6, 26, 46], 10: [6, 28, 50]}
ECL_BITS_M = 0  # format-information bits for level M


class QRError(ValueError):
    pass


# --- Reed-Solomon over GF(256), polynomial 0x11D ----------------------------------------------
def _gf_mul(x: int, y: int) -> int:
    z = 0
    for i in range(7, -1, -1):
        z = (z << 1) ^ ((z >> 7) * 0x11D)
        z ^= ((y >> i) & 1) * x
    return z & 0xFF


def _rs_divisor(degree: int) -> list[int]:
    result = [0] * (degree - 1) + [1]
    root = 1
    for _ in range(degree):
        for j in range(degree):
            result[j] = _gf_mul(result[j], root)
            if j + 1 < degree:
                result[j] ^= result[j + 1]
        root = _gf_mul(root, 0x02)
    return result


def _rs_remainder(data: list[int], divisor: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    result = [0] * len(divisor)
    for b in data:
        factor = b ^ result.pop(0)
        result.append(0)
        for i, coef in enumerate(divisor):
            result[i] ^= _gf_mul(coef, factor)
    return result


# --- data codewords ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _capacity(version: int) -> int:
    _, groups = BLOCKS_M[version]
    return sum(c * d for c, d in groups)


def _choose_version(n: int) -> int:
    for v in range(1, 11):
        cc_bits = 8 if v < 10 else 16
        if 4 + cc_bits + 8 * n <= _capacity(v) * 8:
            return v
    raise QRError("Text is too long for a version 1-10 QR code.")


def _data_codewords(data: bytes, version: int) -> list[int]:
    bits: list[int] = []

    def put(val: int, n: int):
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            bits.append((val >> i) & 1)

    put(0b0100, 4)
    put(len(data), 8 if version < 10 else 16)
    for b in data:
        put(b, 8)
    cap = _capacity(version) * 8
    put(0, min(4, cap - len(bits)))
    put(0, (-len(bits)) % 8)
    pad = 0xEC
    while len(bits) < cap:
        put(pad, 8)
        pad ^= 0xEC ^ 0x11
    return [int("".join(map(str, bits[i:i + 8])), 2) for i in range(0, len(bits), 8)]


def _interleave(data: list[int], version: int) -> list[int]:
    ec_len, groups = BLOCKS_M[version]
    divisor = _rs_divisor(ec_len)
    blocks, ecs = [], []
    k = 0
    for count, size in groups:
        for _ in range(count):
            blk = data[k:k + size]
            k += size
            blocks.append(blk)
            ecs.append(_rs_remainder(blk, divisor))
    out = []
    for i in range(max(len(b) for b in blocks)):
        for b in blocks:
            if i < len(b):
                out.append(b[i])
    for i in range(ec_len):
        for e in ecs:
            out.append(e[i])
    return out


# --- matrix -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Grid:
    def __init__(self, version: int):
        self.version = version
        self.size = version * 4 + 17
        self.mod = [[False] * self.size for _ in range(self.size)]
        self.func = [[False] * self.size for _ in range(self.size)]

    def set_func(self, x: int, y: int, dark: bool) -> None:
        self.mod[y][x] = dark
        self.func[y][x] = True

    def draw_function_patterns(self) -> None:
        n = self.size
        for i in range(n):
            self.set_func(6, i, i % 2 == 0)
            self.set_func(i, 6, i % 2 == 0)
        for cx, cy in ((3, 3), (n - 4, 3), (3, n - 4)):
            for dy in range(-4, 5):
                for dx in range(-4, 5):
                    x, y = cx + dx, cy + dy
                    if 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < n:
                        dist = max(abs(dx), abs(dy))
                        self.set_func(x, y, dist not in (2, 4))
        pos = ALIGN[self.version]
        last = len(pos) - 1
        for i, a in enumerate(pos):
            for j, b in enumerate(pos):
                if (i == 0 and j == 0) or (i == 0 and j == last) or (i == last and j == 0):
                    continue
                for dy in range(-2, 3):
                    for dx in range(-2, 3):
                        self.set_func(a + dx, b + dy, max(abs(dx), abs(dy)) != 1)
        self.draw_format(0)
        self.draw_version()

    def draw_format(self, mask: int) -> None:
        data = (ECL_BITS_M << 3) | mask
        rem = data
        for _ in range(10):
            rem = (rem << 1) ^ ((rem >> 9) * 0x537)
        bits = ((data << 10) | rem) ^ 0x5412
        n = self.size

        def bit(i):
            return ((bits >> i) & 1) != 0

        for i in range(0, 6):
            self.set_func(8, i, bit(i))
        self.set_func(8, 7, bit(6))
        self.set_func(8, 8, bit(7))
        self.set_func(7, 8, bit(8))
        for i in range(9, 15):
            self.set_func(14 - i, 8, bit(i))
        for i in range(0, 8):
            self.set_func(n - 1 - i, 8, bit(i))
        for i in range(8, 15):
            self.set_func(8, n - 15 + i, bit(i))
        self.set_func(8, n - 8, True)  # dark module

    def draw_version(self) -> None:
        if self.version < 7:
            return
        rem = self.version
        for _ in range(12):
            rem = (rem << 1) ^ ((rem >> 11) * 0x1F25)
        bits = (self.version << 12) | rem
        n = self.size
        for i in range(18):
            b = ((bits >> i) & 1) != 0
            a, c = n - 11 + i % 3, i // 3
            self.set_func(a, c, b)
            self.set_func(c, a, b)

    def draw_codewords(self, data: list[int]) -> None:
        n = self.size
        i = 0
        total = len(data) * 8
        right = n - 1
        while right >= 1:
            if right == 6:
                right = 5
            for vert in range(n):
                for j in range(2):
                    x = right - j
                    upward = ((right + 1) & 2) == 0
                    y = n - 1 - vert if upward else vert
                    if not self.func[y][x] and i < total:
                        self.mod[y][x] = ((data[i >> 3] >> (7 - (i & 7))) & 1) != 0
                        i += 1
            right -= 2

    def apply_mask(self, mask: int) -> None:
        n = self.size
        for y in range(n):
            for x in range(n):
                if self.func[y][x]:
                    continue
                if mask == 0:
                    inv = (x + y) % 2 == 0
                elif mask == 1:
                    inv = y % 2 == 0
                elif mask == 2:
                    inv = x % 3 == 0
                elif mask == 3:
                    inv = (x + y) % 3 == 0
                elif mask == 4:
                    inv = (x // 3 + y // 2) % 2 == 0
                elif mask == 5:
                    inv = x * y % 2 + x * y % 3 == 0
                elif mask == 6:
                    inv = (x * y % 2 + x * y % 3) % 2 == 0
                else:
                    inv = ((x + y) % 2 + x * y % 3) % 2 == 0
                if inv:
                    self.mod[y][x] = not self.mod[y][x]


def _penalty(m: list[list[bool]]) -> int:
    n = len(m)
    score = 0
    # rule 1: runs of 5+ same colour in rows and columns
    for lines in (m, [list(col) for col in zip(*m)]):
        for line in lines:
            run, prev = 0, None
            for v in line:
                if v == prev:
                    run += 1
                else:
                    if run >= 5:
                        score += 3 + (run - 5)
                    run, prev = 1, v
            if run >= 5:
                score += 3 + (run - 5)
    # rule 2: 2x2 blocks
    for y in range(n - 1):
        for x in range(n - 1):
            c = m[y][x]
            if c == m[y][x + 1] == m[y + 1][x] == m[y + 1][x + 1]:
                score += 3
    # rule 3: finder-like patterns 1:1:3:1:1 with 4 light on one side
    pats = ([True, False, True, True, True, False, True, False, False, False, False],
            [False, False, False, False, True, False, True, True, True, False, True])
    for lines in (m, [list(col) for col in zip(*m)]):
        for line in lines:
            for x in range(n - 10):
                seg = line[x:x + 11]
                if seg == pats[0] or seg == pats[1]:
                    score += 40
    # rule 4: dark proportion
    dark = sum(v for row in m for v in row)
    total = n * n
    k = abs(dark * 20 - total * 10) // total
    score += k * 10
    return score


def matrix(text: str) -> list[list[bool]]:
    data = text.encode("utf-8")
    version = _choose_version(len(data))
    codewords = _interleave(_data_codewords(data, version), version)
    best, best_score = None, None
    for mask in range(8):
        g = _Grid(version)
        g.draw_function_patterns()
        g.draw_codewords(codewords)
        g.apply_mask(mask)
        g.draw_format(mask)
        s = _penalty(g.mod)
        if best_score is None or s < best_score:
            best, best_score = g, s
    return best.mod


def svg(text: str, size: int = 320, dark: str = "#1B191A", light: str = "#FFFFFF", border: int = 4) -> str:
    m = matrix(text)
    n = len(m) + 2 * border
    path = []
    for y, row in enumerate(m):
        for x, v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                path.append(f"M{x + border},{y + border}h1v1h-1z")
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {n} {n}" width="{size}" height="{size}" '
            f'shape-rendering="crispEdges" role="img" aria-label="QR code"><rect width="{n}" height="{n}" fill="{light}"/>'
            f'<path d="{"".join(path)}" fill="{dark}"/></svg>')


def png(text: str, scale: int = 10, border: int = 4) -> bytes:
    m = matrix(text)
    n = (len(m) + 2 * border) * scale
    rows = []
    for y in range(n):
        my = y // scale - border
        line = bytearray([0])  # filter type 0
        for x in range(n):
            mx = x // scale - border
            dark = 0 <= my < len(m) and 0 <= mx < len(m) and m[my][mx]
            line.append(0 if dark else 255)
        rows.append(bytes(line))
    raw = zlib.compress(b"".join(rows), 9)

    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
        return struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + kind + data + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(kind + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)

    ihdr = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", n, n, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0)  # 8-bit greyscale
    return b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + chunk(b"IHDR", ihdr) + chunk(b"IDAT", raw) + chunk(b"IEND", b"")


def read_format(m: list[list[bool]]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Decode (ecl_bits, mask) from the top-left format copy. Used by tests."""
    bits = 0
    for i in range(0, 6):
        bits |= int(m[i][8]) << i
    bits |= int(m[7][8]) << 6
    bits |= int(m[8][8]) << 7
    bits |= int(m[8][7]) << 8
    for i in range(9, 15):
        bits |= int(m[8][14 - i]) << i
    data = (bits ^ 0x5412) >> 10
    return data >> 3, data & 7
```

### `app/services/reports.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/reports.py sha256=b35c655cea52d98cee70f3a896b7bac4570d91ebd01625f90c3f4fc340f7c132 nl=1 -->
```python
"""Organiser reports as CSV (Excel-friendly, UTF-8 with BOM) and PDF.

    filename, data, content_type = build(ev, "final", "pdf")
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
from collections import Counter
from typing import Optional

from .. import catalog, db, events
from ..views.forms import fmt_date, fmt_dt, fmt_time
from .pdf import PDF

KINDS = {
    "guests": ("Complete guest list", "Everyone on the list with contact details, status, party size and table."),
    "rsvp": ("RSVP report", "Every response with plus-ones, children, meal and requests."),
    "seating": ("Seating chart", "Tables, occupancy and who sits where."),
    "dietary": ("Dietary report", "Dietary requirements and allergies of attending guests, for the caterer."),
    "meals": ("Meal selection report", "Meal choice counts and each guest's selection."),
    "outstanding": ("Outstanding RSVP report", "Guests who haven't replied yet, with contact details."),
    "final": ("Final event administration report", "Totals, guests, meals, dietary needs, requests and seating in one document."),
}
FORMATS = ("csv", "pdf")
STATUS = {"attending": "Attending", "declined": "Declined", "pending": "Pending"}


def _guests(event_id: int):
    return db.q("""SELECT g.*, m.name AS meal_name, t.name AS table_name
                   FROM guests g
                   LEFT JOIN menu_items m ON m.id = g.meal_item_id
                   LEFT JOIN seat_assignments a ON a.guest_id = g.id
                   LEFT JOIN seating_tables t ON t.id = a.table_id
                   WHERE g.event_id = ?
                   ORDER BY g.last_name COLLATE NOCASE, g.first_name COLLATE NOCASE""", (event_id,))


def _csv(headers: list, rows: list) -> bytes:
    buf = io.StringIO()
    w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator="\r\n")
    w.writerow(headers)
    for r in rows:
        w.writerow(["" if v is None else _safe_cell(v) for v in r])
    return ("﻿" + buf.getvalue()).encode("utf-8")


def _safe_cell(v):
    """Neutralise spreadsheet formula injection in text cells."""
    if isinstance(v, str) and v[:1] in ("=", "+", "-", "@") and not v[1:].replace(".", "").isdigit():
        return "'" + v
    return v


def _subtitle(ev) -> str:
    bits = [events.title(ev)]
    if ev.get("event_date"):
        bits.append(fmt_date(ev["event_date"]))
    venue = (ev.get("venue") or {}).get("name")
    if venue:
        bits.append(venue)
    return " · ".join(bits)


def _party(g) -> int:
    return events.party_size(g) if g["status"] != "declined" else 0


def _totals(ev) -> list:
    s = events.stats(ev["id"])
    return [("Total invited", s["invited"]), ("Confirmed", s["attending"]), ("Declined", s["declined"]),
            ("Pending RSVPs", s["pending"]), ("Plus-ones attending", s["plus_ones"]),
            ("Children attending", s["children"]), ("Total headcount", s["headcount"]),
            ("RSVP completion", f"{s['completion']}%")]


def _table_rows(ev):
    tables = events.tables(ev["id"])
    seated = {}
    for r in db.q("""SELECT a.table_id, g.* FROM seat_assignments a JOIN guests g ON g.id = a.guest_id
                     WHERE a.event_id = ? ORDER BY g.last_name COLLATE NOCASE, g.first_name COLLATE NOCASE""", (ev["id"],)):
        seated.setdefault(r["table_id"], []).append(r)
    return tables, seated


def build(ev: dict, kind: str, fmt: str, user_id: Optional[int] = None, delivered: str = "download"):
    if kind not in KINDS or fmt not in FORMATS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown report")
    if not isinstance(ev, dict) or not isinstance(ev.get("venue"), dict):
        ev = events.by_id(ev["id"])
    title, _ = KINDS[kind]
    guests = _guests(ev["id"])
    filename = f"{ev['slug']}-{kind}.{fmt}"
    data = _BUILDERS[kind](ev, guests, fmt, title)
    if user_id is not None:
        db.insert("report_runs", {"event_id": ev["id"], "user_id": user_id, "kind": kind, "format": fmt,
                                  "delivered": delivered, "created_at": db.now()})
    ctype = "text/csv; charset=utf-8" if fmt == "csv" else "application/pdf"
    return filename, data, ctype


# --- builders ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _b_guests(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    headers = ["First name", "Last name", "Email", "Phone", "Category", "Family group", "Side", "VIP", "Child",
               "Status", "Plus-ones", "Children", "Party size", "Table", "Checked in"]
    rows = [[g["first_name"], g["last_name"], g["email"], g["phone"], g["category"], g["family_group"], g["side"],
             "Yes" if g["is_vip"] else "", "Yes" if g["is_child"] else "", STATUS[g["status"]], g["plus_ones"],
             g["children"], _party(g), g["table_name"] or "", "Yes" if g["checked_in_at"] else ""] for g in guests]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(headers, rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.kv(_totals(ev)[:4])
    doc.table(["Name", "Contact", "Category", "Status", "Party", "Table"],
              [[events.guest_name(g) + (" (VIP)" if g["is_vip"] else ""), g["email"] or g["phone"],
                " / ".join(x for x in (g["category"], g["family_group"]) if x), STATUS[g["status"]], _party(g),
                g["table_name"] or ""] for g in guests], [2.2, 2.4, 1.8, 1.1, .7, 1.2])
    return doc.output()


def _b_rsvp(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    headers = ["Name", "Status", "Responded", "Plus-ones", "Plus-one names", "Children", "Meal", "Dietary",
               "Allergies", "Special requests", "Source"]
    rows = [[events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], fmt_dt(g["responded_at"]), g["plus_ones"], g["plus_one_names"],
             g["children"], g["meal_name"] or "", g["dietary"], g["allergies"], g["special_requests"],
             {"general_link": "General link", "import": "Imported"}.get(g["source"], "Organiser")] for g in guests]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(headers, rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.kv(_totals(ev))
    for status in ("attending", "declined", "pending"):
        subset = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == status]
        doc.heading(f"{STATUS[status]} ({len(subset)})")
        doc.table(["Name", "Replied", "+1", "Kids", "Meal", "Notes"],
                  [[events.guest_name(g), fmt_dt(g["responded_at"]), g["plus_ones"] or "", g["children"] or "",
                    g["meal_name"] or "", "; ".join(x for x in (g["dietary"], g["allergies"], g["special_requests"]) if x)]
                   for g in subset], [2, 1.6, .5, .5, 1.6, 3])
    return doc.output()


def _b_seating(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    tables, seated = _table_rows(ev)
    if fmt == "csv":
        rows = []
        for t in tables:
            people = seated.get(t["id"], [])
            if not people:
                rows.append([t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], "", "", ""])
            for g in people:
                rows.append([t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], _party(g)])
        assigned = {g["id"] for ps in seated.values() for g in ps}
        for g in guests:
            if g["status"] == "attending" and g["id"] not in assigned:
                rows.append(["Unassigned", "", "", events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], _party(g)])
        return _csv(["Table", "Capacity", "Seated", "Guest", "Status", "Party size"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.table(["Table", "Capacity", "Seated", "Free"],
              [[t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], _free(t)] for t in tables],
              [3, 1, 1, 1])
    for t in tables:
        people = seated.get(t["id"], [])
        doc.heading(f"{t['name']}  ·  {t['seated']} of {t['capacity']}")
        if t["notes"]:
            doc.text(t["notes"], 9, muted=True)
        doc.table(["Guest", "Party", "Meal / dietary"],
                  [[events.guest_name(g) + (f" + {g['plus_one_names'] or g['plus_ones']}" if g["plus_ones"] else ""),
                    _party(g), "; ".join(x for x in (_meal(g), g["dietary"], g["allergies"]) if x)] for g in people],
                  [3, .8, 3])
    assigned = {g["id"] for ps in seated.values() for g in ps}
    loose = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending" and g["id"] not in assigned]
    if loose:
        doc.heading(f"Not yet seated ({len(loose)})")
        doc.table(["Guest", "Party"], [[events.guest_name(g), _party(g)] for g in loose], [4, 1])
    return doc.output()


def _free(t) -> str:
    free = t["capacity"] - t["seated"]
    return str(free) if free >= 0 else f"Over by {-free}"


def _att(g, key):
    return (g[key] or "") if g["status"] == "attending" else ""


def _meal(g):
    try:
        return g["meal_name"] or ""
    except (IndexError, KeyError):
        row = db.one("SELECT name FROM menu_items WHERE id = ?", (g["meal_item_id"],)) if g["meal_item_id"] else None
        return row["name"] if row else ""


def _b_dietary(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    subset = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending" and (g["dietary"] or g["allergies"])]
    rows = [[events.guest_name(g), g["dietary"], g["allergies"], g["meal_name"] or "", g["table_name"] or ""] for g in subset]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(["Guest", "Dietary requirements", "Allergies", "Meal", "Table"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    counts = Counter()
    for g in subset:
        for part in (g["dietary"] or "").split(","):
            if part.strip():
                counts[part.strip()] += 1
    if counts:
        doc.kv([(k, v) for k, v in counts.most_common()])
    doc.table(["Guest", "Dietary", "Allergies", "Meal", "Table"], rows, [2, 2, 2, 1.6, 1])
    return doc.output()


def _b_meals(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    attending = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending"]
    counts = Counter(g["meal_name"] or "No selection" for g in attending)
    options = [m["name"] for m in events.meal_options(ev["id"])]
    for o in options:
        counts.setdefault(o, 0)
    if fmt == "csv":
        rows = [["Count", k, v, ""] for k, v in sorted(counts.items())]
        rows += [["Guest", events.guest_name(g), g["meal_name"] or "No selection", g["dietary"]] for g in attending]
        return _csv(["Row type", "Name", "Meal / count", "Dietary"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    doc.heading("Totals")
    doc.kv([(k, v) for k, v in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])])
    doc.heading("By guest")
    doc.table(["Guest", "Meal", "Dietary", "Table"],
              [[events.guest_name(g), g["meal_name"] or "No selection", g["dietary"], g["table_name"] or ""] for g in attending],
              [2, 2, 2, 1])
    return doc.output()


def _b_outstanding(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    subset = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "pending"]
    rows = [[events.guest_name(g), g["email"], g["phone"], g["category"], g["family_group"], fmt_dt(g["invited_at"]),
             events.invite_url(ev, g)] for g in subset]
    if fmt == "csv":
        return _csv(["Guest", "Email", "Phone", "Category", "Family group", "Invited", "Personal link"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    deadline = (ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("rsvp_deadline")
    doc.text(f"{len(subset)} guests haven't replied." + (f" RSVP deadline: {fmt_date(deadline)}." if deadline else ""))
    doc.table(["Guest", "Email", "Phone", "Group"], [r[:4] for r in rows], [2, 2.6, 1.6, 1.4])
    return doc.output()


def _b_final(ev, guests, fmt, title):
    tables, seated = _table_rows(ev)
    attending = [g for g in guests if g["status"] == "attending"]
    meal_counts = Counter(g["meal_name"] or "No selection" for g in attending)
    if fmt == "csv":
        rows = [["Summary", k, v, "", "", "", "", "", ""] for k, v in _totals(ev)]
        rows += [["Meal total", k, v, "", "", "", "", "", ""] for k, v in sorted(meal_counts.items())]
        rows += [["Table", t["name"], f"{t['seated']} of {t['capacity']}", "", "", "", "", "", ""] for t in tables]
        rows += [["Guest", events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], g["plus_ones"], g["children"], g["meal_name"] or "",
                  "; ".join(x for x in (g["dietary"], g["allergies"]) if x), g["special_requests"], g["table_name"] or ""]
                 for g in guests]
        return _csv(["Section", "Name", "Status / value", "Plus-ones", "Children", "Meal", "Dietary and allergies",
                     "Special requests", "Table"], rows)
    doc = PDF(title, _subtitle(ev))
    venue = ev.get("venue") or {}
    doc.kv([("Event", ev["name"]), ("Date", fmt_date(ev.get("event_date")) or "To be confirmed"),
            ("Time", " to ".join(x for x in (fmt_time(ev.get("start_time")), fmt_time(ev.get("end_time"))) if x) or "To be confirmed"),
            ("Venue", ", ".join(x for x in (venue.get("name"), venue.get("address")) if x) or "To be confirmed")])
    doc.heading("Totals")
    doc.kv(_totals(ev))
    doc.heading("Meal selections")
    doc.kv([(k, v) for k, v in sorted(meal_counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])] or [("Meals", "No selections yet")])
    if catalog.has_feature(ev, "detailed_reports"):
        doc.heading("By guest category")
        cats = Counter((g["category"] or "Uncategorised") for g in attending)
        doc.kv([(k, f"{v} attending") for k, v in cats.most_common()] or [("Categories", "None")])
    doc.heading("Table occupancy")
    doc.table(["Table", "Capacity", "Seated", "Free"],
              [[t["name"], t["capacity"], t["seated"], _free(t)] for t in tables], [3, 1, 1, 1])
    doc.heading("Guests")
    doc.table(["Guest", "Status", "+1", "Kids", "Meal", "Dietary / allergies", "Requests", "Table"],
              [[events.guest_name(g), STATUS[g["status"]], _att(g, "plus_ones"), _att(g, "children"), g["meal_name"] or "",
                "; ".join(x for x in (g["dietary"], g["allergies"]) if x), g["special_requests"], g["table_name"] or ""]
               for g in guests], [1.8, 1, .45, .6, 1.3, 1.6, 1.6, 1])
    return doc.output()


_BUILDERS = {"guests": _b_guests, "rsvp": _b_rsvp, "seating": _b_seating, "dietary": _b_dietary,
             "meals": _b_meals, "outstanding": _b_outstanding, "final": _b_final}


def final_attachments(ev, user_id: Optional[int] = None) -> list:
    out = []
    for fmt in ("pdf", "csv"):
        name, data, ctype = build(ev, "final", fmt, user_id=user_id, delivered="email")
        out.append((name, data, ctype.split(";")[0]))
    return out
```

### `app/services/scheduler.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/scheduler.py sha256=2082913fa91ad7ec75a73cf584dcad41ce87c9a040882d5c56a61ccfcd91d419 nl=1 -->
```python
"""Background jobs: RSVP summaries, reminders, post-event reports, hosting expiry, clean-up.

`loop()` runs in a daemon thread started by run.py. `run_once(today)` does one pass and is
safe to repeat: every email is guarded by a sent_markers row (event_id, marker), so a job that
already ran for a period, guest or date never sends twice. Demo events never get emails and
suspended events are skipped entirely.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import sys
import time
import traceback
from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import Optional

from .. import catalog, config, db, events, notify
from . import email as mail


def mark(event_id: int, marker: str) -> bool:
    """Claim a marker. True the first time (go ahead and send), False if already claimed."""
    try:
        cur = db.connect().execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sent_markers (event_id, marker, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (event_id, marker, db.now()))
        return cur.rowcount == 1
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return False


def _date(value) -> Optional[date]:
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(str(value)[:10])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _email_events() -> list:
    rows = db.q("SELECT * FROM events WHERE is_demo = 0 AND status != 'suspended' AND paid_package IS NOT NULL")
    return [events.parse(r) for r in rows]


def _summaries(ev, today: date) -> int:
    prefs = ev.get("report_prefs") or {}
    freq = prefs.get("summary", "none")
    event_day = _date(ev.get("event_date"))
    if not events.is_live(ev) or freq not in ("daily", "weekly") or (event_day and event_day < today):
        return 0
    if freq == "daily":
        marker, since = f"summary-d-{today.isoformat()}", today - timedelta(days=1)
    else:
        if today.weekday() != 0:
            return 0
        y, w, _ = today.isocalendar()
        marker, since = f"summary-w-{y}-{w:02d}", today - timedelta(days=7)
    if not mark(ev["id"], marker):
        return 0
    st = events.stats(ev["id"])
    new_count = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rsvp_responses WHERE event_id = ? AND created_at >= ?",
                       (ev["id"], since.isoformat()), 0)
    notify.organiser(ev, "rsvp_summary", {"summary_table": notify.summary_table_html(st),
                                          "completion": st["completion"], "new_count": new_count})
    return 1


def _outstanding(ev, today: date) -> int:
    deadline = _date((ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("rsvp_deadline"))
    if not deadline or not events.is_live(ev):
        return 0
    days = (deadline - today).days
    if days not in (7, 2):
        return 0
    st = events.stats(ev["id"])
    if st["pending"] <= 0 or not mark(ev["id"], f"outstanding-{days}-{deadline.isoformat()}"):
        return 0
    notify.organiser(ev, "outstanding_reminder", {"pending": st["pending"]})
    return 1


def _auto_guest_reminders(ev, today: date) -> int:
    prefs = ev.get("report_prefs") or {}
    if not prefs.get("auto_reminders") or not events.is_live(ev) or not catalog.has_feature(ev, "reminders", public=True):
        return 0
    deadline = _date((ev.get("guest_settings") or {}).get("rsvp_deadline"))
    if not deadline or not (0 <= (deadline - today).days <= 5):
        return 0
    used, allowed = events.email_quota(ev)
    sent = 0
    base = notify.event_vars(ev)
    for g in db.q("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id", (ev["id"],)):
        if used >= allowed:
            break
        if not notify.can_email_guest(g):
            continue
        if not mark(ev["id"], f"auto-remind-{g['id']}"):
            continue
        result = mail.send(g["email"], "guest_reminder", {**base, **notify.guest_vars(ev, g)},
                           event_id=ev["id"], guest_id=g["id"], batch_id=f"auto-{today.isoformat()}")
        if result["status"] == "sent":
            used += 1
            sent += 1
    return sent


def _event_reminders(ev, today: date) -> int:
    event_day = _date(ev.get("event_date"))
    if not event_day:
        return 0
    days = (event_day - today).days
    if days not in (7, 1) or not mark(ev["id"], f"event-reminder-{days}-{event_day.isoformat()}"):
        return 0
    text = "Tomorrow" if days == 1 else f"{days} days to go"
    lower = "tomorrow" if days == 1 else f"in {days} days"
    notify.organiser(ev, "event_reminder", {"days_text": text, "days_text_lower": lower})
    return 1


def _next_steps(ev, today: date) -> int:
    """From the day after the website goes live (for a week): what's left to do, if anything. The same list
    the dashboard shows, so a client who has already shared their link and seen replies gets no email."""
    published = _date(ev.get("published_at"))
    if not events.is_live(ev) or not published or not (1 <= (today - published).days <= 7):
        return 0
    from ..views.dashboard import next_steps
    steps = [(t, w, config.BASE_URL + href, link) for t, w, href, link in next_steps(ev)[:3]]
    if not steps or not mark(ev["id"], "next-steps"):
        return 0
    notify.organiser(ev, "setup_instructions", {"steps": notify.steps_html(steps)}, owner_only=True)
    return 1


def _post_event(ev, today: date) -> int:
    event_day = _date(ev.get("event_date"))
    if not event_day or not (1 <= (today - event_day).days <= 3):
        return 0
    if not mark(ev["id"], "post-event"):
        return 0
    attachments = []
    try:
        from . import reports  # built by the organiser-dashboard module
        attachments = list(reports.final_attachments(ev) or [])
    except ImportError:
        attachments = []
    except Exception:  # a broken report must not stop the email
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        attachments = []
    st = events.stats(ev["id"])
    notify.organiser(ev, "post_event", {"summary_table": notify.summary_table_html(st)}, attachments=attachments)
    return 1


def _expire_hosting(today: date) -> int:
    rows = db.q("SELECT id, uid FROM events WHERE status = 'published' AND hosting_until IS NOT NULL AND hosting_until < ?",
                (today.isoformat(),))
    for r in rows:
        events.touch(r["id"], status="unpublished")
        db.insert("audit_log", {"actor_id": None, "action": "event.hosting_expired", "target": r["uid"], "meta": "{}",
                                "created_at": db.now()})
    return len(rows)


def _prune() -> int:
    now = db.now()
    c = db.connect()
    n = c.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < ?", (now,)).rowcount
    n += c.execute("DELETE FROM user_tokens WHERE expires_at < ? OR used_at IS NOT NULL", (now,)).rowcount
    return n


JOBS = [("next_steps", _next_steps), ("summaries", _summaries), ("outstanding", _outstanding), ("guest_reminders", _auto_guest_reminders),
        ("event_reminders", _event_reminders), ("post_event", _post_event)]


def run_once(today: Optional[date] = None) -> dict:
    today = today or date.today()
    counts = {name: 0 for name, _ in JOBS}
    for ev in _email_events():
        for name, job in JOBS:
            try:
                counts[name] += job(ev, today)
            except Exception:
                print(f"[scheduler] {name} failed for event {ev['uid']}", file=sys.stderr)
                traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
    counts["hosting_expired"] = _expire_hosting(today)
    counts["pruned"] = _prune()
    return counts


def loop() -> None:
    while True:
        try:
            counts = run_once()
            if any(counts.values()) and config.DEBUG:
                print(f"[scheduler] {counts}", file=sys.stderr)
        except Exception:
            traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        time.sleep(max(30, config.SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS))
```

### `app/services/storage.py`

<!-- FILE: app/services/storage.py sha256=db342dbe8cfed37515d9aa378b2f5bf903439a6a64e831cf59a9410ff6a9e7eb nl=1 -->
```python
"""Image uploads behind a storage interface.

`LocalStorage` keeps files under data/uploads/. A cloud backend (S3, R2, GCS) only needs the
same three methods; set STORAGE_BACKEND once one is added. Files are validated by their
leading bytes (not the browser's claimed type), size-limited and stored under random names.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import secrets
from typing import Optional

from .. import config, db

SIGNATURES = [
    (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "image/png", "png"),
    (b"\xff\xd8\xff", "image/jpeg", "jpg"),
    (b"GIF87a", "image/gif", "gif"),
    (b"GIF89a", "image/gif", "gif"),
]


class UploadError(Exception):
    pass


def sniff(data: bytes) -> Optional[tuple[str, str]]:
    for sig, mime, ext in SIGNATURES:
        if data.startswith(sig):
            return mime, ext
    if data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP":
        return "image/webp", "webp"
    return None


class LocalStorage:
    root = config.UPLOAD_DIR

    def put(self, key: str, data: bytes) -> None:
        path = (self.root / key).resolve()
        path.relative_to(self.root.resolve())
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(data)

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
        path = (self.root / key).resolve()
        try:
            path.relative_to(self.root.resolve())
        except ValueError:
            return None
        return path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None

    def delete(self, key: str) -> None:
        path = (self.root / key).resolve()
        try:
            path.relative_to(self.root.resolve())
        except ValueError:
            return
        if path.is_file():
            path.unlink()


storage = LocalStorage()


def save_image(upload, event, user_id: Optional[int], kind: str, caption: str = "") -> dict:
    if upload is None or not upload.data:
        raise UploadError("Choose an image to upload.")
    if upload.size > config.MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:
        raise UploadError(f"Images must be {config.MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES // (1024 * 1024)} MB or smaller.")
    kind_info = sniff(upload.data)
    if not kind_info:
        raise UploadError("Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.")
    mime, ext = kind_info
    key = f"{event['uid']}/{kind}-{secrets.token_hex(10)}.{ext}"
    storage.put(key, upload.data)
    sort = db.val("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort), 0) + 1 FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ? AND kind = ?",
                  (event["id"], kind), 1)
    up_id = db.insert("uploads", {"event_id": event["id"], "user_id": user_id, "kind": kind, "storage_key": key,
                                  "mime": mime, "size": upload.size, "caption": caption[:200], "sort": sort,
                                  "created_at": db.now()})
    return dict(db.one("SELECT * FROM uploads WHERE id = ?", (up_id,)))


def delete_upload(upload_id: int, event_id: int) -> bool:
    row = db.one("SELECT * FROM uploads WHERE id = ? AND event_id = ?", (upload_id, event_id))
    if not row:
        return False
    storage.delete(row["storage_key"])
    db.run("DELETE FROM uploads WHERE id = ?", (upload_id,))
    return True
```

```python
"""Stock photos for the marketing pages and the template samples.

Drop a photo into static/img/stock/ under one of these names and it is used automatically; until then
the line drawings and colour washes stay. Sample gallery photos go in static/img/stock/gallery/<slot>/.
`python3 tools/add_photos.py PHOTOS_FOLDER_OR_ZIP` resizes and files them for you. Keep each photo under about 250 KB (1600px wide, JPEG).
Record where each photo came from and its licence in CREDITS below (Unsplash and Pexels photos are free
for commercial use without attribution, but keeping the source makes them easy to check or replace).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "static" / "img" / "stock"

SLOTS = {
    "weddings": "Couple at a South African wedding (home page tile, wedding template samples)",
    "traditional": "Traditional or lobola celebration (traditional template samples)",
    "baby": "Baby shower or new parents (home page tile, baby template samples)",
    "parties": "Birthday or dinner party (home page tile, party template samples)",
    "other": "Graduation, family gathering or corporate event (home page tile, other samples)",
}

CREDITS: dict = {}   # slot -> "Photographer, source link, licence"


def url(slot: str) -> str:
    """Web path of the photo for `slot`, or "" when none has been added yet."""
    for ext in ("jpg", "jpeg", "webp", "png"):
        if (DIR / f"{slot}.{ext}").is_file():
            return f"/static/img/stock/{slot}.{ext}"
    return ""


def gallery(slot: str) -> list[str]:
    """Web paths of the sample gallery photos for `slot` (static/img/stock/gallery/<slot>/), sorted by name."""
    folder = DIR / "gallery" / slot
    if not folder.is_dir():
        return []
    return [f"/static/img/stock/gallery/{slot}/{f.name}" for f in sorted(folder.iterdir())
            if f.suffix.lower() in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".png")]
```

}
PROGRAMME_FOR = {"white-wedding": "wedding", "multi-day-wedding": "wedding"}
DEFAULT_START = {"weddings": "14:00", "baby": "11:00", "parties": "18:00", "other": "10:00"}


# How the automatic event name reads: "<names>'s <noun>". Occasions not listed use the names as typed
# (party and corporate names are usually typed in full, e.g. "Kagiso's 40th").
NAME_NOUN = {"white-wedding": "wedding", "traditional-wedding": "wedding", "multi-day-wedding": "wedding",
             "lobola": "lobola celebration", "engagement": "engagement party", "baby-shower": "baby shower",
             "gender-reveal": "gender reveal", "welcome-baby": "baby welcome", "graduation": "graduation celebration"}


def auto_event_name(category: str, hosts: str) -> str:
    hosts = (hosts or "").strip()
    noun = NAME_NOUN.get(category)
    if not hosts or not noun:
        return hosts
    return f"{hosts}' {noun}" if hosts.endswith("s") and not hosts.endswith("'s") else f"{hosts}'s {noun}"


def wording_options(category: str) -> list[dict]:
    return WORDING.get(category) or WORDING["private-celebration"]


def fill_wording(text: str, hosts: str, deadline: str) -> str:
    """Put the names and RSVP date into a suggestion. Without a deadline, drop "by {deadline}"."""
    text = text.replace("{hosts}", hosts or "the hosts")
    if deadline:
        return text.replace("{deadline}", deadline)
    return re.sub(r"\s*by \{deadline\}", "", text).replace("{deadline}", "")


def programme_key(category: str) -> str:
    key = PROGRAMME_FOR.get(category, category)
    return key if key in PROGRAMMES else "private-celebration"


def sample_programme(category: str, start: str = "", group: str = "") -> list[dict]:
    """Programme items with real clock times, counted from the start time (or a sensible default)."""
    start = start if re.match(r"^\d{2}:\d{2}$", start or "") else DEFAULT_START.get(group, "12:00")
    base = int(start[:2]) * 60 + int(start[3:])
    out = []
    for offset, title, kind, detail in PROGRAMMES[programme_key(category)]:
        t = (base + offset) % (24 * 60)
        out.append({"item_time": f"{t // 60:02d}:{t % 60:02d}", "title": title, "kind": kind, "description": detail})
    return out


# --- pasted guest list ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_EMAIL = re.compile(r"[^@\s,;<>]+@[^@\s,;<>]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}")
_PHONE = re.compile(r"\+?\d[\d ()-]{6,}\d")
_HEADER_WORDS = {"name", "names", "full name", "guest", "guests", "guest name", "first name", "surname", "last name",
                 "phone", "mobile", "cell", "cellphone", "phone number", "whatsapp", "email", "e-mail", "email address"}


def _sa_phone(p: str) -> str:
    """Excel drops the leading 0 of SA mobiles (821234567); put it back."""
    d = re.sub(r"\D", "", p or "")
    return "0" + d if len(d) == 9 and d[0] in "678" and not (p or "").strip().startswith("+") else (p or "").strip()


def parse_guest_list(text: str, limit: int = 2000) -> list[dict]:
    """One guest per line, in any order: name, mobile, email (commas, tabs or semicolons between).
    Copying rows from Excel or Google Sheets works too. A header row is skipped. A line that ends with
    a colon ("Mokoena family:") is a group heading for the names below it, until the next heading."""
    out, seen, group = [], set(), ""
    for raw in (text or "").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip().strip(",;\t")
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.endswith(":") and not _EMAIL.search(line) and not _PHONE.search(line):
            group = line[:-1].strip()[:60]
            continue
        cells = [c.strip().lower() for c in re.split(r"[,;\t|]+", line) if c.strip()]
        if cells and all(c in _HEADER_WORDS for c in cells):
            continue
        email = _EMAIL.search(line)
        rest = line.replace(email.group(0), " ") if email else line
        phone = _PHONE.search(rest)
        rest = rest.replace(phone.group(0), " ") if phone else rest
        name = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"[,;\t|]+", " ", rest)).strip(" -")
        if not name:
            continue
        key = (name.lower(), email.group(0).lower() if email else "")
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append({"name": name[:120], "phone": _sa_phone(phone.group(0)) if phone else "",
                    "email": email.group(0).lower() if email else "", "group": group})
        if len(out) >= limit:
            break
    return out


_COLS = {"name": ("name", "full name", "guest", "guest name", "names", "guest names"), "first": ("first name", "first", "firstname", "given name"),
         "last": ("surname", "last name", "last", "lastname", "family name"),
         "phone": ("phone", "mobile", "cell", "cellphone", "whatsapp", "number", "phone number", "mobile number", "contact", "tel"),
         "email": ("email", "e-mail", "email address", "mail"), "group": ("family", "family group", "group", "side", "household")}


def parse_sheet(rows: list, limit: int = 2000) -> list[dict]:
    """Rows from a spreadsheet. With a header row (Name / Surname / Mobile / Email / Family), columns are
    matched by heading; without one, each row is read like a pasted line."""
    rows = [[str(c or "").strip() for c in r] for r in rows if any(str(c or "").strip() for c in r)]
    if not rows:
        return []
    head = [c.lower() for c in rows[0]]
    col = {k: next((n for n, h in enumerate(head) if h in words), None) for k, words in _COLS.items()}
    if col["name"] is None and col["first"] is None:
        return parse_guest_list("\n".join(", ".join(c for c in r if c) for r in rows), limit)
    out, seen = [], set()
    get = lambda r, k: r[col[k]] if col[k] is not None and col[k] < len(r) else ""
    for r in rows[1:]:
        name = get(r, "name") or get(r, "first")
        last = get(r, "last")
        if last and last.lower() not in name.lower():          # "Name" + "Surname" columns
            name = f"{name} {last}"
        name = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", name).strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        email = (_EMAIL.search(get(r, "email")) or [""])[0].lower() if get(r, "email") else ""
        key = (name.lower(), email)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append({"name": name[:120], "phone": _sa_phone(get(r, "phone")), "email": email, "group": get(r, "group")[:60]})
        if len(out) >= limit:
            break
    return out


def read_sheet_file(data: bytes, filename: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    """Rows from an uploaded .csv or .xlsx (Excel, Google Sheets download). First sheet only."""
    import csv
    import io
    import zipfile
    from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
    if data[:2] == b"PK":
        ns = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
            names = z.namelist()
            shared = []
            if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
                for si in ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml")).findall("m:si", ns):
                    shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{%s}t" % ns["m"])))
            sheets = sorted(n for n in names if re.match(r"xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml$", n))
            if not sheets:
                raise ValueError("That Excel file has no sheets.")
            first = "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" if "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" in sheets else sheets[0]
            out = []
            for row in ET.fromstring(z.read(first)).iter("{%s}row" % ns["m"]):
                cells = {}
                for c in row.findall("m:c", ns):
                    ref = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)", c.get("r", "A"))
                    colno = 0
                    for ch in ref.group(1):
                        colno = colno * 26 + ord(ch) - 64
                    t, v = c.get("t"), c.find("m:v", ns)
                    if t == "s" and v is not None:
                        val = shared[int(v.text)] if v.text and v.text.isdigit() and int(v.text) < len(shared) else ""
                    elif t == "inlineStr":
                        val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in c.iter("{%s}t" % ns["m"]))
                    else:
                        val = v.text if v is not None and v.text else ""
                        if re.match(r"^\d+\.0$", val):
                            val = val[:-2]
                    cells[colno] = val
                if cells:
                    out.append([cells.get(n, "") for n in range(1, max(cells) + 1)])
            return out
    try:
        text = data.decode("utf-8-sig")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        text = data.decode("cp1252", "replace")
    dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(text[:2000], delimiters=",;\t") if text.strip() else csv.excel
    return [r for r in csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), dialect)]


# --- pasted menu -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_COURSE_WORDS = {
    "Canapés": ("canapé", "canape", "canapés", "canapes", "snacks", "hors d'oeuvres", "on arrival"),
    "Starter": ("starter", "starters", "entrée", "entree", "entrées", "appetiser", "appetisers", "appetizer", "appetizers", "first course"),
    "Main": ("main", "mains", "main course", "main courses", "buffet", "main meal"),
    "Dessert": ("dessert", "desserts", "pudding", "sweet", "sweets"),
    "Late-night": ("late-night", "late night", "late night snack", "midnight snack"),
    "Drinks": ("drinks", "beverages", "bar"),
}


def _course_of(word: str) -> str:
    w = word.strip().strip(":").strip().lower()
    for course, words in _COURSE_WORDS.items():
        if w in words:
            return course
    return ""


def parse_menu(text: str, limit: int = 60) -> list[dict]:
    """Turn a caterer's menu into dishes. A line that is only a course name ("Starters") sets the course
    for the lines below it; "Main: Lamb shank - rosemary jus" sets it inline. Text after " - ", " – " or
    " with " in brackets becomes the description."""
    items, course = [], "Main"
    for raw in (text or "").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip().lstrip("•*-·– ").strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        c = _course_of(line)
        if c:
            course = c
            continue
        m = re.match(r"^([^:]{2,30}):\s*(.+)$", line)
        this_course = course
        if m and _course_of(m.group(1)):
            this_course, line = _course_of(m.group(1)), m.group(2).strip()
            course = this_course
        name, desc = line, ""
        for sep in (" - ", " – ", " — ", " | "):
            if sep in line:
                name, desc = (s.strip() for s in line.split(sep, 1))
                break
        else:
            b = re.match(r"^(.+?)\s*\((.+)\)$", line)
            if b:
                name, desc = b.group(1).strip(), b.group(2).strip()
        if name:
            items.append({"course": this_course, "name": name[:120], "description": desc[:240], "tags": [], "selectable": False})
        if len(items) >= limit:
            break
    return items


# --- programme item type, guessed from its title (the client never picks a "type") ---------------------
KIND_WORDS = [
    ("meal", ("dinner", "lunch", "breakfast", "brunch", "meal", "food", "starter", "main course", "dessert", "cake", "canap",
              "braai", "buffet", "tea", "supper", "snack")),
    ("ceremony", ("ceremony", "vows", "wedding", "negotiation", "lobola", "blessing", "prayer", "unveiling", "graduation",
                  "church", "service", "ritual", "exchange of gifts", "umembeso", "umabo")),
    ("speech", ("speech", "toast", "welcome", "remarks", "introduction", "thanks", "keynote", "panel", "announcement")),
    ("entertainment", ("dance", "music", "dj", "band", "entertainment", "party", "reveal", "performance", "choir", "show")),
    ("reception", ("reception", "seated", "drinks", "cocktail", "arrival of the couple", "entrance")),
    ("activity", ("photo", "games", "gift", "workshop", "registration", "tour")),
]


def guess_kind(title: str) -> str:
    t = (title or "").lower()
    for kind, words in KIND_WORDS:
        if any(w in t for w in words):
            return kind
    return "other"
