```python
# --- categories ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _category_fields(vals: dict, errors: dict, new: bool) -> str:
    slug_field = field("slug", "Slug (used in links, can't change later)", vals.get("slug", ""), required=True, errors=errors,
                       attrs={"pattern": "[a-z0-9-]+", "maxlength": 60}) if new else ""
    return f"""<div class="form-row form-row--2">{slug_field}{field("name", "Name", vals.get("name", ""), required=True, errors=errors)}
{select("group_slug", "Group", [(k, g["name"]) for k, g in catalog.GROUPS.items()], vals.get("group_slug", "weddings"), required=True, errors=errors)}
{field("sort", "Order", vals.get("sort", 0), type="number", errors=errors)}</div>
{field("description", "Description", vals.get("description", ""), errors=errors)}
{field("features", "Feature hints (comma separated)", vals.get("features", ""), errors=errors, hint="Known hints: family_sides, multi_function, seating, menu, registry")}
{switch("active", "Available for new events", bool(vals.get("active", True)))}"""


def _category_vals(req, f: Form, new: bool) -> dict:
    vals = {"name": f.text("name", "Name", required=True, max=60),
            "group_slug": f.choice("group_slug", catalog.GROUPS.keys(), "Group", required=True),
            "sort": f.integer("sort", "Order", min=0, max=1000), "description": f.text("description", "Description", max=300),
            "features": req.get("features"), "active": f.flag("active")}
    if new:
        slug = f.text("slug", "Slug", required=True, max=60).lower()
        vals["slug"] = slug
        if slug and not SLUG_RE.match(slug):
            f.error("slug", "Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.")
        elif slug and catalog.category(slug):
            f.error("slug", "That slug is already used.")
    return vals


@router.route("/admin/categories", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def categories(req):
    admin = auth.require_admin(req)
    errors, vals = {}, {"active": True}
    if req.method == "POST":
        f = Form(req)
        vals = _category_vals(req, f, new=True)
        if f.ok:
            feats = [x.strip() for x in vals["features"].split(",") if x.strip()]
            db.insert("categories", {"slug": vals["slug"], "name": vals["name"], "group_slug": vals["group_slug"],
                                     "description": vals["description"], "features": db.dumps(feats), "sort": vals["sort"],
                                     "active": 1 if vals["active"] else 0})
            auth.audit(admin["id"], "category.create", vals["slug"])
            req.flash("success", f"{vals['name']} added.")
            return redirect("/admin/categories")
        errors = f.errors
    used = {r["category"]: r["n"] for r in db.q("SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events GROUP BY category")}
    rows = [[f'<a href="/admin/categories/{esc(c["slug"])}">{esc(c["name"])}</a><span class="table__sub">{esc(c["slug"])}</span>',
             esc(catalog.GROUPS.get(c["group_slug"], {}).get("name", c["group_slug"])), esc(", ".join(db.loads(c["features"], [])) or "—"),
             _pill("ok", "Active") if c["active"] else _pill("cancelled", "Hidden"), str(used.get(c["slug"], 0)), str(c["sort"])]
            for c in catalog.categories(active_only=False)]
    body = (page_head("Event categories", "Categories drive the wizard's form hints and the category pages.")
            + _table(["Category", "Group", "Hints", "Status", ">Events", ">Order"], rows)
            + f'<section class="box" style="margin-top:var(--gap)" id="add"><div class="box__head"><h2>Add a category</h2></div>'
              f'{errors_summary(errors)}<form method="post" class="form" action="/admin/categories#add">{csrf(req)}{_category_fields(vals, errors, True)}'
              f'<div><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Add category</button></div></form></section>')

@router.route("/admin/categories/<slug:slug>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def category_edit(req, slug):

    vals = {"name": c["name"], "group_slug": c["group_slug"], "sort": c["sort"], "description": c["description"],
            "features": ", ".join(db.loads(c["features"], [])), "active": bool(c["active"])}
    if req.method == "POST":
        f = Form(req)
        vals = _category_vals(req, f, new=False)

            req.flash("success", f"{vals['name']} saved.")

              f'<div><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Save category</button></div></form>')
    resp = _page(req, c["name"], body, "/admin/categories")
    return Response(resp, status=400) if errors else resp

_VARS = re.compile(r"\{\{\{?\s*(\w+)\s*\}?\}\}")


def sample_vars() -> dict:
    base = config.BASE_URL
    dash = f"{base}/dashboard/events/sample"
    stats = {"invited": 150, "attending": 86, "declined": 9, "pending": 55, "plus_ones": 14, "children": 6, "headcount": 106}
    return {
        "first_name": "Thandi", "name": "Thandi", "event_name": "Sarah & John's Wedding", "hosts": "Sarah & John",
        "event_date": "Saturday, 12 December 2026", "start_time": "14:00", "venue_name": "The Glasshouse",
        "venue_address": "12 Oak Avenue, Johannesburg", "public_url": f"{base}/events/sarah-and-john",
        "dashboard_url": dash, "rsvp_url": dash + "/rsvps", "share_url": dash + "/share", "reports_url": dash + "/reports",
        "seating_url": dash + "/seating", "comms_url": dash + "/communications", "remind_url": dash + "/communications",
        "verify_url": f"{base}/verify/sample", "reset_url": f"{base}/reset-password/sample", "receipt_url": f"{base}/dashboard/billing",
        "guest_first": "Lerato", "guest_name": "Lerato Dlamini", "invite_url": f"{base}/events/sarah-and-john/i/sample",
        "unsubscribe_url": f"{base}/events/sarah-and-john/u/sample", "deadline": "Friday, 20 November 2026",
        "package": "Premium Experience", "amount": "R12,999.00", "invoice_no": "AUR-2026-0001", "order_ref": "ord_sample",
        "status_text": "is attending", "attending": 86, "declined": 9, "pending": 55, "completion": 63, "new_count": 12,
        "days_to_go": "26 days to go", "tables": 15, "seated": 142, "days_text": "7 days to go", "days_text_lower": "in 7 days",
        "hosting_until": "Saturday, 11 September 2027", "inviter": "Thandi Mokoena", "ref": "SR-1042", "priority_note": "",
        "message": "Could you help me change my event date?", "subject": "A note from Sarah & John",
        "message_html": "<p style='margin:0 0 18px'>We can't wait to celebrate with you.</p>",
        "details": "<table role='presentation' cellpadding='0' cellspacing='0' style='margin:0 0 18px'><tr><td style='padding:6px 12px 6px 0;color:#625D5E'>Meal</td><td>Roast lamb</td></tr></table>",
        "summary_table": notify.summary_table_html(stats),
        "steps": notify.steps_html([("Send your invitations", "150 guests haven't been sent their invitation yet. Send them on WhatsApp, one tap each.",
                                     dash + "/share/whatsapp", "Start sending")]),
    }


def _template_vars(*texts: str) -> list[str]:
    seen = []
    for t in texts:
        for m in _VARS.finditer(t or ""):
            if m.group(1) not in seen:
                seen.append(m.group(1))
    return seen


def _preview_vars(subject: str, body: str) -> dict:
    v = sample_vars()
    for name in _template_vars(subject, body):
        v.setdefault(name, f"[{name}]")
    return v


def _sandboxed(html: str) -> Response:
    r = Response(html)
    r.header("Content-Security-Policy", "sandbox; default-src 'none'; img-src * data:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'")
    r.header("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN")
    r.header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    return r


@router.get("/admin/emails")
def emails_list(req):

    sections = []
    for aud, title in (("organiser", "To organisers"), ("guest", "To guests"), ("system", "System")):
        rows = [[f'<a href="/admin/emails/{esc(t["key"])}">{esc(t["name"])}</a><span class="table__sub mono">{esc(t["key"])}</span>',
                 esc(t["subject"]), _pill("ok", "On") if t["active"] else _pill("cancelled", "Off"), str(sent.get(t["key"], 0)),
                 esc(fmt_dt(t["updated_at"]))]
                for t in db.q("SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE audience = ? ORDER BY name", (aud,))]
        if rows:
            sections.append(f'<section class="box" style="margin-bottom:var(--gap)"><div class="box__head"><h2>{title}</h2></div>'

@router.route("/admin/emails/<key>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def email_edit(req, key):
    admin = auth.require_admin(req)
    t = mail.template(key)
    if not t:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    errors = {}
    subject, body_txt, active = t["subject"], t["body"], bool(t["active"])
    if req.method == "POST":
        f = Form(req)
        subject = f.text("subject", "Subject", required=True, max=200)
        body_txt = (req.form.get("body") or [""])[0].replace("\r\n", "\n").strip()
        if not body_txt:
            f.error("body", "Body is required.")
        elif len(body_txt) > 10000:
            f.error("body", "Body must be 10,000 characters or fewer.")
        active = f.flag("active")
        if f.ok:
            db.run("UPDATE email_templates SET subject = ?, body = ?, active = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE key = ?",
                   (subject, body_txt, 1 if active else 0, db.now(), key))
            auth.audit(admin["id"], "email_template.update", key, active=active)
            req.flash("success", "Email template saved.")
            return redirect(f"/admin/emails/{key}")
        errors = f.errors
    default = mail.DEFAULT_TEMPLATES.get(key)
    variables = _template_vars(default[2] + default[3] if default else "", subject, body_txt)
    var_list = "".join(f'<li><code class="mono">{{{{{esc(v)}}}}}</code></li>' for v in variables) or "<li>None</li>"
    reset = (_post_button(f"/admin/emails/{key}/reset", "Restore default wording", req, "btn btn--ghost btn--sm",
                          "Replace the current subject and body with the original wording?") if default else "")
    form = f"""{errors_summary(errors)}<form method="post" class="form" id="email-form">{csrf(req)}
{field("subject", "Subject", subject, required=True, errors=errors)}
{field("body", "Body", body_txt, type="textarea", required=True, errors=errors, attrs={"rows": 16, "spellcheck": "true"},
       hint="Blank lines start new paragraphs. Lines starting with '- ' become a list. A button is written as [button: Label | {{url}}].")}
{switch("active", "Send this email", active)}
<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Save</button>
<button class="btn btn--secondary" type="submit" formaction="/admin/emails/{esc(key)}/preview" formtarget="email-preview" formnovalidate>{i("eye")}Preview changes</button>
<button class="btn btn--secondary" type="submit" formaction="/admin/emails/{esc(key)}/test" formnovalidate>{i("send")}Send test to me</button></div></form>"""
    body = (f'<p><a class="arrow-link" href="/admin/emails">{i("arrow-left")}<span>All email templates</span></a></p>'
            + page_head(t["name"], f"<span class=mono>{esc(key)}</span> · to {esc(t['audience'])}s", reset)
            + f'<div class="cols cols--even"><div class="stack"><section class="box">{form}</section>'
              f'<section class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Variables</h2><span class="tiny muted">Filled in when the email is sent</span></div>'
              f'<ul class="admin-vars">{var_list}</ul></section></div>'
              f'<section class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Preview</h2><span class="tiny muted">Sample data</span></div>'
              f'<iframe class="admin-frame" name="email-preview" title="Email preview" sandbox src="/admin/emails/{esc(key)}/preview"></iframe></section></div>')
    resp = _page(req, t["name"], body, "/admin/emails")
    return Response(resp, status=400) if errors else resp


@router.route("/admin/emails/<key>/preview", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def email_preview(req, key):
    auth.require_admin(req)
    t = mail.template(key)
    if not t:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    subject = req.get("subject") if req.method == "POST" else t["subject"]
    body_txt = ((req.form.get("body") or [""])[0].replace("\r\n", "\n") if req.method == "POST" else t["body"]) or t["body"]
    msg = mail.compose(key, _preview_vars(subject, body_txt), subject_override=subject or t["subject"], body_override=body_txt)
    head = (f'<div style="font:13px/1.5 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;padding:10px 14px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #eee">'
            f'<b>Subject:</b> {esc(msg["subject"])}</div>')
    return _sandboxed(msg["html"].replace("<body style=\"margin:0;padding:0;background:#F5F5F4\">",
                                          "<body style=\"margin:0;padding:0;background:#F5F5F4\">" + head, 1))


@router.post("/admin/emails/<key>/test")
def email_test(req, key):
    admin = auth.require_admin(req)
    t = mail.template(key)
    if not t:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    subject = req.get("subject") or t["subject"]
    body_txt = (req.form.get("body") or [""])[0].replace("\r\n", "\n").strip() or t["body"]
    vars = {**_preview_vars(subject, body_txt), "first_name": mail.first_name(admin["name"])}
    result = mail.send(admin["email"], key, vars, user_id=admin["id"], subject_override="[Test] " + subject, body_override=body_txt)
    auth.audit(admin["id"], "email_template.test", key, status=result["status"])
    if result["status"] == "sent":
        req.flash("success", f"Test sent to {admin['email']}.")
    else:
        req.flash("error", f"Test {result['status']}: {result['error'] or 'see the email log'}")
    return redirect(f"/admin/emails/{key}")


@router.post("/admin/emails/<key>/reset")
def email_reset(req, key):
    admin = auth.require_admin(req)
    default = mail.DEFAULT_TEMPLATES.get(key)
    if not default:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    db.run("UPDATE email_templates SET subject = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE key = ?", (default[2], default[3], db.now(), key))
    auth.audit(admin["id"], "email_template.reset", key)
    req.flash("success", "Default wording restored.")
    return redirect(f"/admin/emails/{key}")


# --- email log / outbox ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/admin/outbox")
def outbox(req):
    auth.require_admin(req)
    q, status, audience, tkey = req.arg("q"), req.arg("status"), req.arg("audience"), req.arg("template")
    where, params = ["1 = 1"], []
    if q:
        where.append("(l.to_email LIKE ? OR l.subject LIKE ?)")
        params += [f"%{q}%", f"%{q}%"]
    if status in ("sent", "failed", "skipped"):
        where.append("l.status = ?")
        params.append(status)
    if audience in ("organiser", "guest", "system"):
        where.append("l.audience = ?")
        params.append(audience)
    if tkey:
        where.append("l.template_key = ?")
        params.append(tkey)
    w = " AND ".join(where)
    total = db.val(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_logs l WHERE {w}", params, 0)
    offset, pager = _pager(req, total)
    rows = db.q(f"""SELECT l.*, e.uid AS event_uid, e.name AS event_name FROM email_logs l LEFT JOIN events e ON e.id = l.event_id
                    WHERE {w} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?""", params + [PER_PAGE, offset])
    table = _table(["Sent", "To", "Email", "Event", "Status", "Provider"], [[
        esc(fmt_dt(r["created_at"])), esc(r["to_email"]) + f'<span class="table__sub">{esc(r["audience"])}</span>',
        f'<a href="/admin/outbox/{r["id"]}">{esc(r["subject"])}</a><span class="table__sub mono">{esc(r["template_key"])}</span>',
        _event_link(r["event_uid"], r["event_name"]) if r["event_uid"] else "—", _pill(r["status"]), esc(r["provider"])] for r in rows],
        "No emails match these filters.")
    keys = [(r["key"], r["name"]) for r in db.q("SELECT key, name FROM email_templates ORDER BY name")]
    controls = (_search(q, "Recipient or subject")
                + _sel("status", "Status", [("", "Any status"), ("sent", "Sent"), ("failed", "Failed"), ("skipped", "Skipped")], status)
                + _sel("audience", "Audience", [("", "Everyone"), ("organiser", "Organisers"), ("guest", "Guests")], audience)
                + _sel("template", "Template", [("", "Any email")] + keys, tkey))
    body = page_head("Email log", "Every email the platform has tried to send, with its delivery result.") + _filters(req, controls) + table + pager
    return _page(req, "Email log", body, "/admin/outbox")


_REF_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._+-]{6,80}$")


@router.get("/admin/outbox/<int:log_id>")
def outbox_detail(req, log_id):
    auth.require_admin(req)
    r = db.one("""SELECT l.*, e.uid AS event_uid, e.name AS event_name FROM email_logs l
                  LEFT JOIN events e ON e.id = l.event_id WHERE l.id = ?""", (log_id,))
    if not r:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    has_file = bool(r["outbox_file"]) and bool(_REF_RE.match(r["outbox_file"])) and (config.OUTBOX_DIR / f"{r['outbox_file']}.html").is_file()
    frame = (f'<iframe class="admin-frame" title="Stored email" sandbox src="/admin/outbox/{log_id}/view"></iframe>' if has_file
             else '<div class="empty"><p>The message body is only stored for the development outbox provider.</p></div>')
    info = f"""<dl class="dl"><dt>To</dt><dd>{esc(r['to_email'])}</dd><dt>Audience</dt><dd>{esc(r['audience'])}</dd>
<dt>Template</dt><dd><a class="text-link" href="/admin/emails/{esc(r['template_key'])}">{esc(r['template_key'])}</a></dd>
<dt>Event</dt><dd>{_event_link(r['event_uid'], r['event_name']) if r['event_uid'] else '—'}</dd>
<dt>Status</dt><dd>{_pill(r['status'])}</dd><dt>Provider</dt><dd>{esc(r['provider'])} · {esc(r['provider_id'] or '—')}</dd>
<dt>Error</dt><dd>{esc(r['error'] or '—')}</dd><dt>Batch</dt><dd class="mono">{esc(r['batch_id'] or '—')}</dd>
<dt>Created</dt><dd>{esc(fmt_dt(r['created_at']))}</dd></dl>"""
    body = (f'<p><a class="arrow-link" href="/admin/outbox">{i("arrow-left")}<span>Email log</span></a></p>' + page_head(r["subject"])
            + f'<div class="cols cols--2"><section class="box">{frame}</section><section class="box">{info}</section></div>')
    return _page(req, "Email", body, "/admin/outbox")


@router.get("/admin/outbox/<int:log_id>/view")
def outbox_view(req, log_id):
    auth.require_admin(req)
    r = db.one("SELECT outbox_file FROM email_logs WHERE id = ?", (log_id,))
    ref = r["outbox_file"] if r else None
    if not ref or not _REF_RE.match(ref):
        raise HTTPError(404)
    path = (config.OUTBOX_DIR / f"{ref}.html").resolve()
    try:
        path.relative_to(config.OUTBOX_DIR.resolve())
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return _sandboxed(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


# --- support ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SUPPORT_STATUSES = [("open", "Open"), ("in_progress", "In progress"), ("resolved", "Resolved")]
PRIORITIES = [("0", "Normal"), ("1", "High"), ("2", "Urgent")]


@router.get("/admin/support")
def support_list(req):
    auth.require_admin(req)
    status, q = req.arg("status"), req.arg("q")
    where, params = ["1 = 1"], []
    if status in dict(SUPPORT_STATUSES):
        where.append("s.status = ?")
        params.append(status)
    if q:
        where.append("(s.email LIKE ? OR s.name LIKE ? OR s.message LIKE ?)")
        params += [f"%{q}%"] * 3
    w = " AND ".join(where)
    total = db.val(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_requests s WHERE {w}", params, 0)
    offset, pager = _pager(req, total)
    rows = db.q(f"""SELECT s.* FROM support_requests s WHERE {w}
                    ORDER BY CASE s.status WHEN 'open' THEN 0 WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.priority DESC, s.created_at DESC
                    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?""", params + [PER_PAGE, offset])
    pr = dict(PRIORITIES)
    table = _table(["Request", "From", "Priority", "Status", "Received"], [[
        f'<a href="/admin/support/{s["id"]}">SR-{s["id"]}: {esc(s["topic"].replace("_", " ").capitalize())}</a><span class="table__sub">{esc(s["message"][:90])}</span>',
        esc(s["name"]) + f'<span class="table__sub">{esc(s["email"])}</span>',
        _pill("failed" if s["priority"] >= 2 else ("pending" if s["priority"] == 1 else "info"), pr.get(str(s["priority"]), "Normal")),
        _pill(s["status"], dict(SUPPORT_STATUSES).get(s["status"])), esc(fmt_dt(s["created_at"]))] for s in rows], "No support requests.")
    controls = _search(q, "Name, email or message") + _sel("status", "Status", [("", "Any status")] + SUPPORT_STATUSES, status)
    body = page_head("Support", "Requests from the contact form and dashboards. Open and urgent requests come first.") + _filters(req, controls) + table + pager
    return _page(req, "Support", body, "/admin/support")


@router.route("/admin/support/<int:req_id>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def support_detail(req, req_id):
    admin = auth.require_admin(req)
    s = db.one("SELECT * FROM support_requests WHERE id = ?", (req_id,))
    if not s:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    if req.method == "POST":
        f = Form(req)
        status = f.choice("status", dict(SUPPORT_STATUSES), "Status", required=True)
        priority = f.choice("priority", dict(PRIORITIES), "Priority", default="0")
        notes = f.text("admin_notes", "Notes", max=5000)
        if f.ok:
            db.run("UPDATE support_requests SET status = ?, priority = ?, admin_notes = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                   (status, int(priority), notes, db.now(), req_id))
            auth.audit(admin["id"], "support.update", f"SR-{req_id}", status=status, priority=priority)
            req.flash("success", "Support request updated.")
        else:
            req.flash("error", next(iter(f.errors.values())))
        return redirect(f"/admin/support/{req_id}")
    ev = events.by_id(s["event_id"]) if s["event_id"] else None
    info = f"""<dl class="dl"><dt>From</dt><dd>{esc(s['name'])}<br>{_user_link(s['user_id'], s['email'])}</dd>
<dt>Topic</dt><dd>{esc(s['topic'])}</dd><dt>Event</dt><dd>{_event_link(ev['uid'], ev['name']) if ev else '—'}</dd>
<dt>Received</dt><dd>{esc(fmt_dt(s['created_at']))}</dd><dt>Updated</dt><dd>{esc(fmt_dt(s['updated_at']))}</dd></dl>"""
    form = f"""<form method="post" class="form">{csrf(req)}<div class="form-row form-row--2">
{select("status", "Status", SUPPORT_STATUSES, s["status"], required=True)}{select("priority", "Priority", PRIORITIES, str(s["priority"]))}</div>
{field("admin_notes", "Internal notes (never shown to the customer)", s["admin_notes"], type="textarea", attrs={"rows": 6})}
<div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Save</button>
<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="mailto:{esc(s['email'])}?subject={esc('Re: your request SR-' + str(req_id))}">{i("mail")}Reply by email</a></div></form>"""
    body = (f'<p><a class="arrow-link" href="/admin/support">{i("arrow-left")}<span>Support queue</span></a></p>'
            + page_head(f"SR-{req_id}", _pill(s["status"], dict(SUPPORT_STATUSES).get(s["status"])))
            + f'<div class="cols cols--2"><div class="stack"><section class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Message</h2></div>'
              f'<p style="white-space:pre-wrap">{esc(s["message"])}</p></section><section class="box">{form}</section></div>'
              f'<section class="box">{info}</section></div>')
    return _page(req, f"SR-{req_id}", body, "/admin/support")


# --- audit -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/admin/audit")
def audit_log(req):
    auth.require_admin(req)
    action, q = req.arg("action"), req.arg("q")
    where, params = ["1 = 1"], []
    if action:
        where.append("a.action LIKE ?")
        params.append(f"{action}%")
    if q:
        where.append("(u.email LIKE ? OR a.target LIKE ?)")
        params += [f"%{q}%", f"%{q}%"]
    w = " AND ".join(where)
    base = "FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.actor_id"
    total = db.val(f"SELECT COUNT(*) {base} WHERE {w}", params, 0)
    offset, pager = _pager(req, total)
    rows = db.q(f"SELECT a.*, u.email {base} WHERE {w} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?", params + [PER_PAGE, offset])
    prefixes = [(r["p"], r["p"].capitalize()) for r in db.q("SELECT DISTINCT substr(action, 1, instr(action || '.', '.') - 1) AS p FROM audit_log ORDER BY p")]
    table = _table(["When", "Who", "Action", "Target", "Details"], [[
        esc(fmt_dt(a["created_at"])), _user_link(a["actor_id"], a["email"]) if a["actor_id"] else '<span class="muted">System</span>',
        f'<span class="mono small">{esc(a["action"])}</span>', esc(a["target"]),
        f'<span class="tiny muted mono">{esc(a["meta"] if a["meta"] != "{}" else "")}</span>'] for a in rows], "No audit entries.")
    controls = _search(q, "Actor email or target") + _sel("action", "Area", [("", "All areas")] + prefixes, action)
    body = page_head("Audit log", "Who changed what, and when.") + _filters(req, controls) + table + pager
    return _page(req, "Audit log", body, "/admin/audit")
```

```python
"""Organiser dashboard: event list, event overview, sharing (WhatsApp, QR), reports and settings."""

@router.get("/dashboard")
def dashboard_home(req):

                   WHERE (e.owner_id = ? OR a.user_id = ?) AND e.status != 'archived'
                   ORDER BY CASE e.status WHEN 'draft' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, e.updated_at DESC""", (user["id"], user["id"]))
    first = (user["name"] or "").split(" ")[0]
    head = page_head(f"Welcome back, {first}" if rows else f"Welcome, {first}",
                     "Your events, drafts and RSVPs in one place.",
                     f'<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/create">{i("plus")}Create an event</a>')
    if not user["email_verified_at"]:
        head += (f'<div class="notice notice--warn" style="margin-bottom:18px">{i("mail")}<div>Please confirm your email address '
                 f'so RSVP updates and reports reach you. <a class="text-link" href="/account">Resend the email</a></div></div>')
    if not rows:
        body = head + (f'<div class="empty"><span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">{i("sparkle")}</span>'
                       f'<h2 style="font-size:1.375rem">Create your first event</h2>'
                       f'<p>Choose a category and template, add your details, and get one link for invitations, RSVPs, '
                       f'menus, seating and more. Your progress saves as you go.</p>'
                       f'<a class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" href="/create">Create your event</a></div>')
        return account_page(req, "My events", body, "/dashboard")
    cards = []
    for e in rows:
        ev = events.parse(e)
        s = events.stats(ev["id"])
        role = "" if ev["owner_id"] == user["id"] else '<span class="tag">Co-admin</span>'
        days = forms.days_until(ev.get("event_date"))
        when = forms.fmt_date(ev.get("event_date"), long=False) or "Date not set"
        if days is not None and days >= 0:
            when += f" · {days} day{'s' if days != 1 else ''} to go" if days else " · today"
        if ev["status"] == "draft":
            done = len(ev.get("wizard_done") or [])
            action = (f'<a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/setup/{ev["wizard_step"] or 1}">Continue setup</a>'
                      f'<span class="small muted">{done} of 10 steps done</span>')
            progress = f'<div class="progress"><span style="width:{done * 10}%"></span></div>'
        else:
            action = (f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}">Open dashboard</a>'
                      f'<a class="arrow-link" href="{events.public_path(ev)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>View website</span>{i("external")}</a>')
            progress = (f'<div class="bar-list__row"><span class="small muted">{s["attending"]} attending · {s["pending"]} to reply</span>'
                        f'<b class="mono small">{s["completion"]}%</b><div class="progress"><span style="width:{s["completion"]}%"></span></div></div>')
        cards.append(f"""<article class="box event-card"><div class="event-card__top"><div>
<h2 style="font-size:1.25rem"><a href="{base(ev)}" style="text-decoration:none">{esc(ev["name"])}</a></h2>
<div class="event-card__meta"><span>{esc(catalog.category_name(ev["category"]))}</span><span>{esc(when)}</span></div></div>
<div class="cluster">{role}{status_pill_event(ev)}</div></div>{progress}<div class="row">{action}</div></article>""")
    body = head + f'<div class="grid grid--2">{"".join(cards)}</div>'
    return account_page(req, "My events", body, "/dashboard")


def status_pill_event(ev) -> str:
    label = events.STATUS_LABELS.get(ev["status"], ev["status"])
    if ev["status"] == "draft" and not ev["paid_package"]:
        label = "Draft"
    return f'<span class="pill pill--{esc(ev["status"])}">{esc(label)}</span>'


# =============================================================================================
# Event overview

        banner = (f'<div class="notice notice--error" style="margin-bottom:22px">{i("alert")}<div><b>This event is suspended.</b> '

        countdown = f"{-days} days ago"

    kpis = f"""<div class="kpis" style="--n:5;margin-bottom:22px">
<div class="kpi kpi--accent"><span>Event date</span><b style="font-size:1.25rem">{esc(forms.fmt_date(ev.get("event_date"), long=False) or "Not set")}</b><small>{esc(countdown)}</small></div>
<div class="kpi"><span>Invited</span><b>{s["invited"]}</b><small>{s["headcount"]} people attending</small></div>
<div class="kpi"><span>Confirmed</span><b>{s["attending"]}</b><small>+{s["plus_ones"]} plus-ones · {s["children"]} children</small></div>
<div class="kpi"><span>Declined</span><b>{s["declined"]}</b><small>{s["pending"]} still pending</small></div>
<div class="kpi"><span>RSVP completion</span><b>{s["completion"]}%</b><div class="progress" style="margin-top:10px"><span style="width:{s["completion"]}%"></span></div></div></div>"""

    tables = events.tables(ev["id"])
    next_html = _next_step_cards(next_steps(ev, s, days))
    checklist = [
        ("Event details and date", bool(ev.get("event_date") and ev.get("name")), f"{base(ev)}/setup/1"),
        ("Venue and directions", bool(venue.get("name")), f"{base(ev)}/setup/1"),
        ("Design chosen", 2 in (ev.get("wizard_done") or []), f"{base(ev)}/setup/2"),
        ("Package paid", bool(paid), f"{base(ev)}/setup/8"),
        ("Website published", live, f"{base(ev)}/settings"),
        ("Guests added", s["invited"] > 0, f"{base(ev)}/guests"),
    ]
    if has(ev, "seating"):
        checklist.append(("Everyone seated", bool(tables) and s["attending"] > 0 and s["unseated_parties"] == 0, f"{base(ev)}/seating"))
    if has(ev, "menu"):
        checklist.append(("Menu added", bool(events.menus(ev["id"])), f"{base(ev)}/menu"))
    done = sum(1 for _, ok, _ in checklist if ok)
    check_html = "".join(
        f'<li><a href="{href}" class="row" style="text-decoration:none;gap:10px;flex-wrap:nowrap">'
        f'<span class="icon-tile{" icon-tile--soft" if ok else ""}" style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%">{i("check") if ok else ""}</span>'
        f'<span{" class=muted" if ok else ""}>{esc(label)}</span></a>{"" if ok else i("arrow")}</li>' for label, ok, href in checklist)

    recent = db.q("""SELECT r.*, g.first_name, g.last_name, g.status FROM rsvp_responses r LEFT JOIN guests g ON g.id = r.guest_id
                     WHERE r.event_id = ? ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 8""", (ev["id"],))
    recent_html = "".join(
        f'<li><span><b>{esc((r["first_name"] or "Removed guest") + " " + (r["last_name"] or ""))}</b><br>'
        f'<span class="small muted">{esc(forms.fmt_dt(r["created_at"]))}</span></span>{status_pill(r["status"]) if r["status"] else ""}</li>' for r in recent)
    recent_box = (f'<ul class="list-plain list-rows">{recent_html}</ul>' if recent else
                  '<p class="small muted">Responses appear here as soon as guests reply.</p>')

    link = events.public_url(ev)
    wa = "https://wa.me/?text=" + quote(_invite_message(ev))
    share = f"""<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Your one link</h2>{'<span class="pill pill--ok">Live</span>' if live else '<span class="pill pill--draft">Not live yet</span>'}</div>
<p class="mono small" style="overflow-wrap:anywhere">{esc(link)}</p><div class="row" style="margin-top:12px">
<button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="button" data-copy="{esc(link)}" data-copied="Link copied">{i("copy")}Copy</button>
<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="{esc(wa)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{i("chat")}WhatsApp</a>
<a class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/share">{i("qr")}QR code</a></div></div>"""

    actions = (f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/setup/1">{i("edit")}Edit details</a>'
               f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="{events.public_path(ev)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{i("eye")}View website</a>')
    head = page_head(ev["name"], esc(" · ".join(x for x in (catalog.category_name(ev["category"]), venue.get("name", "")) if x)), actions)

<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Checklist</h2><span class="small muted">{done} of {len(checklist)}</span></div>
<div class="progress" style="margin-bottom:12px"><span style="width:{round(100 * done / len(checklist))}%"></span></div>
<ul class="list-plain list-rows">{check_html}</ul></div></div>"""
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Overview", body, "")


def _booking_box(ev, paid, live) -> str:
    """The client's booking at a glance: package, payment, receipt, website link and how long it stays online."""
    if not paid:
        return ""
    order = db.one("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE event_id = ? AND status = 'paid' ORDER BY paid_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1", (ev["id"],))
    rows = [("Package", esc(paid["name"]))]
    if order:
        rows.append(("Paid", f'{catalog.money(order["amount_cents"])} on {esc(forms.fmt_date((order["paid_at"] or "")[:10]))}'
                             f'{" (test payment)" if order["mode"] == "sandbox" else ""}'))
        rows.append(("Reference", f'<span class="mono">{esc(order["invoice_no"] or order["uid"])}</span> · '
                                  f'<a class="text-link" href="/dashboard/orders/{esc(order["uid"])}/receipt">Receipt</a>'))
    pill = '<span class="pill pill--ok">Live</span>' if live else '<span class="pill pill--draft">Not live</span>'
    rows.append(("Website", f'<a class="text-link" href="{esc(events.public_path(ev))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{esc(events.public_url(ev))}</a> {pill}'))
    if ev.get("hosting_until"):
        rows.append(("Online until", esc(forms.fmt_date(ev["hosting_until"]))))
    dl = "".join(f"<dt>{k}</dt><dd>{v}</dd>" for k, v in rows)
    return (f'<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Your booking</h2><a class="arrow-link" href="/dashboard/billing"><span>Billing</span>{i("arrow")}</a></div>'
            f'<dl class="dl">{dl}</dl></div>')


def next_steps(ev, s: dict | None = None, days: int | None = None) -> list:
    """What to do next, in order, as (title, why, link, button), so the organiser never has to work it out.
    Shown on the overview and sent the day after the website goes live (scheduler)."""
    s = s or events.stats(ev["id"])
    if days is None:
        days = forms.days_until(ev.get("event_date"))
    paid = catalog.package(ev["paid_package"])
    live = events.is_live(ev)
    venue = ev.get("venue") or {}
    # guests who replied, or opened their personal link, clearly have their invitation
    not_sent = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND invited_at IS NULL AND status = 'pending'", (ev["id"],), 0)
    waiting = s["pending"] - not_sent              # invited, not replied yet
    steps = []   # (title, why, link, button)
    if not (ev.get("hosts") and ev.get("event_date")):
        steps.append(("Add your names and date", "Guests see these first.", f"{base(ev)}/setup/1", "Add details"))
    if not (venue.get("name") and venue.get("address")):
        steps.append(("Add your venue", "So guests get directions and a map.", f"{base(ev)}/setup/1", "Add venue"))
    if not paid:
        pass                                    # the "Ready to share it?" banner above already asks for this
    elif not live and ev["status"] != "suspended":
        steps.append(("Publish your website", "It's paid for. Publish it so guests can open your link.", f"{base(ev)}/settings", "Publish"))
    if live and has(ev, "guest_management") and s["invited"] == 0:
        steps.append(("Add your guest list", "Paste names or import a spreadsheet. Each guest gets a personal RSVP link.", f"{base(ev)}/guests/import", "Add guests"))
    if live and has(ev, "personal_invites") and not_sent:
        steps.append(("Send your invitations", (f"{not_sent} guests haven't been sent their invitation yet. Send them on WhatsApp, one tap each." if not_sent != 1 else "1 guest hasn't been sent their invitation yet. Send it on WhatsApp in one tap."),
                      f"{base(ev)}/share/whatsapp", "Start sending"))
    elif live and not has(ev, "personal_invites") and s["invited"] == 0:
        steps.append(("Share your link", "Send it on WhatsApp, by email or as a QR code. Guests reply on the website.", f"{base(ev)}/share", "Share"))
    if live and waiting > 0 and (days is None or days >= 0):
        steps.append(("Remind guests who haven't replied", f"{waiting} still to reply.", f"{base(ev)}/share/whatsapp?mode=remind", "Send reminders"))
    if has(ev, "seating") and s["attending"] and s["unseated_parties"]:
        steps.append(("Seat your guests", f"{s['unseated_parties']} confirmed part{'y' if s['unseated_parties'] == 1 else 'ies'} without a table. Seat everyone automatically, then fine-tune.",
                      f"{base(ev)}/seating", "Open seating"))
    if days is not None and days < 0 and has(ev, "gallery") and not db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ? AND kind = 'gallery' AND created_at >= ?", (ev["id"], ev["event_date"] or ""), 0):
        steps.append(("Share photos from the day", "Add your favourites to the gallery. Guests see them on the link they already have.", f"{base(ev)}/setup/7", "Add photos"))
    if days is not None and days < 0 and has(ev, "reports"):
        steps.append(("Download your final report", "Attendance, meals and seating in one file to keep.", f"{base(ev)}/reports", "Reports"))
    return steps


def _next_step_cards(steps) -> str:
    if not steps:
        return ""
    cards = "".join(f'<a class="next-step" href="{href}"><span class="mono tiny">NEXT {n}</span><b>{esc(t)}</b><span class="small muted">{esc(w)}</span>'
                    f'<span class="arrow-link small"><span>{esc(btn)}</span>{i("arrow")}</span></a>' for n, (t, w, href, btn) in enumerate(steps[:3], 1))
    return f'<div class="next-steps" style="margin-bottom:22px">{cards}</div>'


# =============================================================================================
# Share
# =============================================================================================
def _invite_message(ev) -> str:
    date = forms.fmt_date(ev.get("event_date"))
    when = f" on {date}" if date else ""
    return (f"You're invited to {ev['name']}{when}. Everything you need, from directions to RSVP, "
            f"is on our event page: {events.public_url(ev)}")


def _reminder_message(ev, g) -> str:
    gs = ev.get("guest_settings") or {}
    by = f" by {forms.fmt_date(gs['rsvp_deadline'], long=False)}" if gs.get("rsvp_deadline") else ""
    return (f"Hi {g['first_name']}, a quick reminder to let us know{by} if you can make it to {ev['name']}. "
            f"It takes a minute: {events.invite_url(ev, g)}")


def _broadcast_box(ev, with_queue: bool = True) -> str:
    msg = _invite_message(ev)
    return f"""<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Send to many people at once</h2></div>
<p class="small muted">Use a WhatsApp broadcast list: everyone gets the message privately, as if you'd sent it to them alone.</p>
<ol class="small" style="margin:10px 0 12px;padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:6px"><li>In WhatsApp, open <b>Broadcast lists</b> (Android: ⋮ › New broadcast; iPhone: Chats › Lists or Broadcast lists).</li>
<li>Add your guests, up to 256 per list.</li><li>Paste this message and send.</li></ol>
<textarea class="textarea" id="broadcast-msg" rows="4" readonly aria-label="Message for a broadcast list">{esc(msg)}</textarea>
<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="button" data-copy-target="#broadcast-msg" data-copied="Message copied">{i("copy")}Copy message</button></div>
<p class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:10px">Only people who have your number saved in their phone receive broadcasts. For everyone else, {"send one by one, or " if with_queue else ""}post the message in a group chat.</p></div>"""


@router.route("/dashboard/events/<uid>/share/whatsapp", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def whatsapp_queue(req, uid):
    """Send personal invitations (or reminders) on WhatsApp one guest at a time: one tap to open
    WhatsApp with the message ready, one tap for the next guest. Nothing is sent automatically."""
    ev = load(req, uid)
    mode = "remind" if (req.arg("mode") or req.get("mode")) == "remind" else "invite"
    skip = [int(x) for x in (req.arg("skip") or req.get("skip") or "").split(",") if x.isdigit()][:500]
    title = "Remind guests on WhatsApp" if mode == "remind" else "Send invitations on WhatsApp"
    if not has(ev, "personal_invites"):
        body = page_head(title, "Personal links for each guest are part of Premium. You can still share your one link with everyone.") + _broadcast_box(ev, with_queue=False)
        return organiser_page(req, ev, title, body, "/share")
    today = db.now()[:10]
    if req.method == "POST":
        g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE id = ? AND event_id = ?", (req.get("guest_id"), ev["id"]))
        if g and req.get("action") == "sent":
            if mode == "invite":
                db.run("UPDATE guests SET invited_at = COALESCE(invited_at, ?), updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (db.now(), db.now(), g["id"]))
            else:
                db.run("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sent_markers (event_id, marker, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                       (ev["id"], f"wa-remind:{g['id']}:{today}", db.now()))
        elif g:
            skip.append(g["id"])
        q = {"mode": mode if mode == "remind" else "", "skip": ",".join(map(str, skip))}
        return redirect(f"{base(ev)}/share/whatsapp" + ("?" + "&".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in q.items() if v) if any(q.values()) else ""))
    if mode == "invite":
        todo = db.q("""SELECT * FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND invited_at IS NULL AND status = 'pending' AND phone != ''
                       ORDER BY is_vip DESC, last_name COLLATE NOCASE, first_name COLLATE NOCASE""", (ev["id"],))
        done = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND invited_at IS NOT NULL AND phone != ''", (ev["id"],), 0)
    else:
        todo = db.q("""SELECT g.* FROM guests g WHERE g.event_id = ? AND g.status = 'pending' AND g.phone != '' AND g.invited_at IS NOT NULL
                       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sent_markers m WHERE m.event_id = g.event_id AND m.marker = 'wa-remind:' || g.id || ':' || ?)
                       ORDER BY g.last_name COLLATE NOCASE, g.first_name COLLATE NOCASE""", (ev["id"], today))
        done = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sent_markers WHERE event_id = ? AND marker LIKE ?", (ev["id"], f"wa-remind:%:{today}"), 0)
    queue = [g for g in todo if g["id"] not in skip and wa_digits(g["phone"])]
    skipped = [g for g in todo if g["id"] in skip]
    no_phone = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND phone = '' AND status != 'declined'", (ev["id"],), 0)
    total = done + len(queue) + len(skipped)
    tabs_html = (f'<nav class="tabs" aria-label="Section" style="margin-bottom:18px"><a href="{base(ev)}/share/whatsapp"{" aria-current=page" if mode == "invite" else ""}>Invitations</a>'
                 f'<a href="{base(ev)}/share/whatsapp?mode=remind"{" aria-current=page" if mode == "remind" else ""}>Reminders</a></nav>')
    if queue:
        g = queue[0]
        msg = guest_whatsapp(ev, g) if mode == "invite" else f"https://wa.me/{wa_digits(g['phone'])}?text={quote(_reminder_message(ev, g))}"
        text = (f"Hi {g['first_name']}, you're invited to {ev['name']}. Your personal invitation and RSVP link: {events.invite_url(ev, g)}"
                if mode == "invite" else _reminder_message(ev, g))
        form = lambda action, label, cls: (f'<form method="post">{csrf(req)}<input type="hidden" name="mode" value="{mode}"><input type="hidden" name="skip" value="{",".join(map(str, skip))}">'
                                           f'<input type="hidden" name="guest_id" value="{g["id"]}"><input type="hidden" name="action" value="{action}">'
                                           f'<button class="btn {cls}" type="submit"{" data-next-guest" if action == "sent" else ""}>{label}</button></form>')
        card = f"""<div class="box wa-queue"><div class="row row--between"><span class="mono small">{done + 1} of {total}</span><span class="small muted">{len(queue) - 1} after this one</span></div>
<div class="progress"><span style="width:{round(100 * done / total) if total else 0}%"></span></div>
<div><h2 style="font-size:1.375rem">{esc(events.guest_name(g))}{' <span class="pill pill--gold pill--plain">VIP</span>' if g["is_vip"] else ""}</h2><p class="mono small muted">{esc(g["phone"])}</p></div>
<div class="notice">{i("chat")}<span class="small" style="white-space:pre-wrap">{esc(text)}</span></div>
<div class="btn-row"><a class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" href="{esc(msg)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-open-wa>{i("chat")}Open WhatsApp</a>
{form("sent", "Sent, next guest " + i("arrow", "i--arrow"), "btn--secondary btn--lg")}{form("skip", "Skip for now", "btn--ghost")}</div>
<p class="tiny muted">WhatsApp opens with the message ready. Press send there, come back and tap “Sent, next guest”.</p></div>"""
    else:
        msg_done = ("Everyone with a mobile number has their invitation." if mode == "invite" else "Everyone who hasn't replied has had a reminder today.")
        card = (f'<div class="box"><div class="empty"><span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">{i("check")}</span><h2 style="font-size:1.25rem">{msg_done}</h2>'
                + (f'<p>You skipped {len(skipped)}. <a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/share/whatsapp{"?mode=remind" if mode == "remind" else ""}">Go through them again</a>.</p>' if skipped else "")
                + f'<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{base(ev)}/rsvps">See RSVPs</a></div></div>')
    extra = ""
    if no_phone:
        extra = (f'<div class="notice" style="margin-top:14px">{i("info")}<span>{no_phone} guest{"s have" if no_phone != 1 else " has"} no mobile number. '
                 f'<a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/guests">Add numbers</a> or <a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/communications">email them instead</a>.</span></div>')
    js = """<script>(function(){var a=document.querySelector('[data-open-wa]'),n=document.querySelector('[data-next-guest]');if(a&&n)a.addEventListener('click',function(){setTimeout(function(){n.classList.remove('btn--secondary');n.classList.add('btn--primary');n.focus();},400);});})();</script>"""
    intro = ("One guest at a time, each with their own RSVP link. Two taps per guest." if mode == "invite"
             else "Guests who were invited but haven't replied yet, each with their own RSVP link.")
    body = page_head(title, intro) + tabs_html + f'<div class="cols cols--2"><div>{card}{extra}</div>{_broadcast_box(ev)}</div>' + js
    return organiser_page(req, ev, title, body, "/share")

    sub_js = json.dumps("Invitation: " + ev["name"]).replace("<", "\\u003c")

@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/reports")
def reports_page(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if not has(ev, "basic_dashboard"):
        return organiser_page(req, ev, "Reports", page_head("Reports") + locked_panel(ev, "basic_dashboard", "Reports"), "/reports")
    can = has(ev, "reports")
    rows = []
    for kind, (title, desc) in reports.KINDS.items():
        links = (f'<a class="chip" href="{base(ev)}/reports/{kind}.pdf">{i("download")}PDF</a>'
                 f'<a class="chip" href="{base(ev)}/reports/{kind}.csv">{i("download")}CSV</a>') if can else f'<span class="tag">{i("lock")} Premium</span>'
        rows.append(f'<li><span><b>{esc(title)}</b><br><span class="small muted">{esc(desc)}</span></span><span class="row" style="flex-wrap:nowrap">{links}</span></li>')
    prefs = {"summary": "weekly", "new_rsvp": True, "auto_reminders": True, **(ev.get("report_prefs") or {})}
    summary_opts = [("none", "Don't send summaries"), ("daily", "Daily summary"), ("weekly", "Weekly summary (Mondays)")]
    final = ""
    if can:
        final = (f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/communications/final-report">{csrf(req)}<input type="hidden" name="back" value="/reports">'
                 f'<button class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" type="submit">{i("mail")}Email me the final report</button></form>')
    upsell = "" if can else (f'<div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:16px">{i("lock")}<div>Downloadable reports are part of the Premium Experience. '
                             f'Your RSVP numbers stay visible on the dashboard. <a class="text-link" href="{base(ev)}/setup/8">Compare packages</a></div></div>')
    reminders_switch = forms.switch("auto_reminders", "Remind guests who haven't replied, 7 and 2 days before the RSVP deadline",
                                    bool(prefs.get("auto_reminders"))) if has(ev, "reminders") else \
        '<p class="small muted">Automatic guest reminders are part of the Premium Experience.</p>'
    body = page_head("Reports", "Download what your venue, caterer and planner need, or have it emailed to you.", final) + upsell + f"""
<div class="cols cols--2"><div class="box"><ul class="list-plain list-rows">{"".join(rows)}</ul></div>
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/reports/prefs">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>Automatic emails</h2></div>
{forms.select("summary", "RSVP summaries to you", summary_opts, prefs.get("summary", "weekly"))}
{forms.switch("new_rsvp", "Email me every new RSVP", bool(prefs.get("new_rsvp")))}
{reminders_switch}
<p class="small muted">Event reminders reach you a week and a day before the event, and a post-event report follows the day after.</p>
<div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save preferences</button></div></form></div>"""
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Reports", body, "/reports")


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/reports/<kind>.<fmt>")
def report_download(req, uid, kind, fmt):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if kind not in reports.KINDS or fmt not in reports.FORMATS:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    if not has(ev, "reports"):
        raise HTTPError(403, "Downloadable reports are part of the Premium Experience.")
    name, data, ctype = reports.build(ev, kind, fmt, user_id=req.user["id"])
    return download(data, name, ctype)


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/reports/prefs")
def report_prefs(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    f = Form(req)
    summary = f.choice("summary", ["none", "daily", "weekly"], "summary", default="weekly")
    prefs = dict(ev.get("report_prefs") or {})
    prefs.update({"summary": summary, "new_rsvp": f.flag("new_rsvp")})
    if has(ev, "reminders"):
        prefs["auto_reminders"] = f.flag("auto_reminders")
    events.save_json(ev["id"], "report_prefs", prefs)
    return go(req, ev, "/reports", "success", "Email preferences saved.")

@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings")
def settings(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    vis = {**events.default_sections(), **(ev.get("sections") or {})}
    toggles = []
    for key, label, feature in events.SECTION_KEYS:
        allowed = feature is None or has(ev, feature)
        extra = {} if allowed else {"disabled": True}
        lock = "" if allowed else f' <span class="tag">{i("lock")} not in package</span>'
        toggles.append(f'<label class="switch"><input type="checkbox" name="sections" value="{key}"'
                       f'{" checked" if vis.get(key) and allowed else ""}{" disabled" if extra else ""}><span>{esc(label)}{lock}</span></label>')
    owner = ev["owner_id"] == req.user["id"]
    live = events.is_live(ev)
    if not ev["paid_package"]:
        pub = (f'<p class="small muted">Publishing needs a confirmed payment.</p>'
               f'<a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="{base(ev)}/setup/8">Choose a package</a>')
    elif ev["status"] == "suspended":
        pub = '<p class="small">This event is suspended by the platform. <a class="text-link" href="/contact">Contact support</a>.</p>'
    elif live:
        pub = (f'<p class="small muted">Your website is live. Unpublishing hides it from guests straight away; you can publish it again any time.</p>'
               f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/unpublish" data-confirm="Hide the website from guests?">{csrf(req)}'
               f'<button class="btn btn--danger btn--sm" type="submit">Unpublish website</button></form>')
    else:
        pub = (f'<p class="small muted">Your website is hidden from guests.</p><form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/publish">{csrf(req)}'
               f'<button class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" type="submit">Publish website</button></form>')
    hosting = f'<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:8px">Hosted until {esc(forms.fmt_date(ev["hosting_until"]))}.</p>' if ev.get("hosting_until") else ""

    admins_box = ""
    if has(ev, "co_admins"):
        admins = db.q("SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email FROM event_admins a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
        limit = catalog.limit(ev, "admins", 1)
        lis = "".join(
            f'<li><span><b>{esc(a["name"])}</b><br><span class="small muted">{esc(a["email"])}</span></span>'
            + (f'<form method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/admins/{a["id"]}/remove" data-confirm="Remove {esc(a["name"])}?">{csrf(req)}'
               f'<button class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" type="submit">Remove</button></form>' if owner else "") + "</li>" for a in admins)
        add = ""
        if owner and 1 + len(admins) < limit:
            add = (f'<form class="row" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/admins" style="margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:nowrap">{csrf(req)}'
                   f'<input class="input input--sm" type="email" name="email" placeholder="their@email.com" required aria-label="Administrator email">'
                   f'<button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Add</button></form>'
                   f'<p class="small muted" style="margin-top:6px">They need an {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)} account with this email.</p>')
        admins_box = (f'<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Administrators</h2><span class="small muted">{1 + len(admins)} of {limit}</span></div>'
                      f'<ul class="list-plain list-rows"><li><span><b>Owner</b></span><span class="tag">Full access</span></li>{lis}</ul>{add}</div>')
    else:
        admins_box = (f'<div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Administrators</h2></div><p class="small muted">Add co-hosts or planners with the Signature Experience.</p></div>')

    danger = ""
    if owner:
        danger = f"""<div class="box" style="border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--error) 30%,transparent)"><div class="box__head"><h2>Delete event</h2></div>
<p class="small muted">This permanently removes the website, guests, RSVPs, seating and uploads. Payments and receipts stay on record. It can’t be undone.</p>
<form class="form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/delete" style="margin-top:12px">{csrf(req)}
{forms.field("confirm_name", f"Type “{ev['name']}” to confirm", "", attrs={"autocomplete": "off"})}
<div><button class="btn btn--danger btn--sm" type="submit">Delete permanently</button></div></form></div>"""
    body = page_head("Settings", "Control what guests see and who can manage this event.") + f"""
<div class="cols cols--even"><div class="stack">
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/sections">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>Website sections</h2></div>
<p class="small muted">Switch off anything you don’t want public. Guest lists are never shown publicly.</p>
<div style="display:grid;gap:2px">{"".join(toggles)}</div><div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save sections</button></div></form>
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/slug">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>Website address</h2></div>
<div class="field"><label for="f-slug">{esc(config.BASE_URL)}/events/</label><input class="input mono" id="f-slug" name="slug" value="{esc(ev["slug"])}" maxlength="60" pattern="[a-z0-9-]+" required></div>
<p class="small muted">Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it breaks links you’ve already shared.{" Custom domains are available on request for Signature events." if has(ev, "custom_domain") else ""}</p>
<div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save address</button></div></form></div>
<div class="stack"><div class="box"><div class="box__head"><h2>Publishing</h2>{status_pill_event(ev)}</div>{pub}{hosting}</div>
<form class="box form" method="post" action="{base(ev)}/settings/rsvp">{csrf(req)}<div class="box__head"><h2>RSVPs</h2></div>
{forms.switch("rsvp_open", "Accept RSVPs", bool(ev["rsvp_open"]))}<p class="small muted">Close RSVPs once your numbers are final; guests will see a short note instead of the form.</p>
<div class="row row--end"><button class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" type="submit">Save</button></div></form>
{admins_box}{danger}</div></div>"""
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Settings", body, "/settings")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/sections")
def settings_sections(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    chosen = set(req.getlist("sections"))
    current = {**events.default_sections(), **(ev.get("sections") or {})}
    for key, _, feature in events.SECTION_KEYS:
        if feature is None or has(ev, feature):
            current[key] = key in chosen
    events.save_json(ev["id"], "sections", current)
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "Website sections saved.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/slug")
def settings_slug(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    slug = req.get("slug").lower()
    if not forms.SLUG_RE.match(slug) or slug in events.RESERVED_SLUGS:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "Use 3 to 60 lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.")
    if slug == ev["slug"]:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "info", "That’s already your address.")
    if db.one("SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?", (slug, ev["id"])):
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", f"/events/{slug} is taken. Try adding your date or a word.")
    events.touch(ev["id"], slug=slug)
    auth.audit(req.user["id"], "event.slug", ev["uid"], old=ev["slug"], new=slug)
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", f"Your website is now at /events/{slug}.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/rsvp")
def settings_rsvp(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    open_ = req.get("rsvp_open") == "1"
    events.touch(ev["id"], rsvp_open=1 if open_ else 0)
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "RSVPs are open." if open_ else "RSVPs are closed.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/publish")
def settings_publish(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    ok, msg = notify.publish(ev, req.user["id"])
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success" if ok else "error", msg)


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/unpublish")
def settings_unpublish(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["status"] != "published":
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "info", "The website isn’t published.")
    notify.unpublish(ev, req.user["id"])
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "Your website is now hidden from guests.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/admins")
def settings_admin_add(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can change administrators.")
    if not has(ev, "co_admins"):
        raise HTTPError(403, "Additional administrators are part of the Signature Experience.")
    email = req.get("email").lower()
    count = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_admins WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],), 0)
    if 1 + count >= catalog.limit(ev, "admins", 1):
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "You’ve reached your package’s administrator limit.")
    user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)) if forms.EMAIL_RE.match(email or "") else None
    if user is None:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "No account uses that email yet. Ask them to register first, then add them.")
    if user["id"] == ev["owner_id"]:
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "info", "That’s you, the owner.")
    db.run("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO event_admins (event_id, user_id, role, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor', ?)",
           (ev["id"], user["id"], db.now()))
    from ..services import email as mail
    mail.send(user["email"], "co_admin_invite", {**notify.event_vars(ev), "inviter": req.user["name"]},
              event_id=ev["id"], user_id=user["id"])
    auth.audit(req.user["id"], "event.admin_add", ev["uid"], user=user["email"])
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", f"{user['name']} can now manage this event.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/admins/<int:user_id>/remove")
def settings_admin_remove(req, uid, user_id):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can change administrators.")
    db.run("DELETE FROM event_admins WHERE event_id = ? AND user_id = ?", (ev["id"], user_id))
    return go(req, ev, "/settings", "success", "Administrator removed.")


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/settings/delete")
def settings_delete(req, uid):
    ev = load(req, uid)
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can delete it.")
    if req.get("confirm_name").strip() != ev["name"].strip():
        return go(req, ev, "/settings", "error", "Type the event name exactly to delete it.")
    for up in events.uploads(ev["id"]):
        storage.delete(up["storage_key"])
    paid_orders = db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE event_id = ? AND status = 'paid'", (ev["id"],), 0)
    if paid_orders:
        # Keep financial records: archive instead of hard-deleting, but wipe guest data (POPIA).
        with db.transaction():
            db.run("DELETE FROM guests WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
            db.run("DELETE FROM seating_tables WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
            db.run("DELETE FROM uploads WHERE event_id = ?", (ev["id"],))
            db.run("UPDATE events SET status = 'archived', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (db.now(), ev["id"]))
    else:
        db.run("DELETE FROM events WHERE id = ?", (ev["id"],))
    auth.audit(req.user["id"], "event.delete", ev["uid"], name=ev["name"])
    req.flash("success", f"{ev['name']} was deleted.")
    return redirect("/dashboard")
```

```python
"""Form rendering helpers and server-side validation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any, Iterable, Optional

from ..web import esc

EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]{1,64}@[^@\s]{1,190}\.[A-Za-z]{2,24}$")
PHONE_RE = re.compile(r"^\+?[0-9 ()-]{7,20}$")
TIME_RE = re.compile(r"^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$")
HEX_RE = re.compile(r"^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$")
SLUG_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{1,58}[a-z0-9])?$")


class Form:
    """Collects cleaned values and errors. `f.text('name', required=True, max=120)` etc."""

    def __init__(self, req):
        self.req = req
        self.data: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.errors: dict[str, str] = {}

    def _raw(self, name: str) -> str:
        return self.req.get(name)

    def text(self, name: str, label: str = "", required: bool = False, max: int = 500, min: int = 0) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        label = label or name.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and len(v) > max:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be {max} characters or fewer."
        elif v and len(v) < min:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be at least {min} characters."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def email(self, name: str, label: str = "Email", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name).lower()
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and not EMAIL_RE.match(v):
            self.errors[name] = "Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def phone(self, name: str, label: str = "Phone", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and not PHONE_RE.match(v):
            self.errors[name] = "Enter a phone number using digits, spaces and an optional +."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def integer(self, name: str, label: str = "", required: bool = False, min: int = 0, max: int = 100000,
                default: int = 0) -> int:
        raw = self._raw(name)
        label = label or name.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
        if not raw:
            if required:
                self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
            self.data[name] = default
            return default
        try:
            v = int(raw)
        except ValueError:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a whole number."
            self.data[name] = default
            return default
        if v < min or v > max:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be between {min} and {max}."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def date(self, name: str, label: str = "Date", required: bool = False, future: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v:
            try:
                d = date.fromisoformat(v)
                if future and d < date.today():
                    self.errors[name] = f"{label} can't be in the past."
            except ValueError:
                self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a valid date."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def time(self, name: str, label: str = "Time", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and not TIME_RE.match(v):
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a time like 14:30."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def url(self, name: str, label: str = "Link", required: bool = False) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if v and not re.match(r"^https?://", v, re.I):
            v = "https://" + v
        if required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} is required."
        elif v and (len(v) > 600 or not re.match(r"^https?://[^\s<>\"]+\.[^\s<>\"]+", v, re.I)):
            self.errors[name] = f"{label} must be a web address."
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def color(self, name: str, default: str) -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        if not HEX_RE.match(v or ""):
            v = default
        self.data[name] = v.upper()
        return v.upper()

    def choice(self, name: str, options: Iterable[str], label: str = "", required: bool = False, default: str = "") -> str:
        v = self._raw(name)
        opts = list(options)
        if v and v not in opts:
            self.errors[name] = f"Choose one of the listed {label.lower() or 'options'}."
            v = default
        elif required and not v:
            self.errors[name] = f"{label or 'This'} is required."
        self.data[name] = v or default
        return v or default

    def flag(self, name: str) -> bool:
        v = self.req.get(name) in ("1", "on", "true", "yes")
        self.data[name] = v
        return v

    def error(self, name: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.errors[name] = message

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return not self.errors


# --- rendering -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def csrf(req) -> str:
    return f'<input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{esc(req.csrf)}">'


def honeypot() -> str:
    return ('<div class="hp" aria-hidden="true"><label>Leave this empty <input name="website" tabindex="-1" '
            'autocomplete="off"></label></div>')


def errors_summary(errors: dict) -> str:
    if not errors:
        return ""
    items = "".join(f"<li>{esc(m)}</li>" for m in errors.values())
    return (f'<div class="form-errors" role="alert" tabindex="-1" data-focus><b>Please fix '
            f'{"this" if len(errors) == 1 else "these " + str(len(errors))} '
            f'{"item" if len(errors) == 1 else "items"}:</b><ul>{items}</ul></div>')


def _attrs(attrs: Optional[dict]) -> str:
    if not attrs:
        return ""
    out = []
    for k, v in attrs.items():
        if v is True:
            out.append(f" {k}")
        elif v not in (False, None):
            out.append(f' {k}="{esc(v)}"')
    return "".join(out)


def field(name: str, label: str, value: Any = "", type: str = "text", required: bool = False, hint: str = "",
          errors: Optional[dict] = None, attrs: Optional[dict] = None, wrap_class: str = "") -> str:
    err = (errors or {}).get(name)
    fid = "f-" + name.replace("_", "-")
    described = f' aria-describedby="{fid}-hint"' if hint else ""
    if err:
        described = f' aria-describedby="{fid}-err"' + (f' aria-errormessage="{fid}-err"' if True else "")
    a = _attrs(attrs)
    req_attr = " required" if required else ""
    inv = ' aria-invalid="true"' if err else ""
    if type == "textarea":
        control = (f'<textarea class="textarea" id="{fid}" name="{esc(name)}"{req_attr}{inv}{described}{a}>'
                   f'{esc(value)}</textarea>')
    else:
        control = (f'<input class="input" id="{fid}" name="{esc(name)}" type="{type}" value="{esc(value)}"'
                   f'{req_attr}{inv}{described}{a}>')
    req_mark = ' <span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span>' if required else ""
    hint_html = f'<span class="hint" id="{fid}-hint">{hint}</span>' if hint else ""
    err_html = f'<span class="field-error" id="{fid}-err">{esc(err)}</span>' if err else ""
    cls = "field" + (" has-error" if err else "") + (f" {wrap_class}" if wrap_class else "")
    return f'<div class="{cls}"><label for="{fid}">{esc(label)}{req_mark}</label>{control}{hint_html}{err_html}</div>'


def select(name: str, label: str, options: Iterable, value: Any = "", required: bool = False, hint: str = "",
           errors: Optional[dict] = None, blank: str = "", attrs: Optional[dict] = None) -> str:
    err = (errors or {}).get(name)
    fid = "f-" + name.replace("_", "-")
    opts = [f'<option value="">{esc(blank)}</option>'] if blank else []
    for o in options:
        v, t = (o if isinstance(o, (tuple, list)) else (o, o))[:2]
        sel = " selected" if str(v) == str(value) else ""
        opts.append(f'<option value="{esc(v)}"{sel}>{esc(t)}</option>')
    req_mark = ' <span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span>' if required else ""
    hint_html = f'<span class="hint">{hint}</span>' if hint else ""
    err_html = f'<span class="field-error">{esc(err)}</span>' if err else ""
    return (f'<div class="field{" has-error" if err else ""}"><label for="{fid}">{esc(label)}{req_mark}</label>'
            f'<select class="select" id="{fid}" name="{esc(name)}"{" required" if required else ""}{_attrs(attrs)}>'
            f'{"".join(opts)}</select>{hint_html}{err_html}</div>')


def check(name: str, label: str, checked: bool = False, value: str = "1", hint: str = "", attrs: Optional[dict] = None,
          type: str = "checkbox") -> str:
    c = " checked" if checked else ""
    hint_html = f'<span class="hint" style="display:block">{hint}</span>' if hint else ""
    return (f'<label class="check"><input type="{type}" name="{esc(name)}" value="{esc(value)}"{c}{_attrs(attrs)}>'
            f'<span>{label}{hint_html}</span></label>')


def switch(name: str, label: str, checked: bool = False, attrs: Optional[dict] = None) -> str:
    c = " checked" if checked else ""
    return (f'<label class="switch"><input type="checkbox" name="{esc(name)}" value="1"{c}{_attrs(attrs)}>'
            f'<span>{esc(label)}</span></label>')


def color(name: str, label: str, value: str) -> str:
    fid = "f-" + name
    return (f'<div class="field"><label for="{fid}">{esc(label)}</label><div class="color-field">'
            f'<input type="color" id="{fid}" value="{esc(value)}" data-sync="{esc(name)}" aria-label="{esc(label)}">'
            f'<input type="text" name="{esc(name)}" value="{esc(value)}" maxlength="7" pattern="#[0-9A-Fa-f]{{6}}" '
            f'aria-label="{esc(label)} hex value"></div></div>')


def fmt_date(iso: Optional[str], long: bool = True) -> str:
    if not iso:
        return ""
    try:
        d = date.fromisoformat(iso[:10])
    except ValueError:
        return iso
    return d.strftime("%A, %-d %B %Y") if long else d.strftime("%-d %b %Y")


def fmt_time(hhmm: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not hhmm:
        return ""
    try:
        t = datetime.strptime(hhmm, "%H:%M")
    except ValueError:
        return hhmm
    return t.strftime("%H:%M")


def fmt_dt(iso: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """UTC ISO timestamp → '16 Nov 2026, 14:05' in SAST (UTC+2, no DST)."""
    if not iso:
        return ""
    try:
        from datetime import timedelta
        d = datetime.fromisoformat(iso) + timedelta(hours=2)
        return d.strftime("%-d %b %Y, %H:%M")
    except ValueError:
        return iso


def days_until(iso: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    if not iso:
        return None
    try:
        return (date.fromisoformat(iso[:10]) - date.today()).days
    except ValueError:
        return None


def slugify(text: str, max_len: int = 60) -> str:
    text = text.lower().replace("&", " and ")
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")
    return text[:max_len].strip("-") or "event"
```

```python
def brand(href: str = "/") -> str:

def head(title: str, description: str = "", extra: str = "", noindex: bool = False) -> str:
    full = title if config.BRAND_NAME in title else f"{title} · {config.BRAND_NAME}"

{THEME_SCRIPT}{extra}</head>"""


def toasts(req) -> str:

    html = "".join(
        f'<div class="toast toast--{esc(k)} glass glass--strong" role="status">{i(icon.get(k, "info"))}'
        f'<span>{esc(m)}</span><button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" data-dismiss>×</button></div>'

def page(req, title: str, body: str, current: str = "", description: str = "", body_class: str = "site",

def _csrf(req) -> str:
    return f'<input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{esc(req.csrf)}">'


def side_link(href: str, label: str, icon: str, current: str, locked: bool = False) -> str:
    cur = ' aria-current="page"' if current == href else ""
    lock = i("lock", "lock") if locked else ""
    return f'<a class="side-link" href="{href}"{cur}>{i(icon)}<span>{esc(label)}</span>{lock}</a>'


def error_page(req, status: int, message: str) -> str:
    titles = {403: "Not allowed", 404: "Page not found", 405: "Not allowed", 500: "Something went wrong"}
    title = titles.get(status, "Error")
    body = f"""<section class="page-hero" style="min-height:70vh;display:grid;align-content:center"><div class="grid-texture"></div>
<div class="container"><p class="mono muted">Error {status}</p><h1 style="margin-top:10px">{esc(title)}</h1>
<p class="lead">{esc(message if status != 404 else "The page you were looking for isn't here. It may have moved, or the link may be private.")}</p>
<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:28px"><a class="btn btn--primary" href="/">Go to the home page</a><a class="btn btn--secondary" href="/contact">Contact support</a></div></div></section>"""
    return page(req, title, body, noindex=True)
```

```python
"""Organiser tools: guests (with CSV import), RSVPs, seating editor, menu, programme, communications."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import json
import re
import secrets
from urllib.parse import quote

from .. import auth, catalog, db, events, notify
from ..icons import i
from ..services import email as mail
from ..web import HTTPError, Response, download, esc, json_response, redirect, router, url
from . import forms
from .forms import Form, csrf
from .shell import locked_panel, organiser_page, page_head

MEAL_PILL = ' <span class="pill pill--gold pill--plain">Meal option</span>'
BR_MUTED = '<br><span class="small muted">'
BR_SMALL = '<br><span class="small">'
COURSES = ["Canapés", "Starter", "Main", "Dessert", "Drinks", "Late-night", "Other"]
KINDS = [("ceremony", "Ceremony"), ("reception", "Reception"), ("speech", "Speech"), ("entertainment", "Entertainment"),
         ("activity", "Activity"), ("meal", "Meal"), ("other", "Other")]
STATUS_LABEL = {"attending": "Attending", "declined": "Declined", "pending": "Pending"}
DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = ["Family", "Friends", "Colleagues"]


# --- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load(req, uid: str) -> dict:
    return events.parse(auth.event_for(req, uid))


def base(ev) -> str:
    return f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}"


def has(ev, feature: str) -> bool:
    return catalog.has_feature(ev, feature)


def go(req, ev, suffix: str, kind: str = "", msg: str = ""):
    if msg:
        req.flash(kind or "success", msg)
    return redirect(base(ev) + suffix)


def _guest(ev, gid: int):
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE id = ? AND event_id = ?", (gid, ev["id"]))
    if g is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return g


def status_pill(status: str) -> str:
    return f'<span class="pill pill--{esc(status)}">{esc(STATUS_LABEL.get(status, status))}</span>'


def wa_digits(phone: str) -> str:
    d = re.sub(r"\D", "", phone or "")
    if d.startswith("0") and len(d) == 10:
        d = "27" + d[1:]
    return d


def guest_whatsapp(ev, g) -> str:
    msg = (f"Hi {g['first_name']}, you're invited to {ev['name']}. "
           f"Your personal invitation and RSVP link: {events.invite_url(ev, g)}")
    d = wa_digits(g["phone"])
    return f"https://wa.me/{d}?text={quote(msg)}" if d else f"https://wa.me/?text={quote(msg)}"


def categories_for(ev) -> list:
    gs = ev.get("guest_settings") or {}
    cats = [c for c in (gs.get("categories") or []) if c]
    if not has(ev, "guest_categories"):
        return DEFAULT_CATEGORIES
    return list(dict.fromkeys(cats + DEFAULT_CATEGORIES + ["VIP"]))


def tabs(ev, current: str, items: list) -> str:
    links = "".join(f'<a href="{base(ev)}{s}"{" aria-current=page" if s == current else ""}>{esc(l)}</a>' for s, l in items)
    return f'<nav class="tabs" aria-label="Section">{links}</nav>'
```
