```python
def section_head(title: str, intro: str = "", side: str = "", variant: str = "") -> str:
    cls = "section-head" + (f" section-head--{variant}" if variant else "")
    intro_html = f'<p class="section-head__intro">{intro}</p>' if intro else ""
    if variant == "split":
        return f'<div class="{cls}"><div class="stack" style="--stack:14px"><h2>{title}</h2>{intro_html}</div>{side}</div>'
    if variant == "pair":
        return f'<div class="{cls}"><h2>{title}</h2>{intro_html}</div>'
    return f'<div class="{cls}"><h2>{title}</h2>{intro_html}</div>'


def category_art(group: str) -> str:
    """Line art in the accent colour over a soft wash (no stock photos needed)."""
    wash = {"weddings": "--glow-blush", "baby": "--glow-sky", "parties": "--glow-peach", "other": "--glow-mint"}.get(group, "--glow-accent")
    common = 'fill="none" stroke="var(--color-accent)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"'
    art = {
        "weddings": f'<circle cx="150" cy="120" r="54" {common}/><circle cx="214" cy="120" r="54" {common}/>'
                    f'<path d="M110 250V170a72 72 0 0 1 144 0v80" {common} opacity=".55"/><path d="M182 52l10-14 10 14-10 12z" {common}/>',
        "baby": f'<path d="M226 72a58 58 0 1 0 40 88 46 46 0 1 1-40-88z" {common}/>'
                f'<path d="M110 70l4 12 12 4-12 4-4 12-4-12-12-4 12-4zM300 150l3 8 8 3-8 3-3 8-3-8-8-3 8-3zM140 190l2 6 6 2-6 2-2 6-2-6-6-2 6-2z" {common}/>',
        "parties": f'<path d="M120 230l50-140 90 90z" {common}/><path d="M165 120c10 20 30 40 60 50" {common} opacity=".6"/>'
                   f'<circle cx="270" cy="70" r="6" {common}/><path d="M300 110l14-8M240 40l4-14M310 160h14M200 60l-10-10" {common}/>'
                   f'<rect x="90" y="80" width="12" height="12" rx="2" transform="rotate(20 96 86)" {common}/>',
        "other": f'<path d="M110 120l90-40 90 40-90 40z" {common}/><path d="M150 140v44c30 22 70 22 100 0v-44M290 120v58" {common}/>'
                 f'<path d="M100 240c30-30 70-36 100-30 30-6 70 0 100 30" {common} opacity=".55"/>',
    }.get(group, "")
    return (f'<svg class="cat-tile__art" viewBox="0 0 360 300" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" aria-hidden="true">'
            f'<defs><radialGradient id="wash-{group}" cx="70%" cy="20%" r="80%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="rgb(var({wash}))" stop-opacity=".55"/>'
            f'<stop offset="1" stop-color="rgb(var({wash}))" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient></defs>'
            f'<rect width="360" height="300" fill="url(#wash-{group})"/>{art}</svg>')


def category_tiles() -> str:
    tiles = []
    for key, g in catalog.GROUPS.items():
        photo = stock.url(key)
        art = (f'<div class="cat-tile__photo"><img src="{photo}" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></div>' if photo else category_art(key))
        tiles.append(f"""<a class="cat-tile" href="{g['path']}" data-reveal>{art}
<h3>{esc(g['name'])}</h3><p>{esc(g['blurb'])}</p><span class="arrow-link"><span>Explore {esc(g['name'].lower())}</span>{i("arrow")}</span></a>""")
    return f'<div class="grid grid--4" data-stagger>{"".join(tiles)}</div>'


def template_card(t, group: str = "") -> str:
    groups = db.loads(t["groups"], [])
    g = group if group in groups else (groups[0] if groups else "weddings")
    tags = "".join(f'<span class="tag">{esc(x)}</span>' for x in db.loads(t["tags"], [])[:3])
    return f"""<article class="tpl-card" data-groups="{esc(' '.join(groups))}" data-reveal>
<div class="tpl-card__stage" data-fit><iframe src="/templates/{esc(t['slug'])}/preview?group={g}" width="1280" title="{esc(t['name'])} template preview" loading="lazy" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true"></iframe></div>
<div class="tpl-card__body"><div class="tpl-card__row"><h3><a href="/templates/{esc(t['slug'])}">{esc(t['name'])}</a></h3><span class="tpl-card__dir">{esc(t['direction'])}</span></div>
<p class="card__text">{esc(t['description'])}</p><div class="cluster">{tags}</div>
<div class="tpl-card__foot"><a class="btn btn--sm btn--secondary" href="/templates/{esc(t['slug'])}">{i("eye")} Preview</a>
<a class="btn btn--sm btn--primary" href="/create?template={esc(t['slug'])}">Use this template</a></div></div></article>"""


def price_cards(highlight_cta: bool = True) -> str:
    out = []
    for p in catalog.packages():
        bullets = db.loads(p["bullets"], [])
        limits = db.loads(p["limits"], {})
        items = "".join(
            f'<li class="{"is-first" if n == 0 and b.startswith("Everything") else ""}">{i("check")}<span>{esc(b)}</span></li>'
            for n, b in enumerate(bullets))
        lim = "".join(
            f'<div><span>{esc(label)}</span><b>{esc(limits.get(k, "-")) if limits.get(k, 0) else "Not included"}</b></div>'
            for k, label in catalog.LIMIT_LABELS.items())
        badge = '<span class="price__badge">Recommended</span>' if p["highlight"] else ""
        btn = "btn--primary" if p["highlight"] else "btn--secondary"
        out.append(f"""<article class="price{' price--highlight' if p['highlight'] else ''}" data-reveal>{badge}
<div><h3>{esc(p['name'])}</h3><p class="muted small" style="margin-top:6px">{esc(p['tagline'])}</p></div>
<div class="price__amount">{catalog.money(p['price_cents'])}<small>once-off{', VAT incl.' if config.VAT_REGISTERED else ''}</small></div>
<ul>{items}</ul><div class="price__limits">{lim}</div>
<a class="btn {btn} btn--block" href="/create?package={esc(p['code'])}">Choose {esc(p['name'].split()[0])}</a></article>""")
    return f'<div class="price-grid" data-stagger>{"".join(out)}</div>'

@router.get("/robots.txt")
def robots(req):
    """Marketing pages may be indexed; event websites, accounts and admin may not."""
    from ..web import Response
    body = ("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /events/\nDisallow: /dashboard\nDisallow: /admin\nDisallow: /media/\n"
            "Disallow: /login\nDisallow: /register\nDisallow: /pay/\n"
            f"Sitemap: {config.BASE_URL}/sitemap.xml\n")
    return Response(body, content_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8")


@router.get("/sitemap.xml")
def sitemap(req):
    from ..web import Response
    paths = SITEMAP_PATHS + [f"/templates/{t['slug']}" for t in db.q("SELECT slug FROM templates WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY sort, id")]
    urls = "".join(f"<url><loc>{esc(config.BASE_URL + p)}</loc></url>" for p in paths)
    return Response(f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">{urls}</urlset>',
                    content_type="application/xml; charset=utf-8")

GROUP_BY_PATH = {g["path"]: k for k, g in catalog.GROUPS.items()}


def category_page(req, group: str):
    g = catalog.GROUPS[group]
    title, intro, feats = CATEGORY_COPY[group]
    cats = [c for c in catalog.categories() if c["group_slug"] == group]
    cat_cards = "".join(f"""<article class="card card--link" data-reveal><h3 class="card__title"><a href="/create?category={esc(c['slug'])}">{esc(c['name'])}</a></h3>
<p class="card__text">{esc(c['description'])}</p><div class="card__foot"><span class="arrow-link"><span>Start a {esc(c['name'].lower())}</span>{i("arrow")}</span></div></article>""" for c in cats)
    tpls = "".join(template_card(t, group) for t in catalog.templates(group))
    feat_html = "".join(f'<div class="feature" data-reveal><span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">{i(ic)}</span><h3>{esc(t)}</h3><p>{esc(d)}</p></div>'
                        for ic, t, d in feats)
    extra = (f'<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:28px"><a class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" href="/create?group={group}">'
             f'Create your {esc(g["name"].lower().rstrip("s"))} website {i("arrow", "i--arrow")}</a>'
             f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--lg" href="#templates">See templates</a></div>')
    grid_cls = "grid--3" if len(cats) % 3 == 0 else "grid--2" if len(cats) % 2 == 0 else "grid--3"
    body = (page_hero(esc(title), esc(intro), [(g["name"], "")], extra) + f"""
<section class="section"><div class="container">{section_head("Choose your occasion")}<div class="grid {grid_cls}" data-stagger>{cat_cards}</div></div></section>
<section class="section section--surface" id="templates"><div class="container">{section_head(f"Templates for {esc(g['name'].lower())}", "Preview any design with sample content, on desktop and mobile.")}
<div class="grid grid--3" data-stagger>{tpls}</div></div></section>
<section class="section"><div class="container">{section_head("Made for this kind of event")}<div class="grid grid--4" data-stagger>{feat_html}</div></div></section>
{cta_panel()}""")
    return page(req, g["name"], body, g["path"], description=intro)


def _cat_route(path, group):
    router.get(path, name=f"category_{group}")(lambda req: category_page(req, group))


for _k, _g in catalog.GROUPS.items():
    _cat_route(_g["path"], _k)


# --- templates ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/templates")
def templates_gallery(req):
    current = req.arg("category")
    rows = catalog.templates()
    counts = {k: sum(1 for t in rows if k in db.loads(t["groups"], [])) for k in catalog.GROUPS}
    chips = [f'<button class="chip" type="button" data-filter="all" aria-pressed="{"false" if current in catalog.GROUPS else "true"}">All <span class="count">{len(rows)}</span></button>']
    chips += [f'<button class="chip" type="button" data-filter="{k}" aria-pressed="{"true" if current == k else "false"}">{esc(g["name"])} <span class="count">{counts[k]}</span></button>'
              for k, g in catalog.GROUPS.items()]
    cards = []
    for t in rows:
        groups = db.loads(t["groups"], [])
        hidden = current in catalog.GROUPS and current not in groups
        card = template_card(t, current if current in catalog.GROUPS else "")
        if hidden:
            card = card.replace('<article class="tpl-card"', '<article class="tpl-card" hidden', 1)
        cards.append(card)
    body = (page_hero('Event website <span class="serif grad">templates</span>',
                      "Eleven designs with their own layouts and character. Filter by occasion, preview on desktop and mobile, then make it yours.",
                      [("Templates", "")]) + f"""
<section class="section"><div class="container"><div class="chips-scroll" data-filter-bar role="group" aria-label="Filter by event type" style="margin-bottom:28px">{"".join(chips)}</div>
<div class="grid grid--3">{"".join(cards)}</div></div></section>{cta_panel("Found the one?", "Start with any template. You can switch designs at any time before and after publishing.")}""")
    return page(req, "Templates", body, "/templates", description="Browse premium event website templates for weddings, baby showers, parties and corporate events.")


@router.get("/templates/<slug:slug>")
def template_detail(req, slug):
    t = catalog.template(slug)
    if not t or not t["active"]:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    groups = db.loads(t["groups"], [])
    group = req.arg("group") if req.arg("group") in groups else (groups[0] if groups else "weddings")
    from ..eventsite import themes
    d = themes.design(t["design"])
    swatches = "".join(
        f'<div class="row" style="gap:10px"><span class="palette-swatches">{"".join(f"<i style=background:{c}></i>" for c in (p[2]["bg"], p[2]["text"], p[2]["accent"], p[2]["accent2"]))}</span><span class="small">{esc(p[1])}</span></div>'
        for p in d["palettes"])
    fonts = ", ".join(themes.FONT_PAIRS[f][0] for f in d["fonts"])
    group_links = "".join(
        f'<a href="{url("/templates/" + slug, group=k)}"{" aria-current=page" if k == group else ""}>{esc(catalog.GROUPS[k]["name"])}</a>'
        for k in groups)
    others = "".join(template_card(x) for x in catalog.templates() if x["slug"] != slug and set(db.loads(x["groups"], [])) & set(groups))
    body = page_hero(f'{esc(t["name"])} <span class="serif grad">template</span>', esc(t["description"]),
                     [("Templates", "/templates"), (t["name"], "")],
                     f'<div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:24px"><a class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" href="/create?template={esc(slug)}&group={group}">Use this template {i("arrow", "i--arrow")}</a></div>') + f"""
<section class="section"><div class="container"><div class="cols cols--2" style="grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)">
<div class="preview-frame" data-preview data-device="desktop"><div class="preview-frame__bar"><span class="preview-frame__url">{esc(config.BASE_URL)}/events/sample</span>
<div class="row" style="gap:8px"><div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Sample content">{group_links}</div>
<div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Device"><button type="button" data-device="desktop" aria-pressed="true">{i("monitor")}<span class="sr-only">Desktop</span></button><button type="button" data-device="mobile" aria-pressed="false">{i("phone")}<span class="sr-only">Mobile</span></button></div></div></div>
<div class="preview-frame__stage" style="height:min(78vh,820px)"><iframe src="/templates/{esc(slug)}/preview?group={group}" title="{esc(t['name'])} preview with sample content"></iframe></div></div>
</div>
<div class="grid grid--3" style="margin-top:var(--gap)">
<div class="box"><h3 style="font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:12px">Design direction</h3><p class="muted small">{esc(t["direction"])}. Sample content shown; your names, photos and wording replace it.</p></div>
<div class="box"><h3 style="font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:12px">Colour palettes</h3><div class="stack" style="--stack:8px">{swatches}</div><p class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:10px">Or set your own colours.</p></div>
<div class="box"><h3 style="font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:12px">Typography</h3><p class="muted small">{esc(fonts)}</p></div>
</div></div></section>
<section class="section section--surface"><div class="container">{section_head("You might also like")}<div class="grid grid--3">{others}</div></div></section>"""
    return page(req, f"{t['name']} template", body, "/templates", description=t["description"])

@router.get("/pricing")
def pricing(req):
    pkgs = list(catalog.packages())
    head = "".join(f'<th scope="col">{esc(p["name"].replace(" Experience", ""))}<br><span class="muted tiny mono">{catalog.money(p["price_cents"])}</span></th>' for p in pkgs)
    rows = []
    for key, label in catalog.FEATURES.items():
        cells = "".join(
            f'<td class="{"yes" if key in db.loads(p["features"], []) else "no"}">'
            f'{i("check") if key in db.loads(p["features"], []) else "—"}<span class="sr-only">{"Included" if key in db.loads(p["features"], []) else "Not included"}</span></td>'
            for p in pkgs)
        rows.append(f"<tr><th scope='row' style='font-weight:400'>{esc(label)}</th>{cells}</tr>")
    for key, label in catalog.LIMIT_LABELS.items():
        cells = "".join(f'<td class="mono">{esc(db.loads(p["limits"], {}).get(key, 0)) or "—"}</td>' for p in pkgs)
        rows.append(f"<tr><th scope='row' style='font-weight:400'>{esc(label)}</th>{cells}</tr>")
    notes = [
        ("Unlimited link sharing", "Share your event link with as many people as you like, on any channel. It is not unlimited email: each package includes the guest email allowance shown above."),
        ("Pay once", "One payment per event. No subscriptions, no per-guest or per-invitation charges."),
        ("Upgrade any time", "Move to a bigger package from your dashboard and pay only the difference."),
        ("Hosting period", "Your website stays online for the months shown, counted from when it is published, and never goes offline before a month after your event. Extensions are available."),
    ]
    note_html = "".join(f'<div class="box"><h3 style="font-size:1rem">{esc(t)}</h3><p class="muted small" style="margin-top:8px">{esc(d)}</p></div>' for t, d in notes)
    body = page_hero('Simple pricing, <span class="serif grad">paid once</span>',
                     "Every package includes your personalised event website, a premium template and unlimited link sharing. Choose the tools you need.",
                     [("Pricing", "")]) + f"""
<section class="section"><div class="container">{price_cards()}
<div class="notice" style="margin-top:22px">{i("wand")}<span>Short on time? <a class="text-link" href="/help-me-set-up">We can set it up for you</a>. Tell us about your event and we'll send you a quote.</span></div></div></section>
<section class="section section--surface"><div class="container">{section_head("Compare every feature")}
<div class="table-wrap table-wrap--sticky"><table class="compare"><thead><tr><th scope="col">Feature</th>{head}</tr></thead><tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table></div></div></section>
<section class="section"><div class="container">{section_head("Good to know")}<div class="grid grid--4">{note_html}</div></div></section>
<section class="section section--surface"><div class="container container--narrow">{section_head("Pricing questions")}{faq_list([FAQ[2], FAQ[4], FAQ[8], FAQ[7]])}</div></section>
{cta_panel()}"""
    return page(req, "Pricing", body, "/pricing", description="Essential, Premium and Signature event packages in South African Rand. Pay once, no per-guest fees.")

# --- contact & support ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TOPICS = [("general", "General question"), ("event", "Help with my event"), ("setup_help", "Set up my event for me"),
          ("payment", "Payments and receipts"), ("technical", "Something isn't working"), ("privacy", "Privacy or data request"),
          ("partnership", "Partnerships")]
REACH = [("whatsapp", "WhatsApp"), ("phone", "Phone call"), ("email", "Email")]


@router.route("/help-me-set-up", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def setup_help(req):
    """Done-for-you set-up: a free request; the team replies with a quote."""
    f = Form(req)
    sent = None
    user = req.user
    if req.method == "POST":
        if req.get("website"):
            return redirect("/help-me-set-up")
        if auth.rate_limited(f"setup-help:{req.ip}", 5, 3600):
            f.error("message", "You've sent several requests already. Please wait a little before sending another.")
        name = f.text("name", "Your name", required=True, max=120)
        email_addr = f.email("email", required=True)
        phone = f.text("phone", "Mobile", max=40)
        reach = f.choice("reach", [k for k, _ in REACH], "contact options", default="email")
        if reach in ("whatsapp", "phone") and not phone:
            f.error("phone", "Add a mobile number so we can contact you on " + dict(REACH)[reach] + ".")
        occasion = f.choice("occasion", [c["slug"] for c in catalog.categories()], "occasions", required=True)
        if "occasion" in f.errors:
            f.errors["occasion"] = "Choose what you're celebrating."
        when = f.date("event_date", "Event date")
        pkg = f.choice("package", ["", *[p["code"] for p in catalog.packages()]], "packages", default="")
        message = f.text("message", "Anything else", max=3000)
        if f.ok:
            lines = [f"Occasion: {catalog.category_name(occasion)}", f"Date: {forms.fmt_date(when) if when else 'not set yet'}",
                     f"Package: {catalog.package(pkg)['name'] if pkg else 'not sure yet'}", f"Mobile: {phone or '-'}",
                     f"Contact by: {dict(REACH)[reach]}", "", message or "(no message)"]
            sid = db.insert("support_requests", {"user_id": user["id"] if user else None, "event_id": None, "name": name,
                                                 "email": email_addr, "topic": "setup_help", "message": "\n".join(lines), "priority": 1,
                                                 "created_at": db.now(), "updated_at": db.now()})
            sent = f"S-{sid:05d}"
            mail.send(email_addr, "setup_help_received", {"first_name": mail.first_name(name), "reference": sent},
                      user_id=user["id"] if user else None)
    if sent:
        form_html = (f'<div class="notice notice--success">{i("check")}<div><b>Thank you. Your reference is {esc(sent)}.</b>'
                     f'<p class="small" style="margin-top:4px">We\'ve emailed you a copy. We\'ll contact you within one working day to go through '
                     f'the details and send you a quote.</p></div></div>')
    else:
        d = f.data
        occ = [(c["slug"], f'{catalog.GROUPS[c["group_slug"]]["name"]}: {c["name"]}') for c in catalog.categories()]
        pk = [(p["code"], f'{p["name"]} ({catalog.money(p["price_cents"])})') for p in catalog.packages()]
        form_html = f"""<form class="form box" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}{honeypot()}{errors_summary(f.errors)}
<div class="form-row form-row--2">{field("name", "Your name", d.get("name", user["name"] if user else ""), required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "name"})}
{field("email", "Email", d.get("email", user["email"] if user else ""), type="email", required=True, errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "email"})}</div>
<div class="form-row form-row--2">{field("phone", "Mobile (optional)", d.get("phone", ""), type="tel", errors=f.errors, attrs={"autocomplete": "tel"})}
{select("reach", "Best way to reach you", REACH, d.get("reach") or "whatsapp")}</div>
<div class="form-row form-row--2">{select("occasion", "What are you celebrating?", occ, d.get("occasion") or req.arg("occasion"), required=True, blank="Choose one", errors=f.errors)}
{field("event_date", "Date (if you know it)", d.get("event_date", ""), type="date", errors=f.errors)}</div>
{select("package", "Package you're thinking of", pk, d.get("package") or req.arg("package") or "", blank="Not sure yet")}
{field("message", "Anything we should know? (optional)", d.get("message", ""), type="textarea", errors=f.errors, attrs={"rows": 4, "placeholder": "Venue, number of guests, the look you like, or questions."})}
<p class="tiny muted">We use these details only to help you with your event. See our <a class="text-link" href="/privacy">privacy notice</a>.</p>
<div><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Ask us to set it up {i("send")}</button></div></form>"""
    steps = "".join(f'<li><span class="mono">{n}</span><div><b>{esc(t)}</b><p class="small muted" style="margin-top:4px">{esc(x)}</p></div></li>'
                    for n, t, x in (("01", "Tell us about your event", "Send this short form. It takes a minute."),
                                    ("02", "We contact you", "Within one working day, on WhatsApp, by phone or email, whichever you prefer."),
                                    ("03", "Send us your details and photos", "Names, date, venue, wording and photos. Voice notes are fine."),
                                    ("04", "We build it, you approve it", "You get a preview link to check. We change anything you like."),
                                    ("05", "Pay and share", "Once you're happy, pay for your package and share your link.")))
    body = page_hero('We\'ll set it up <span class="serif grad">for you</span>',
                     "Short on time? Tell us about your event and our team builds your website for you. You check it, we change anything you like, and you pay only once you're happy.",
                     [("Set-up help", "")]) + f"""<section class="section"><div class="container"><div class="split split--57" style="align-items:start">
<div class="stack" style="--stack:18px"><ol class="how-list" style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:16px">{steps}</ol>
<div class="notice">{i("info")}<span>We send you a quote for the set-up with your package. Asking costs nothing and doesn't commit you.</span></div></div>
<div>{form_html}</div></div></div></section>"""
    return page(req, "We'll set it up for you", body, "/help-me-set-up",
                description=f"Let the {config.BRAND_NAME} team build your event website for you. Free request, quote within one working day.")


@router.route("/contact", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def contact(req):
    f = Form(req)
    sent = None
    user = req.user
    if req.method == "POST":
        if req.get("website"):
            return redirect("/contact")
        if auth.rate_limited(f"contact:{req.ip}", 6, 3600):
            f.error("message", "You've sent several messages already. Please wait a little before sending another.")
        name = f.text("name", "Your name", required=True, max=120)
        email_addr = f.email("email", required=True)
        topic = f.choice("topic", [k for k, _ in TOPICS], "topic", default="general")
        message = f.text("message", "Message", required=True, max=4000, min=10)
        event_id = None
        priority = 0
        if user:
            ev_uid = req.get("event")
            if ev_uid:
                row = db.one("SELECT id, paid_package FROM events WHERE uid = ? AND owner_id = ?", (ev_uid, user["id"]))
                if row:
                    event_id = row["id"]
                    priority = 1 if "priority_support" in catalog.package_features(row["paid_package"]) else 0
        if f.ok:
            sid = db.insert("support_requests", {"user_id": user["id"] if user else None, "event_id": event_id, "name": name,
                                                 "email": email_addr, "topic": topic, "message": message, "priority": priority,
                                                 "created_at": db.now(), "updated_at": db.now()})
            ref = f"S-{sid:05d}"
            mail.send(email_addr, "support_received", {"name": mail.first_name(name), "ref": ref, "message": message,
                                                       "priority_note": " (priority support)" if priority else ""},
                      user_id=user["id"] if user else None, event_id=event_id)
            sent = ref
    if sent:
        form_html = (f'<div class="notice notice--success">{i("check")}<div><b>Thank you. Your reference is {esc(sent)}.</b>'
                     f'<p class="small" style="margin-top:4px">We\'ve emailed you a copy and usually reply within one working day.</p></div></div>')
    else:
        ev_select = ""
        if user:
            evs = db.q("SELECT uid, name FROM events WHERE owner_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC", (user["id"],))
            if evs:
                ev_select = select("event", "Which event is this about? (optional)", [(e["uid"], e["name"]) for e in evs],
                                   req.get("event") or req.arg("event"), blank="Not about a specific event")
        d = f.data
        form_html = f"""<form class="form box" method="post" novalidate>{csrf(req)}{honeypot()}{errors_summary(f.errors)}
<div class="form-row form-row--2">{field("name", "Your name", d.get("name", user["name"] if user else ""), required=True, errors=f.errors)}
{field("email", "Email", d.get("email", user["email"] if user else ""), type="email", required=True, errors=f.errors)}</div>
{select("topic", "Topic", TOPICS, d.get("topic") or req.arg("topic") or "general")}{ev_select}
{field("message", "How can we help?", d.get("message", ""), type="textarea", required=True, errors=f.errors)}
<p class="tiny muted">We use these details only to answer you. See our <a class="text-link" href="/privacy">privacy notice</a>.</p>
<div><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Send message {i("send")}</button></div></form>"""
    body = page_hero('Contact and <span class="serif grad">support</span>', "Questions before you start, help with your event, or a privacy request. We're here.",
                     [("Contact", "")]) + f"""<section class="section"><div class="container"><div class="split split--57" style="align-items:start">
<div class="stack" style="--stack:18px"><div class="notice">{i("mail")}<div><b>Email</b><br><a class="text-link" href="mailto:{esc(config.SUPPORT_EMAIL)}">{esc(config.SUPPORT_EMAIL)}</a></div></div>
{f'<div class="notice">{i("chat")}<div><b>WhatsApp</b><br><a class="text-link" href="{esc(config.whatsapp_link())}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{esc(config.WHATSAPP_NUMBER)}</a></div></div>' if config.WHATSAPP_NUMBER else ""}
<div class="notice">{i("shield")}<div><b>Information officer (POPIA)</b><br><a class="text-link" href="mailto:{esc(config.INFORMATION_OFFICER)}">{esc(config.INFORMATION_OFFICER)}</a></div></div></div>
<div>{form_html}</div></div></div></section>"""
    return page(req, "Contact", body, "/contact")

def legal(req, title, path, html):

        f'<section class="section"><div class="container"><article class="prose">{LEGAL_NOTE}{html}</article></div></section>'

@router.get("/privacy")
def privacy(req):
    b = esc(config.BRAND_NAME)
    return legal(req, "Privacy notice", "/privacy", f"""
<p>{b} ("we") is the responsible party for the personal information of our customers, and an operator for the guest information our customers add to their events. We process personal information in line with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA).</p>
<h2>What we collect</h2><ul><li><b>Customers:</b> name, email, phone (optional), password (stored only as a salted hash), event details and payment records. Card details are handled by our payment gateway; we never see or store them.</li>
<li><b>Guests:</b> the details an organiser adds or a guest submits when replying: name, email or phone, attendance, plus-ones, children, meal choice, dietary needs and special requests.</li>
<li><b>Technical:</b> a session cookie to keep you signed in, a security cookie that protects forms, and basic server logs. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.</li></ul>
<h2>Why we use it</h2><ul><li>To provide the service you asked for: your event website, RSVPs, guest management, reports and emails.</li><li>To process payments and keep tax records.</li><li>To answer support requests and keep the platform secure.</li><li>To send product news only if you opt in.</li></ul>
<h2>Guest information</h2><p>Guest details belong to the organiser's event. They are visible only to that event's organiser and administrators, never to other guests, and never sold or used for our own marketing. Organisers must have a lawful reason to add guests and to email them. Every guest email includes a link to stop event emails.</p>
<h2>Sharing</h2><p>We share information only with service providers who help run the platform (hosting, email delivery, payment processing), under agreements that require them to protect it, or when the law requires it.</p>
<h2>How long we keep it</h2><p>Event data is kept for the hosting period plus 90 days so you can download reports, then deleted. Invoices are kept for five years for tax purposes.</p>
<h2>Your rights</h2><p>You can access, correct or delete your information, object to processing, and complain to the Information Regulator (inforegulator.org.za). Download your data or delete your account from your account page, or contact our information officer at <a href="mailto:{esc(config.INFORMATION_OFFICER)}">{esc(config.INFORMATION_OFFICER)}</a>.</p>
<h2>Security</h2><p>Passwords are hashed, sessions expire, every event is isolated to its organisers, uploads are checked, and access to administration is restricted and logged.</p>""")


@router.get("/terms")
def terms(req):
    b = esc(config.BRAND_NAME)
    return legal(req, "Terms of service", "/terms", f"""
<p>These terms apply when you create an account or buy a package from {b}.</p>
<h2>The service</h2><p>We provide tools to create an event website and manage guests, RSVPs, seating, menus, programmes, communication and reports. Features and limits depend on the package you buy, as shown on the pricing page at the time of purchase.</p>
<h2>Your account</h2><p>Keep your password safe. You are responsible for activity on your account and for the content you publish, including photos you upload, which must be yours to use.</p>
<h2>Guests and communication</h2><p>You confirm you have a lawful basis to add each guest's details and to email them about your event. Don't use the platform for marketing, spam or anything unlawful. We may suspend events that break these terms.</p>
<h2>Payments</h2><p>Prices are in South African Rand{' and include VAT' if config.VAT_REGISTERED else ''}. Your website is published only once our payment gateway confirms payment. Upgrades are charged as the difference between packages.</p>
<h2>Hosting period</h2><p>Your event website stays online for the hosting period of your package from the date it is first published. Whenever you book, it never goes offline before one month after your event date, including if you move the date. We'll remind you before it ends.</p>
<h2>Email allowance</h2><p>Unlimited link sharing means you can share your link as often as you like. Emails sent through the platform are limited to your package's allowance.</p>
<h2>Liability</h2><p>We work hard to keep the service available, but we can't guarantee it will be uninterrupted. To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the event concerned. Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Act.</p>
<h2>Changes</h2><p>We'll tell you about material changes to these terms by email before they take effect.</p>""")


@router.get("/refunds")
def refunds(req):
    return legal(req, "Refund policy", "/refunds", """
<p>We want you to be happy with your event website.</p>
<h2>Before you publish</h2><p>If you've paid but haven't published your website or emailed any guests, you can ask for a full refund within 14 days of payment.</p>
```

```python
"""Serve uploaded images with access control: the event must be live, or the viewer must manage it."""
from __future__ import annotations

from .. import auth, db, events
from ..services.storage import storage
from ..web import HTTPError, Response, router


@router.get("/media/<path:key>")
def media(req, key):
    row = db.one("SELECT * FROM uploads WHERE storage_key = ?", (key,))
    if row is None or row["event_id"] is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    ev = events.by_id(row["event_id"])
    from .public_event import is_available
    draft_id, _, draft_tok = req.cookies.get(events.DRAFT_COOKIE, "").partition(".")
    shared_draft = ev is not None and draft_id == str(ev["id"]) and events.draft_token_ok(ev, draft_tok)
    if ev is None or not (is_available(ev) or auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev) or shared_draft):
        raise HTTPError(404)
    data = storage.get(key)
    if data is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    r = Response(data, content_type=row["mime"])
    r.header("Cache-Control", "private, max-age=3600")
    r.header("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; sandbox")
    return r
```

```python
"""Checkout, the sandbox test checkout, gateway webhooks, payment status, billing and receipts."""
from __future__ import annotations

from .. import auth, catalog, config, db, events
from ..icons import i
from ..services import payments
from ..web import HTTPError, Response, download, esc, json_response, redirect, router
from .forms import csrf, fmt_dt
from .layout import page
from .shell import account_page, organiser_page, page_head


def _own_order(req, order_uid: str):
    user = auth.require_user(req)
    order = db.one("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE uid = ?", (order_uid,))
    if order is None or (order["user_id"] != user["id"] and user["role"] != "admin"):
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return order


@router.post("/dashboard/events/<uid>/checkout")
def checkout(req, uid):
    ev = events.parse(auth.event_for(req, uid))
    if ev["owner_id"] != req.user["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(403, "Only the event owner can make payments.")
    if not req.get("accept"):
        req.flash("error", "Please accept the terms and refund policy to continue.")
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/8")
    if ev["status"] == "suspended":
        req.flash("error", "This event is suspended. Contact support.")
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/8")
    try:
        order = payments.create_order(ev, req.user, req.get("package"))
        target = payments.gateway().checkout(order)
    except payments.PaymentError as e:
        req.flash("error", str(e))
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/8")
    if "redirect" in target:
        return redirect(target["redirect"])
    inputs = "".join(f'<input type="hidden" name="{esc(k)}" value="{esc(v)}">' for k, v in target["fields"])
    body = f"""<section class="page-hero" style="min-height:70vh;display:grid;align-content:center"><div class="container container--narrow">
<h1>Taking you to secure payment…</h1><p class="lead">You're paying {catalog.money(order["amount_cents"], True)} for {esc(order["description"])}.</p>
<form method="post" action="{esc(target['post_to'])}" id="pf">{inputs}<button class="btn btn--primary btn--lg" type="submit" style="margin-top:24px">Continue to {esc(payments.gateway().label)}</button></form>
<script>document.getElementById('pf').submit();</script></div></section>"""
    return page(req, "Secure payment", body, noindex=True)


# --- built-in sandbox checkout --------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/pay/sandbox/<order_uid>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def sandbox_checkout(req, order_uid):
    if config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY != "sandbox" or not payments.sandbox_allowed():
        raise HTTPError(404)
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    gw = payments.SandboxGateway()
    if req.method == "POST":
        decision = req.get("decision")
        if decision not in ("approve", "decline", "cancel"):
            raise HTTPError(400)
        if order["status"] == "pending":
            body, sig = gw.build_notification(order, decision)
            # Same path as an incoming webhook: signature, freshness and amount are verified.
            payments.apply(gw.verify(body, sig), "sandbox")
        return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}/payment/{order['uid']}")
    vat_rows = _vat_rows(order)
    body = f"""<section class="page-hero" style="padding-bottom:var(--section-y)"><div class="grid-texture"></div><div class="container container--narrow">
<span class="demo-flag">Sandbox · test payment, no money moves</span>
<h1 style="margin-top:16px">Test checkout</h1><p class="lead">This page stands in for the payment gateway while {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)} runs in development. Choose an outcome to send a signed test notification to the server.</p>
<div class="glass glass--strong panel" style="margin-top:28px;display:grid;gap:14px">
<dl class="dl"><dt>Order</dt><dd class="mono">{esc(order['uid'])}</dd><dt>Item</dt><dd>{esc(order['description'])}</dd>
{vat_rows}
<dt><b>Total</b></dt><dd class="mono"><b>{catalog.money(order['amount_cents'], True)}</b></dd><dt>Status</dt><dd><span class="pill pill--{esc(order['status'])}">{esc(order['status'])}</span></dd></dl>
{'' if order['status'] != 'pending' else f'''<form method="post" class="btn-row">{csrf(req)}
<button class="btn btn--primary" name="decision" value="approve" type="submit">{i("check")} Approve test payment</button>
<button class="btn btn--secondary" name="decision" value="decline" type="submit">Decline</button>
<button class="btn btn--ghost" name="decision" value="cancel" type="submit">Cancel</button></form>'''}
</div></div></section>"""
    return page(req, "Sandbox checkout", body, noindex=True)


@router.get("/pay/cancel/<order_uid>")
def pay_cancel(req, order_uid):
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    if order["status"] == "pending" and not db.val("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE order_id = ?", (order["id"],), 0):
        db.run("UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (db.now(), order["id"]))
    req.flash("info", "Payment cancelled. Nothing was charged.")
    return redirect(f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}/setup/8")


# --- webhooks (no CSRF: authenticated by signature) ---------------------------------------------------
@router.post("/webhooks/payments/sandbox", csrf=False)
def webhook_sandbox(req):
    if config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY != "sandbox" or not payments.sandbox_allowed():
        raise HTTPError(404)
    notif = payments.SandboxGateway().verify(req.body, req.headers.get("x-aurelia-signature", ""))
    ok, msg = payments.apply(notif, "sandbox")
    return json_response({"ok": notif.valid, "message": msg}, status=200 if notif.valid else 400)


@router.post("/webhooks/payments/payfast", csrf=False)
def webhook_payfast(req):
    if config.PAYMENT_GATEWAY != "payfast":
        raise HTTPError(404)
    gw = payments.PayFastGateway()
    notif = gw.verify_itn(req.body, req.ip)
    payments.apply(notif, "payfast")
    return Response("OK", content_type="text/plain")   # PayFast expects 200 regardless


# --- status / return page ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/api/orders/<order_uid>/status")
def order_status(req, order_uid):
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    return {"status": order["status"], "live": events.is_live(ev), "public_url": events.public_path(ev)}


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/payment/<order_uid>")
def payment_return(req, uid, order_uid):
    ev = events.parse(auth.event_for(req, uid))
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    if order["event_id"] != ev["id"]:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    st = order["status"]
    if st == "paid":
        live = events.is_live(ev)
        inner = f"""<div class="empty" style="border-style:solid"><span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">{i("check")}</span>
<h2>Payment confirmed{' and your website is live' if live else ''}</h2>
<p>Receipt {esc(order['invoice_no'])} is in your email. {'Share your link with guests now.' if live else 'Publish your website from Settings when you are ready.'}</p>
<div class="btn-row">{f'<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/dashboard/events/{uid}/share">{i("chat")} Share your link</a>' if live else ''}
<a class="btn btn--secondary" href="{events.public_path(ev)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{i("external")} Open website</a>
<a class="btn btn--ghost" href="/dashboard/orders/{order['uid']}/receipt">View receipt</a></div></div>"""
    elif st == "pending":
        inner = f"""<div class="empty" style="border-style:solid" data-poll="/api/orders/{order['uid']}/status"><span class="spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
<h2>Waiting for the payment gateway</h2><p>We publish your website as soon as the gateway confirms payment. This page updates by itself; it usually takes a few seconds.</p>
<a class="btn btn--ghost" href="/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/8">Back to packages</a></div>
<script>(function(){{var box=document.querySelector('[data-poll]'),n=0;function tick(){{fetch(box.getAttribute('data-poll'),{{headers:{{Accept:'application/json'}},credentials:'same-origin'}}).then(function(r){{return r.json();}}).then(function(j){{if(j.status!=='pending'){{location.reload();}}else if(++n<45){{setTimeout(tick,2000);}}else{{box.querySelector('p').textContent='Still waiting. If you completed the payment, it will appear here shortly; you can safely leave this page.';}}}});}}setTimeout(tick,1500);}})();</script>"""
    else:
        inner = f"""<div class="empty" style="border-style:solid"><span class="icon-tile">{i("alert")}</span><h2>Payment {esc(st)}</h2>
<p>Nothing was charged{f": {esc(order['failure_reason'])}" if order['failure_reason'] and order['failure_reason'] != st else ""}. Your event is saved; you can try again.</p>
<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/dashboard/events/{uid}/setup/8">Try again</a></div>"""
    body = page_head("Payment", f"Order {esc(order['uid'])} · {catalog.money(order['amount_cents'], True)}"
                     + (' · <span class="pill pill--sandbox">sandbox</span>' if order["mode"] == "sandbox" else "")) + inner
    return organiser_page(req, ev, "Payment", body, "/setup/8")


# --- billing & receipts ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/dashboard/billing")
def billing(req):
    user = auth.require_user(req)
    rows = db.q("""SELECT o.*, e.name AS event_name, e.uid AS event_uid FROM orders o JOIN events e ON e.id = o.event_id
                   WHERE o.user_id = ? ORDER BY o.created_at DESC""", (user["id"],))
    if rows:
        trs = "".join(f"""<tr><td><span class="mono">{esc(o['uid'])}</span><span class="table__sub">{esc(fmt_dt(o['created_at']))}</span></td>
<td><a href="/dashboard/events/{o['event_uid']}">{esc(o['event_name'])}</a><span class="table__sub">{esc(o['description'])}</span></td>
<td class="num mono">{catalog.money(o['amount_cents'], True)}</td><td><span class="pill pill--{esc(o['status'])}">{esc(o['status'])}</span>{' <span class="pill pill--sandbox">sandbox</span>' if o['mode'] == 'sandbox' else ''}</td>
<td>{f'<a href="/dashboard/orders/{o["uid"]}/receipt">Receipt</a>' if o['status'] == 'paid' else ''}</td></tr>""" for o in rows)
        table = f'<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Event</th><th class="num">Amount</th><th>Status</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>{trs}</tbody></table></div>'
    else:
        table = f'<div class="empty"><span class="icon-tile">{i("card")}</span><h2 style="font-size:1.2rem">No orders yet</h2><p>When you choose a package for an event, your orders and receipts appear here.</p></div>'
    return account_page(req, "Orders and receipts", page_head("Orders and receipts", "Every payment and its receipt.") + table, "/dashboard/billing")


def _vat_rows(order) -> str:
    """Excl.-VAT and VAT lines, shown only when the business is VAT-registered."""
    if not config.VAT_REGISTERED:
        return ""
    excl, vat = payments.vat_breakdown(order["amount_cents"])
    return (f'<dt>Amount excl. VAT</dt><dd class="mono">{catalog.money(excl, True)}</dd>'
            f'<dt>VAT ({int(config.VAT_RATE * 100)}%)</dt><dd class="mono">{catalog.money(vat, True)}</dd>')


@router.get("/dashboard/orders/<order_uid>/receipt")
def receipt(req, order_uid):
    order = _own_order(req, order_uid)
    if order["status"] not in ("paid", "refunded"):
        raise HTTPError(404)
    user = db.one("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (order["user_id"],))
    ev = events.by_id(order["event_id"])
    excl, vat = payments.vat_breakdown(order["amount_cents"])
    sandbox_note = "SANDBOX TEST PAYMENT. NOT A TAX INVOICE." if order["mode"] == "sandbox" else ""
    tax_invoice = config.VAT_REGISTERED and not sandbox_note
    title = "Tax invoice" if tax_invoice else "Receipt"
    if req.arg("format") == "pdf":
        try:
            from ..services.pdf import PDF
        except ImportError:
            raise HTTPError(404)
        doc = PDF(f"{config.BRAND_NAME} receipt", sandbox_note or title)
        doc.kv([("Invoice", order["invoice_no"] or ""), ("Order", order["uid"]), ("Paid", fmt_dt(order["paid_at"])),
                ("Billed to", f"{user['name']} <{user['email']}>"), ("Event", ev["name"])]
               + ([("VAT number", config.VAT_NUMBER)] if config.VAT_REGISTERED else []))
        doc.spacer(10)
        if config.VAT_REGISTERED:
            doc.table(["Description", "Excl. VAT", "VAT", "Total"],
                      [[order["description"], catalog.money(excl, True), catalog.money(vat, True), catalog.money(order["amount_cents"], True)]],
                      widths=[0.52, 0.16, 0.14, 0.18])
        else:
            doc.table(["Description", "Total"], [[order["description"], catalog.money(order["amount_cents"], True)]], widths=[0.8, 0.2])
        doc.spacer(10)
        doc.text(f"{config.BRAND_NAME} · {config.COMPANY_ADDRESS} · {config.SUPPORT_EMAIL}", size=8, muted=True)
        return download(doc.output(), f"{order['invoice_no'] or order['uid']}.pdf", "application/pdf")
    body = f"""{page_head("Receipt", "", f'<a class="btn btn--secondary btn--sm" href="?format=pdf">{i("download")} PDF</a><button class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm no-print" type="button" onclick="window.print()">{i("print")} Print</button>')}
<article class="box" style="max-width:760px">{f'<p class="demo-flag" style="margin-bottom:16px">{esc(sandbox_note)}</p>' if sandbox_note else ''}
<div class="row row--between" style="align-items:flex-start"><div><h2 style="font-size:1.4rem">{title}</h2><p class="muted small">{esc(config.BRAND_NAME)} · {esc(config.COMPANY_ADDRESS)}{"<br>VAT no. " + esc(config.VAT_NUMBER) if config.VAT_REGISTERED else ""}</p></div>
<div class="small" style="text-align:right"><b class="mono">{esc(order['invoice_no'] or '')}</b><br><span class="muted">{esc(fmt_dt(order['paid_at']))}</span></div></div><hr>
<dl class="dl"><dt>Billed to</dt><dd>{esc(user['name'])}<br><span class="muted">{esc(user['email'])}</span></dd><dt>Event</dt><dd>{esc(ev['name'])}</dd><dt>Order</dt><dd class="mono">{esc(order['uid'])}</dd>
<dt>Description</dt><dd>{esc(order['description'])}</dd>{_vat_rows(order)}
<dt><b>Total paid</b></dt><dd class="mono"><b>{catalog.money(order['amount_cents'], True)}</b></dd><dt>Status</dt><dd><span class="pill pill--{esc(order['status'])}">{esc(order['status'])}</span></dd></dl></article>"""
    return account_page(req, "Receipt", body, "/dashboard/billing")
```

### `app/views/public_event.py`

<!-- FILE: app/views/public_event.py sha256=a14bc068e90d0be1c62804e0eaed49be040f4b6505ed99a6ae364144ad57c0cf nl=1 -->
```python
"""Guest-facing event websites: public page, personal invitations, RSVP, unsubscribe, calendar,
plus the organiser preview and the template-gallery sample render."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

from .. import auth, catalog, config, db, events, notify
from ..eventsite import render as R
from ..eventsite import themes
from ..eventsite.demo import demo_event
from ..services import email as mail
from ..web import HTTPError, Response, esc, redirect, router
from .forms import EMAIL_RE, Form


def is_available(ev) -> bool:
    """Guests may open the site: published, paid, not suspended, inside the hosting period."""
    if not events.is_live(ev):
        return False
    hu = ev.get("hosting_until")
    if hu:
        try:
            if date.today() > date.fromisoformat(hu[:10]):
                return False
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return True


def simple_page(ev, title: str, body: str, status: int = 200) -> Response:
    """A small themed page (unavailable, unsubscribe) using the event's palette when known."""
    style, fonts = "", ""
    if ev:
        t = themes.resolve(R.design_key(ev), ev.get("design") or {})
        style = themes.css_vars(t) + R.contrast_vars(t["colors"])
        fonts = f'<link rel="stylesheet" href="{esc(themes.fonts_url(t["display"], t["body"]))}">'
    html = f"""<!doctype html><html lang="en-ZA"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{esc(title)}</title><meta name="robots" content="noindex"><link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">{fonts}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/eventsite.css"></head>
<body class="ev ev-simple" style="{style}"><main class="ev-simple__card">{body}
<p class="ev-made"><a href="/">Made with {esc(config.BRAND_NAME)}</a></p></main></body></html>"""
    return Response(html, status=status)


def unavailable(ev=None) -> Response:
    body = ('<h1>This event page isn\'t available</h1><p>The link may be private, the page may not be published yet, '
            'or the event has ended. If you were invited, please check with the hosts.</p>')
    return simple_page(ev, "Event page not available", body, 404)


def _load(slug: str):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return ev


@router.get("/events/<slug:slug>")
def event_page(req, slug):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        return unavailable()
    if is_available(ev):
        return Response(R.render(ev, "public", None, req))
    if auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev):
        return Response(R.render(ev, "preview", None, req, notice="Guests see an 'unavailable' page until it is published"))
    return unavailable(ev)


def _guest(ev, token: str):
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (token, ev["id"]))
    if g is None:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    return g


@router.get("/events/<slug:slug>/i/<token>")
def invitation(req, slug, token):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        return unavailable()
    guest = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (token, ev["id"]))
    if guest is None:
        return unavailable(ev)
    if is_available(ev):
        if not guest["invited_at"] and not auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev):    # the guest has their link
            db.run("UPDATE guests SET invited_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND invited_at IS NULL", (db.now(), guest["id"]))
        return Response(R.render(ev, "public", guest, req))
    if auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev):
        return Response(R.render(ev, "preview", guest, req, notice=f"Personal link for {events.guest_name(guest)}"))
    return unavailable(ev)


# --- RSVP -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
STATUS_TEXT_GUEST = {"attending": "attending", "declined": "not attending"}
STATUS_TEXT_ORG = {"attending": "is attending", "declined": "can't attend"}


def _rerender(req, ev, guest, form, status=400):
    values = {k: (",".join(v) if k == "dietary" else v[0]) for k, v in req.form.items() if k != "_csrf"}
    return Response(R.render(ev, "public", guest, req, form={"errors": form.errors, "values": values}), status=status)


@router.post("/events/<slug:slug>/rsvp")
def rsvp(req, slug):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None or not is_available(ev):
        return unavailable(ev)
    token = req.get("token")
    guest = _guest(ev, token) if token else None
    back = f"/events/{ev['slug']}" + (f"/i/{guest['token']}" if guest else "")
    if req.get("website"):  # honeypot: pretend all is well
        return redirect(back + "?rsvp=thanks#rsvp")
    if auth.rate_limited(f"rsvp:{req.ip}", 30, 600):
        raise HTTPError(429, "Too many replies from this connection. Please wait a few minutes and try again.")
    closed = R.rsvp_closed(ev)
    if closed:
        return Response(R.render(ev, "public", guest, req, notice=closed), status=409)

    f = Form(req)
    status = f.choice("status", ["attending", "declined"], "answer", required=True)
    if not status and "status" not in f.errors:
        f.error("status", "Tell us whether you'll attend.")
    if guest is None:
        first = f.text("first_name", "First name", required=True, max=80)
        last = f.text("last_name", "Surname", required=True, max=80)
        email_addr = f.email("email", required=True)
        phone = f.phone("phone")
    allow = R.allowances(ev, guest)
    plus = f.integer("plus_ones", "Guests joining you", min=0, max=allow["plus_ones"]) if allow["plus_ones"] else 0
    kids = f.integer("children", "Children", min=0, max=allow["children"]) if allow["children"] else 0
    plus_names = f.text("plus_one_names", "Their names", max=300) if allow["plus_ones"] else ""
    special = f.text("special_requests", "Message", max=1000)
    meal_id = None
    meal_options = {m["id"]: m for m in events.meal_options(ev["id"])}
    if meal_options and catalog.has_feature(ev, "menu", public=True) and events.visible_sections(ev)["menu"]:
        raw = f.text("meal_item_id", "Meal choice", max=12)
        if raw:
            try:
                meal_id = int(raw)
            except ValueError:
                meal_id = None
            if meal_id not in meal_options:
                f.error("meal_item_id", "Choose one of the listed meals.")
                meal_id = None
    dietary, allergies = "", ""
    if catalog.has_feature(ev, "dietary", public=True):
        offered = set(ev["info"].get("dietary_options") or events.DIETARY_OPTIONS)
        dietary = ", ".join(d for d in req.getlist("dietary") if d in offered)
        allergies = f.text("allergies", "Allergies", max=300)
    funcs = events.functions(ev["id"])
    multi = len(funcs) > 1 and catalog.has_feature(ev, "multi_functions", public=True)
    chosen_funcs = set()
    if multi:
        valid = {fn["id"] for fn in funcs}
        for x in req.getlist("functions"):
            if x.isdigit() and int(x) in valid:
                chosen_funcs.add(int(x))
        if status == "attending" and not chosen_funcs:
            f.error("functions", "Choose at least one part of the celebration.")
    if not f.ok:
        return _rerender(req, ev, guest, f)
    if status == "declined":
        plus, kids, plus_names, meal_id, dietary, allergies = 0, 0, "", None, "", ""

    now = db.now()
    via = "personal" if guest else "general"
    with db.transaction():
        if guest is None:
            existing = db.one("""SELECT * FROM guests WHERE event_id = ? AND email = ? AND status = 'pending'
                                 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1""", (ev["id"], email_addr))
            if existing is not None:
                guest_id = existing["id"]
                db.update("guests", guest_id, {"phone": existing["phone"] or phone})
            else:
                guest_id = db.insert("guests", {
                    "event_id": ev["id"], "token": events.new_guest_token(), "first_name": first, "last_name": last,
                    "email": email_addr, "phone": phone, "source": "general_link",
                    "plus_ones_allowed": allow["plus_ones"], "children_allowed": allow["children"],
                    "invited_at": None, "created_at": now, "updated_at": now})
        else:
            guest_id = guest["id"]
        db.update("guests", guest_id, {
            "status": status, "plus_ones": plus, "plus_one_names": plus_names, "children": kids,
            "meal_item_id": meal_id, "dietary": dietary, "allergies": allergies, "special_requests": special,
            "responded_at": now, "updated_at": now})
        if multi:
            db.run("DELETE FROM guest_functions WHERE guest_id = ?", (guest_id,))
            for fn in funcs:
                db.insert("guest_functions", {"guest_id": guest_id, "function_id": fn["id"],
                                              "attending": 1 if (status == "attending" and fn["id"] in chosen_funcs) else 0})
        db.insert("rsvp_responses", {"event_id": ev["id"], "guest_id": guest_id, "via": via, "created_at": now,
                                     "payload": db.dumps({"status": status, "plus_ones": plus, "plus_one_names": plus_names,
                                                          "children": kids, "meal_item_id": meal_id, "dietary": dietary,
                                                          "allergies": allergies, "special_requests": special,
                                                          "functions": sorted(chosen_funcs)})})
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE id = ?", (guest_id,))
    _notify(ev, g)
    return redirect(f"/events/{ev['slug']}/i/{g['token']}?rsvp=thanks#rsvp" if guest else back + "?rsvp=thanks#rsvp")


def _notify(ev, g) -> None:
    details = notify.rsvp_details_html(ev, g)
    try:
        if notify.can_email_guest(g):
            v = {**notify.event_vars(ev), **notify.guest_vars(ev, g),
                 "status_text": STATUS_TEXT_GUEST.get(g["status"], g["status"]), "details": details}
            mail.send(g["email"], "rsvp_confirmation", v, event_id=ev["id"], guest_id=g["id"])
        if (ev.get("report_prefs") or {}).get("new_rsvp", True):
            st = events.stats(ev["id"])
            notify.organiser(ev, "new_rsvp", {"guest_name": events.guest_name(g),
                                              "status_text": STATUS_TEXT_ORG.get(g["status"], g["status"]),
                                              "details": details, "attending": st["attending"],
                                              "declined": st["declined"], "pending": st["pending"]})
    except Exception as e:  # never lose an RSVP because an email failed
        import sys
        print(f"[rsvp] notification failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)


# --- unsubscribe ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.route("/events/<slug:slug>/u/<token>", methods=("GET", "POST"))
def unsubscribe(req, slug, token):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None:
        return unavailable()
    g = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (token, ev["id"]))
    if g is None:
        return unavailable(ev)
    host = esc(events.title(ev))
    if req.method == "POST":
        db.update("guests", g["id"], {"unsubscribed_at": db.now(), "email_consent": 0, "updated_at": db.now()})
        body = (f"<h1>You won't receive more emails</h1><p>We've stopped event emails from {host} to "
                f"{esc(g['email'] or 'you')}. Your RSVP is unchanged, and the event page still works from your link.</p>"
                f'<p><a class="ev-btn ev-btn--ghost" href="/events/{esc(ev["slug"])}/i/{esc(g["token"])}">Back to the event</a></p>')
        return simple_page(ev, "Unsubscribed", body)
    if g["unsubscribed_at"]:
        body = f"<h1>You're already unsubscribed</h1><p>You won't receive event emails from {host}.</p>"
        return simple_page(ev, "Unsubscribed", body)
    body = (f"<h1>Stop event emails?</h1><p>You'll no longer receive invitations, reminders or updates about "
            f"<b>{esc(ev['name'])}</b> from {host}. Under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) you can "
            f"withdraw consent at any time; we'll record the date you did.</p>"
            f'<form method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{esc(req.csrf)}">'
            f'<button class="ev-btn" type="submit">Stop emails</button></form>')
    return simple_page(ev, "Unsubscribe", body)


# --- calendar -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _ics_text(s: str) -> str:
    return (s or "").replace("\\", "\\\\").replace(";", "\\;").replace(",", "\\,").replace("\n", "\\n")


@router.get("/events/<slug:slug>/calendar.ics")
def calendar(req, slug):
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None or not (is_available(ev) or auth.can_manage_event(req.user, ev)) or not ev.get("event_date"):
        return unavailable(ev)
    start = datetime.fromisoformat(f"{ev['event_date']}T{ev.get('start_time') or '12:00'}") - timedelta(hours=2)
    if ev.get("end_time"):
        end = datetime.fromisoformat(f"{ev['event_date']}T{ev['end_time']}") - timedelta(hours=2)
        if end <= start:
            end += timedelta(days=1)
    else:
        end = start + timedelta(hours=4)
    fmt = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"
    v = ev.get("venue") or {}
    loc = ", ".join(x for x in (v.get("name"), v.get("address")) if x)
    lines = ["BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", f"PRODID:-//{config.BRAND_NAME}//Events//EN", "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
             "BEGIN:VEVENT", f"UID:{ev['uid']}@{config.BRAND_NAME.lower()}",
             f"DTSTAMP:{datetime.utcnow().strftime(fmt)}", f"DTSTART:{start.strftime(fmt)}", f"DTEND:{end.strftime(fmt)}",
             f"SUMMARY:{_ics_text(ev['name'])}", f"LOCATION:{_ics_text(loc)}", f"URL:{events.public_url(ev)}",
             f"DESCRIPTION:{_ics_text('Details and RSVP: ' + events.public_url(ev))}", "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR"]
    r = Response("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n", content_type="text/calendar; charset=utf-8")
    r.header("Content-Disposition", f'attachment; filename="{ev["slug"]}.ics"')
    return r


# --- previews --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@router.get("/events/<slug:slug>/draft/<token>")
def draft_preview(req, slug, token):
    """Read-only draft the organiser shares with family before paying. RSVPs are switched off."""
    ev = events.by_slug(slug)
    if ev is None or ev["status"] in ("suspended", "archived") or not events.draft_token_ok(ev, token):
        raise HTTPError(404)
    r = Response(R.render(ev, "preview", None, req, notice="Shared draft from " + (ev["hosts"] or "the hosts")))
    r.header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    r.header("X-Robots-Tag", "noindex, nofollow")
    r.set_cookie(events.DRAFT_COOKIE, f"{ev['id']}.{token}", max_age=3 * 3600, path="/media/")
    return r



@router.get("/templates/<slug:slug>/preview")
def template_preview(req, slug):
    t = catalog.template(slug)
    if t is None or not t["active"]:
        raise HTTPError(404)
    groups = db.loads(t["groups"], [])
    group = req.arg("group") if req.arg("group") in ("weddings", "baby", "parties", "other") else (groups[0] if groups else "weddings")
    r = Response(R.render(demo_event(slug, group), "demo", None, req))
    r.header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
    return r


@router.get("/dashboard/events/<uid>/preview")
def organiser_preview(req, uid):
    row = auth.event_for(req, uid)
    ev = events.parse(row)
    gtoken = req.arg("guest")
    guest = db.one("SELECT * FROM guests WHERE token = ? AND event_id = ?", (gtoken, ev["id"])) if gtoken else None
    r = Response(R.render(ev, "preview", guest, req))
    r.header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    return r
```

```python
"""Navigation for the organiser dashboard and the admin dashboard.

Every dashboard page renders through `organiser_page()` or `admin_page()` so the sidebar and
locked-feature markers stay consistent across modules.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from .. import catalog, events
from ..icons import i
from ..web import esc
from .layout import app_shell, side_link


# (path suffix, label, icon, feature needed)
EVENT_NAV = [
    ("", "Overview", "dashboard", None),
    ("/setup/1", "Event setup", "wand", None),
    ("/guests", "Guests", "users", "basic_dashboard"),
    ("/rsvps", "RSVPs", "check", "basic_dashboard"),
    ("/seating", "Seating", "seat", "seating"),
    ("/menu", "Menu", "dish", "menu"),
    ("/programme", "Programme", "list", "programme"),
    ("/communications", "Communications", "mail", "email_notifications"),
    ("/share", "Share", "chat", None),
    ("/reports", "Reports", "file", "basic_dashboard"),
    ("/settings", "Settings", "settings", None),
]


def event_nav(ev, current: str) -> str:
    base = f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}"
    status = events.STATUS_LABELS.get(ev["status"], ev["status"])
    pill_kind = ev["status"]
    paid = catalog.package(ev["paid_package"])
    pkg_line = paid["name"] if paid else "Not paid yet"
    links = []
    for suffix, label, icon, feature in EVENT_NAV:
        href = base + suffix
        cur = current if not suffix.startswith("/setup") else (href if current.startswith(base + "/setup") else current)
        locked = feature is not None and not catalog.has_feature(ev, feature)
        links.append(side_link(href, label, icon, cur, locked))
    return (f'<a class="side-link" href="/dashboard">{i("arrow-left")}<span>All events</span></a>'
            f'<div class="side-event"><b>{esc(ev["name"])}</b><span>{esc(pkg_line)}</span>'
            f'<div style="margin-top:8px"><span class="pill pill--{esc(pill_kind)}">{esc(status)}</span></div></div>'
            + "".join(links) +
            f'<div class="side-group"><a class="side-link" href="{events.public_path(ev)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{i("external")}<span>View website</span></a></div>')


def account_nav(current: str, user) -> str:
    links = [
        side_link("/dashboard", "My events", "home", current),
        side_link("/create", "Create an event", "plus", current),
        side_link("/dashboard/billing", "Orders and receipts", "card", current),
        side_link("/account", "Account", "user", current),
        side_link("/contact", "Help and support", "support", current),
    ]
    if user is not None and user["role"] == "admin":
        links.append('<div class="side-group"><div class="side-group__label">Platform</div>'
                     + side_link("/admin", "Admin dashboard", "shield", current) + "</div>")
    return "".join(links)


ADMIN_NAV = [
    ("/admin", "Overview", "chart"),
    ("/admin/customers", "Customers", "users"),
    ("/admin/events", "Events", "calendar"),
    ("/admin/orders", "Payments", "card"),
    ("/admin/hosting", "Hosting periods", "clock"),
    ("/admin/packages", "Packages", "tag"),
    ("/admin/templates", "Templates", "layout"),
    ("/admin/categories", "Categories", "list"),
    ("/admin/emails", "Email templates", "mail"),
    ("/admin/outbox", "Email log", "send"),
    ("/admin/support", "Support", "support"),
    ("/admin/audit", "Audit log", "shield"),
]


def admin_nav(current: str) -> str:
    return (side_link("/dashboard", "Back to my events", "arrow-left", current)
            + '<div class="side-group"><div class="side-group__label">Administration</div>'
            + "".join(side_link(h, l, ic, current) for h, l, ic in ADMIN_NAV) + "</div>")


def organiser_page(req, ev, title: str, body: str, current_suffix: str = "", extra_head: str = "",
                   extra_scripts: str = "") -> str:
    current = f"/dashboard/events/{ev['uid']}{current_suffix}"
    return app_shell(req, f"{title} · {ev['name']}", body, event_nav(ev, current), ev, extra_head, extra_scripts)


def account_page(req, title: str, body: str, current: str = "/dashboard", extra_head: str = "") -> str:
    return app_shell(req, title, body, account_nav(current, req.user), None, extra_head)


def admin_page(req, title: str, body: str, current: str = "/admin", extra_head: str = "", extra_scripts: str = "") -> str:
    return app_shell(req, f"{title} · Admin", body, admin_nav(current), None, extra_head, extra_scripts)


def locked_panel(ev, feature: str, what: str) -> str:
    """Shown in place of a tool the event's package doesn't include."""
    need = next((p for p in catalog.packages() if feature in catalog.package_features(p["code"])), None)
    name = need["name"] if need else "a higher package"
    tile = '<span class="icon-tile icon-tile--soft">' + i("lock") + "</span>"
    return (f'<div class="empty">{tile}'
            f'<h2 style="font-size:1.25rem">{esc(what)} is part of the {esc(name)}</h2>'
            f'<p>Upgrade this event to unlock it. You only pay the difference.</p>'
            f'<a class="btn btn--primary" href="/dashboard/events/{ev["uid"]}/setup/8">See packages</a></div>')


def page_head(title: str, intro: str = "", actions: str = "") -> str:
    return (f'<div class="page-head"><div><h1>{esc(title)}</h1>{f"<p>{intro}</p>" if intro else ""}</div>'
            f'{f"<div class=btn-row>{actions}</div>" if actions else ""}</div>')
```

```python
"""Event creation: /create (choose occasion and template) and the 10-step set-up wizard.

Each step is its own form at /dashboard/events/<uid>/setup/<n>. Saving never publishes
anything; the event stays a private draft until a verified payment (step 10).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

from .. import auth, catalog, config, db, events, suggestions
from ..eventsite import themes
from ..icons import i
from ..services import storage
from ..web import HTTPError, esc, json_response, redirect, router, url
from . import forms
from .forms import Form, check, csrf, errors_summary, field, select
from .layout import page
from .shell import organiser_page

STEPS = [
    (1, "Details", "calendar"), (2, "Design", "palette"), (3, "Guests", "users"), (4, "Programme", "list"),

]

              "parties": ("Who are we celebrating?", "e.g. Kagiso's 40th"), "other": ("Host or organisation", "e.g. The Dlamini family")}
COURSES = ["Canapés", "Starter", "Main", "Dessert", "Late-night", "Drinks"]
KINDS = [("ceremony", "Ceremony"), ("reception", "Reception"), ("speech", "Speech"), ("entertainment", "Entertainment"),
         ("meal", "Meal"), ("activity", "Activity"), ("other", "Other")]
DRESS_CODES = ["", "Black tie", "Formal", "Cocktail", "Smart casual", "Traditional attire", "Cultural attire", "All white",
               "Garden party", "Casual", "Themed"]


def step_url(ev, n: int) -> str:

def group_of(ev) -> str:

    return c["group_slug"] if c else "weddings"


def feature_note(ev, feature: str, what: str) -> str:
```
