```css
.fp .fp-table--top { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 45%, var(--color-surface)); }
.fp .fp-chair { fill: var(--color-surface); stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1; opacity: .75; }
.fp .fp-chair--couple { fill: var(--color-accent-dark, var(--color-accent)); opacity: 1; }
.fp .fp-dance { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-dasharray: 4 3; opacity: .5; }
.fp .fp-label { font: 500 9px var(--font-sans); fill: currentColor; opacity: .6; }
.layout-choice .choice > span { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.layout-choice .fp { max-width: 140px; margin: 0 auto; }
.fp-plan-box { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-surface); }
.fp--plan { max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; }
/* Guest list: quick add and chips */
.quick-add { display: grid; gap: 8px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; margin-bottom: 8px; }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .quick-add { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; } .quick-add [data-qa-phone] { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; } }
.guest-chips { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.guest-chips li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface); font-size: .875rem; }
.guest-chips button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--color-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.guest-chips button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 8%, transparent); color: var(--color-text); }
.guest-chips .i { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
/* Printed cards versus one link */
.vs { display: grid; gap: 0; padding: 6px 20px; }
.vs-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: start; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.vs-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.vs-head b { font-size: 1rem; }
.vs-label { color: var(--color-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; padding-top: 3px; }
.vs-old, .vs-new { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
.vs-old { color: var(--color-muted); }
.vs-old .i { color: var(--color-muted); flex: none; margin-top: 3px; }
.vs-new .i { color: var(--color-accent-text); flex: none; margin-top: 3px; }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .vs-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 6px; }
  .vs-head { display: none; }
  .vs-old::after { content: ""; }
}
.vs-tag { display: none; font-weight: 600; }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .vs-tag { display: inline; } }
/* Occasion tiles with a photo: darken the lower half so the text stays readable */
.cat-tile__photo { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; overflow: hidden; }
.cat-tile__photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform var(--t-slow) var(--ease-out); }
.cat-tile:hover .cat-tile__photo img { transform: scale(var(--zoom)); }
.cat-tile__photo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20, 15, 8, 0) 30%, rgba(20, 15, 8, .78) 100%); }
.cat-tile:has(.cat-tile__photo) h3, .cat-tile:has(.cat-tile__photo) p, .cat-tile:has(.cat-tile__photo) .arrow-link { color: #fff; }
.vs, .vs * { text-align: left; } .vs-row { justify-items: start; }
```

### `static/css/eventsite.css`

<!-- FILE: static/css/eventsite.css sha256=2f269fd0872b9fccf1a3bd41d2f7aac0e6151e5eaa257b5a7072ce9517d1b3a4 nl=1 -->
```css
/* Aurelia event websites: shared base + eleven designs (scoped by .d-<design>).
   Theme variables come from the event: --ev-bg --ev-surface --ev-text --ev-muted --ev-accent
   --ev-accent2 --ev-display --ev-body, plus contrast-checked --ev-btn --ev-btn-text --ev-ink. */

/* ---------- base ---------- */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-padding-top: 80px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } }
.ev {
  --ev-btn: var(--ev-text); --ev-btn-text: var(--ev-bg); --ev-ink: var(--ev-text); --ev-ink-s: var(--ev-ink);
  --ev-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 14%, transparent);
  --ev-radius: 14px; --ev-pad: clamp(20px, 4vw, 40px); --ev-w: 1120px;
  margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; overflow-x: clip;
  background: var(--ev-bg); color: var(--ev-text);
  font: 400 clamp(1rem, .96rem + .2vw, 1.0625rem)/1.65 var(--ev-body);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.ev img { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.ev a { color: inherit; }
.ev h1, .ev h2, .ev h3, .ev h4 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; text-wrap: balance; }
.ev h2 { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 1.3rem + 2vw, 2.75rem); }
.ev h3 { font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 1.05rem + .6vw, 1.5rem); }
.ev h4 { font-family: var(--ev-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; }
.ev p { margin: 0; text-wrap: pretty; }
.ev :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-ink); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }
.ev .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
.ev .mono { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.ev-skip { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: -60px; z-index: 50; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text); border-radius: 999px; }
.ev-skip:focus { top: 12px; }
.ev-banner { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; padding: 8px 16px; text-align: center; font: 500 .8125rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; background: #1B191A; color: #F5F3F2; }
.ev-banner--notice { background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text); }
.ev-banner--draft { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px 12px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: .875rem;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #1B191A 0 14px, #2A2629 14px 28px); color: #FFF; border-bottom: 3px solid #E8B44A; }
.ev-banner--draft b { letter-spacing: .02em; }
.ev-banner__btn { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #E8B44A; color: #1B191A; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.ev-banner__btn:hover { background: #F2C766; }
.ev-watermark { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 39; pointer-events: none; background-repeat: repeat; }
.ev-ribbon { position: fixed; z-index: 40; top: 14px; right: -42px; rotate: 45deg; width: 170px; padding: 6px 0; text-align: center; font: 600 .6875rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #1B191A; color: #F5F3F2; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / .2); pointer-events: none; }

.ev-sec { position: relative; padding: clamp(48px, 8vw, 96px) var(--ev-pad); }
.ev-sec__in { max-width: var(--ev-w); margin-inline: auto; }
.ev-h { margin-bottom: clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px); }
.ev-kicker { font-family: var(--ev-body); font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-ink); margin-bottom: 10px !important; }
.ev-lead { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 1.1rem + 1.1vw, 2rem); line-height: 1.35; max-width: 32ch; }
.ev-text { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 88%, var(--ev-muted)); max-width: 62ch; }
.ev-text + .ev-text, .ev-lead + .ev-text { margin-top: 16px; }
.ev-small { font-size: .9375rem; }
.ev-muted { color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-greet { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-style: italic; font-size: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 8px !important; }

.ev-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5em; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text) !important; font: 600 .9375rem/1 var(--ev-body); letter-spacing: .02em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .35s, background-color .18s; }
.ev-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / .5); }
.ev-btn:active { transform: scale(.98); }
.ev-btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ev-text) !important; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 28%, transparent); }
.ev-btn--ghost:hover { border-color: var(--ev-text); box-shadow: none; }
.ev-btn--sm { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: .875rem; }
.ev-btn--wide { width: 100%; }
.ev-btn[disabled] { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
.ev-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; }

.ev-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30; padding: 6px var(--ev-pad); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-bg) 88%, transparent); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-nav ul { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0; max-width: var(--ev-w); list-style: none; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ev-nav ul::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.ev-nav li:first-child { margin-left: auto; }
.ev-nav li:last-child { margin-right: auto; }
.ev-nav a { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; opacity: .8; border-radius: 999px; }
.ev-nav a:hover { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 7%, transparent); }
.ev-nav__n { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--ev-ink); }

.ev-when { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 24px 0 0; }
.ev-when div { display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.ev-when dt { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-when dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }

.ev-count { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(8px, 2vw, 18px); max-width: 640px; }
.ev-count__cell { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: clamp(14px, 3vw, 24px) 6px; border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-count__cell b { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.2rem + 3vw, 3.25rem); line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ev-count__cell span { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-count__done { margin-top: 12px !important; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.25rem; }

.ev-venue__name { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 1.1rem + 1.2vw, 2rem); }
.ev-venue__addr { margin-top: 6px !important; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-venue__time { margin-top: 6px !important; font-weight: 500; }
.ev-notes { display: grid; gap: 16px; margin-top: 28px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-notes { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.ev-note { padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-surface) 80%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-note h4 { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.ev-note + .ev-note { margin-top: 0; }
.ev-sec__body > .ev-note { margin-top: 18px; }
.ev-funcs { list-style: none; margin: 28px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-funcs { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); } }
.ev-func { display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; padding: 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-func__when { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ev-ink-s); }
.ev-func__venue { color: var(--ev-muted); font-size: .9375rem; }
.ev-func .ev-btn { justify-self: start; margin-top: 6px; }

.ev-prog__group { margin: 28px 0 12px; font-size: 1.125rem; }
.ev-prog__group:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.ev-prog { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; }
.ev-prog__item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 16px; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-prog__item time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ev-ink); letter-spacing: .04em; }
.ev-prog__item h4 { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.15rem; }

.ev-menu + .ev-menu { margin-top: 32px; }
.ev-menu__name { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.ev-menu__course { margin: 22px 0 8px; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-ink); }
.ev-menu__items { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.ev-menu__dish { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.2rem; }
.ev-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; }
.ev-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 500; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 14%, transparent); color: var(--ev-text); }
.ev-tag--choice { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-dress { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1.4vw, 2.4rem); margin-bottom: 10px !important; }

.ev-table { display: grid; gap: 6px; justify-items: start; padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-table__name { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.4rem + 2vw, 2.8rem); line-height: 1.1; }

.ev-list { list-style: none; margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-list--reg { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); } }
.ev-list li { padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; }
.ev-list li .ev-btn { justify-self: start; margin-top: 6px; }
.ev-list a { text-underline-offset: .2em; }
.ev-contacts { list-style: none; margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-contacts { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); } }
.ev-contacts li { padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-contacts .ev-actions { margin-top: 10px; gap: 6px; }

.ev-gal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .ev-gal { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
.ev-gal__item { position: relative; margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 18%, var(--ev-surface)); }
.ev-gal__item:nth-child(5n+1) { grid-row: span 2; aspect-ratio: auto; }
.ev-gal__item img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: scale .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
.ev-gal__item:hover img { scale: 1.03; }
.ev-gal__item figcaption { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: .8125rem; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgb(0 0 0 / .55)); }
.ev-gal__art { min-height: 140px; }
.ev-art-0 { background: radial-gradient(80% 60% at 30% 90%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 55%, transparent), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(160deg, var(--ev-surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 40%, var(--ev-bg))); }
.ev-art-1 { background: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 70% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 60%, transparent), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(200deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 30%, var(--ev-bg)), var(--ev-surface)); }
.ev-art-2 { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 18%, transparent) 0 2px, transparent 2px 14px), var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-art-3 { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 60%, transparent) 0 35%, transparent 36%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 50%, transparent) 0 55%, transparent 56%), var(--ev-surface); }
.ev-art-4 { background: conic-gradient(from 200deg at 30% 70%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 40%, var(--ev-bg)), var(--ev-surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 45%, var(--ev-bg)), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 40%, var(--ev-bg))); }
.ev-art-5 { background: linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 35%, var(--ev-surface)) 0 30%, var(--ev-surface) 30%), var(--ev-surface); }

/* forms */
.ev-rsvp { display: grid; gap: 18px; max-width: 640px; }
.ev-rsvp fieldset { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.ev-rsvp__note { color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-rsvp__as { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 12%, transparent); }
.ev-grid2 { display: grid; gap: 18px; }
@media (min-width: 620px) { .ev-grid2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: start; } }
.ev-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.ev-field label, .ev-choice legend { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; }
.ev-input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 24%, transparent); background: var(--ev-surface); color: var(--ev-text); font: 400 1rem/1.4 var(--ev-body); }
textarea.ev-input { min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; }
select.ev-input { appearance: none; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, currentColor 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, currentColor 50%, transparent 50%); background-position: calc(100% - 20px) 50%, calc(100% - 15px) 50%; background-size: 5px 5px; background-repeat: no-repeat; padding-right: 40px; }
.ev-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ev-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 12%, transparent); }
.ev-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #B42318; }
.ev-hint { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.ev-err { font-size: .8125rem; color: #B42318; font-weight: 600; }
.ev-errors { padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(180 35 24 / .35); background: rgb(180 35 24 / .08); color: #8F1C13; font-size: .9375rem; }
.ev-errors ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.ev-choice { display: flex !important; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px !important; }
.ev-choice legend { width: 100%; margin-bottom: 8px; float: left; }
.ev-radio, .ev-check { position: relative; display: inline-flex; }
.ev-radio input, .ev-check input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; cursor: pointer; margin: 0; }
.ev-radio span, .ev-check span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 24%, transparent); background: var(--ev-surface); font-weight: 500; font-size: .9375rem; transition: background-color .18s, color .18s, border-color .18s; }
.ev-check span { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: .875rem; }
.ev-radio input:checked + span, .ev-check input:checked + span { background: var(--ev-btn); color: var(--ev-btn-text); border-color: transparent; }
.ev-radio input:focus-visible + span, .ev-check input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--ev-ink); outline-offset: 2px; }
.ev-attending { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 18px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); border: 1px dashed var(--ev-line); }
.ev-attending[hidden] { display: none; }
.ev-hp { position: absolute !important; left: -9999px; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; }
.ev-thanks { display: grid; gap: 10px; justify-items: start; max-width: 560px; padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--ev-radius); background: var(--ev-surface); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-thanks h3 { font-size: 1.6rem; }
.ev-thanks:focus { outline: none; }

.ev-photo { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 20%, var(--ev-surface)); }
.ev-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.ev-photo--art { background: radial-gradient(70% 60% at 30% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 45%, transparent), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(50% 50% at 80% 20%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 45%, transparent), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(170deg, var(--ev-surface), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 12%, var(--ev-bg))); }

.ev-mono { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 92px; height: 92px; margin: 0 auto 24px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--ev-accent); font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.6rem; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--ev-ink); position: relative; }
.ev-mono::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 5px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 45%, transparent); }
.ev-mono--logo { border: 0; width: 120px; height: auto; }
.ev-mono--logo::after { display: none; }

.ev-foot { padding: 56px var(--ev-pad) 40px; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ev-foot > p:first-child { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.4rem; }
.ev-made { margin-top: 18px !important; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.ev-made a { color: var(--ev-muted); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
.ev-made a:hover { color: var(--ev-text); }

.orn { display: block; pointer-events: none; }
.orn g, .orn path { stroke: currentColor; }

/* background modes */
.bg-paper { background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 5%, transparent) .6px, transparent .7px), radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 3%, transparent) .6px, transparent .7px); background-size: 7px 7px, 11px 11px; background-position: 0 0, 3px 5px; }

/* simple themed pages */
.ev-simple { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; }
.ev-simple__card { max-width: 560px; padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 48px); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--ev-surface); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); display: grid; gap: 16px; text-align: center; justify-items: center; }
.ev-simple__card h1 { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.4rem + 1.5vw, 2.4rem); }
.ev-simple:not([style]) { --ev-bg: #F5F5F4; --ev-surface: #fff; --ev-text: #1B191A; --ev-muted: #625D5E; --ev-accent: #B08D45; --ev-btn: #8A6B2C; --ev-btn-text: #fff; --ev-display: Georgia, serif; --ev-body: system-ui, sans-serif; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 1. ATELIER: minimalist luxury, one calm centred column, hairlines                            */
.d-atelier { --ev-w: 680px; }
.at-hero { min-height: 92svh; display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 72px var(--ev-pad) 56px; }
.at-names { font-size: clamp(3rem, 1.6rem + 7vw, 6.5rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.01em; display: grid; justify-items: center; }
.at-names .ev-amp { font-style: italic; font-size: .5em; color: var(--ev-ink); margin: 10px 0; }
.at-rule { width: 1px; height: 64px; margin: 28px auto; background: linear-gradient(var(--ev-accent), transparent); }
.at-date { font-size: .875rem; letter-spacing: .32em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.at-place { margin: 8px 0 30px !important; color: var(--ev-muted); font-family: var(--ev-display); font-style: italic; font-size: 1.15rem; }
.at-nav { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-bg) 92%, transparent); }
.at-nav a { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.at-photo { max-width: 920px; margin: 48px auto 0; padding: 0 var(--ev-pad); }
.at-photo .ev-photo { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }
.at-col { padding-bottom: 24px; }
.at-sec { text-align: center; }
.at-sec + .at-sec::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; width: 9px; height: 9px; translate: -50% -50%; rotate: 45deg; border: 1px solid var(--ev-accent); background: var(--ev-bg); }
.at-sec + .at-sec { border-top: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.at-sec .ev-h h2 { font-weight: 300; font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.5rem + 2vw, 3rem); }
.at-sec .ev-kicker { display: none; }
.at-sec .ev-lead, .at-sec .ev-text { margin-inline: auto; }
.at-sec .ev-actions, .at-sec .ev-choice { justify-content: center; }
.at-sec .ev-prog__item, .at-sec .ev-rsvp, .at-sec .ev-list li, .at-sec .ev-contacts li, .at-sec .ev-note, .at-sec .ev-func { text-align: left; }
.at-sec .ev-rsvp, .at-sec .ev-count, .at-sec .ev-thanks { margin-inline: auto; }
.at-sec .ev-count__cell { border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--ev-line); border-radius: 0; background: none; }
.at-sec .ev-count__cell:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.at-sec .ev-count__cell b { font-weight: 300; }
.d-atelier .ev-btn { border-radius: 0; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .75rem; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 30px; }
.d-atelier .ev-note, .d-atelier .ev-func, .d-atelier .ev-list li, .d-atelier .ev-contacts li, .d-atelier .ev-table { border-radius: 0; background: transparent; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 2. FOLIO: modern editorial magazine spread, oversized headline, sticky index                */
.d-folio { --ev-radius: 0; }
.fo-hero { padding: 18px var(--ev-pad) clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px); border-bottom: 3px double var(--ev-text); }
.fo-mast { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-text); font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; }
.fo-mast span:first-child { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-style: italic; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: none; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; }
.fo-hero__grid { display: grid; gap: 32px; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
@media (min-width: 960px) { .fo-hero__grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, .75fr); align-items: end; } }
.fo-title { font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 1.4rem + 9vw, 9.5rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: .86; letter-spacing: -.045em; display: grid; }
.fo-title .ev-amp { font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ev-accent); font-size: .6em; line-height: 1; margin-left: .4em; }
.fo-deck { margin-top: 26px !important; max-width: 40ch; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 1rem + .5vw, 1.35rem); line-height: 1.45; border-left: 3px solid var(--ev-accent); padding-left: 16px; }
.fo-hero__fig { margin: 0; }
.fo-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; filter: grayscale(.15) contrast(1.05); }
.fo-photo.ev-photo--art { display: grid; place-items: center; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 8%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 22px), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ev-accent2), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 30%, var(--ev-bg))); }
.fo-art__mark { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: clamp(4rem, 3rem + 6vw, 8rem); font-style: italic; color: var(--ev-surface); mix-blend-mode: difference; }
.fo-hero__fig figcaption { margin-top: 10px; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.fo-body { display: grid; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) { .fo-body { grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 40px; padding: 0 var(--ev-pad); } }
.fo-index { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-text); }
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .fo-index { position: sticky; top: 24px; align-self: start; padding: 40px 0 0; background: none; border: 0; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; }
  .fo-index ul { flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
  .fo-index li:first-child { margin-left: 0; }
  .fo-index a { border-radius: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-line); padding: 0; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 14px; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .fo-sec { padding-inline: 0; }
}
.fo-sec { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-text); }
.fo-sec .ev-h { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-line); padding-bottom: 14px; }
.fo-sec .ev-kicker { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 2.6rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--ev-accent); margin: 0 !important; line-height: 1; }
.fo-sec .ev-h h2 { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.03em; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.4rem + 2vw, 3rem); }
.fo-sec--invitation .ev-sec__body { columns: 2 280px; column-gap: 40px; }
.fo-sec--invitation .ev-lead { column-span: all; max-width: none; font-style: italic; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.fo-sec--invitation .ev-text:first-of-type::first-letter { float: left; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 4.2em; line-height: .8; padding: 6px 8px 0 0; color: var(--ev-accent); }
.d-folio .ev-btn { border-radius: 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .14em; font-size: .75rem; }
.d-folio .ev-count__cell { border-radius: 0; border-color: var(--ev-text); }
.d-folio .ev-input, .d-folio .ev-radio span, .d-folio .ev-check span { border-radius: 0; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 3. BLOOM: romantic floral, arches, script names, drawn botanicals                            */
.d-bloom { --ev-w: 760px; --ev-radius: 22px; }
.bl-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 56px var(--ev-pad) 72px; text-align: center; }
.bl-hero__in { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; }
.orn-sprig { position: absolute; width: clamp(140px, 22vw, 260px); color: var(--ev-accent2); }
.orn-sprig .o-leaf path { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 38%, transparent); stroke-width: 1; }
.orn-sprig .o-bud circle { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 55%, transparent); stroke: var(--ev-accent); }
.bl-tl { top: -10px; left: -20px; }
.bl-br { bottom: -10px; right: -20px; rotate: 180deg; }
.bl-arch { width: min(78vw, 340px); margin: 18px 0 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 999px 999px 18px 18px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 50%, transparent); }
.bl-arch__img { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; border-radius: 999px 999px 12px 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.bl-arch__img.ev-photo--art .orn-sprig { position: static; width: 70%; color: var(--ev-accent2); opacity: .9; }
.bl-names { font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 2rem + 6vw, 6rem); line-height: 1; color: var(--ev-ink); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; align-items: baseline; gap: 0 .25em; font-weight: 400; margin-top: 10px; }
.bl-names .ev-amp { font-size: .6em; color: var(--ev-text); }
.bl-date { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; margin: 14px 0 28px !important; font-size: .8125rem; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.bl-date b { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 2.6rem; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 400; padding: 0 16px; border-inline: 1px solid var(--ev-line); color: var(--ev-ink); }
.d-bloom.has-hero .bl-arch__img { border: 0; }
.bl-body { padding-bottom: 20px; }
.bl-sec { text-align: center; padding-block: clamp(36px, 6vw, 64px); }
.bl-sec .ev-sec__in { padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 48px); border-radius: 28px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-surface) 86%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -48px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 80%, transparent); }
.bl-sec .ev-h h2 { font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 1.8rem + 3vw, 3.6rem); font-weight: 400; color: var(--ev-ink); }
.bl-sec .ev-kicker { display: none; }
.bl-sec .ev-lead, .bl-sec .ev-text { margin-inline: auto; }
.bl-sec .ev-actions, .bl-sec .ev-choice { justify-content: center; }
.bl-sec .ev-rsvp, .bl-sec .ev-prog, .bl-sec .ev-notes, .bl-sec .ev-list, .bl-sec .ev-contacts { text-align: left; }
.bl-sec .ev-rsvp, .bl-sec .ev-count, .bl-sec .ev-thanks, .bl-sec .ev-table { margin-inline: auto; justify-items: center; }
.bl-sec .ev-count__cell { border-radius: 999px 999px 16px 16px; }
.bl-div { text-align: center; font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--ev-accent); opacity: .8; }
.d-bloom .ev-menu__dish, .d-bloom .ev-prog__item h4 { font-style: italic; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 4. HERITAGE: African traditional luxury, beadwork bands, both families, ceremonies          */
.d-heritage { --ev-radius: 4px; }
.orn-beads { display: block; height: 26px; line-height: 0; }
.orn-beads svg { display: block; }
.bd-a { fill: var(--ev-accent); } .bd-b { fill: var(--ev-accent2); } .bd-c { fill: var(--ev-text); } .bd-d { fill: var(--ev-bg); }
.bg-pattern.d-heritage { background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 6%, transparent) 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 6%, transparent) 75%), linear-gradient(45deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 6%, transparent) 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 6%, transparent) 75%); background-size: 36px 36px; background-position: 0 0, 18px 18px; }
.hr-hero { display: grid; gap: 32px; align-items: center; max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(48px, 8vw, 96px) var(--ev-pad); }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .hr-hero { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, .9fr); } }
.hr-names { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 1.6rem + 5vw, 5.4rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; line-height: 1.02; text-transform: uppercase; display: grid; color: var(--ev-accent2); }
.hr-names .ev-amp { color: var(--ev-ink); font-size: .55em; }
.hr-date { margin: 18px 0 6px !important; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ev-ink); }
.hr-hero__mark { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 30px; }
.hr-diamond { width: min(64vw, 340px); aspect-ratio: 1; rotate: 45deg; padding: 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ev-accent); outline: 1px solid var(--ev-accent2); outline-offset: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
.hr-photo { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.hr-photo img { rotate: -45deg; scale: 1.42; }
.hr-photo > span { rotate: -45deg; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 2rem + 3vw, 4rem); color: var(--ev-accent2); letter-spacing: .1em; }
.hr-photo.ev-photo--art { background: repeating-conic-gradient(from 45deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 20%, var(--ev-surface)) 0 25%, var(--ev-surface) 0 50%) 0 0 / 34px 34px; }
.hr-nav { background: var(--ev-accent2); border: 0; }
.hr-nav a { color: var(--ev-bg); opacity: .9; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .14em; font-size: .75rem; }
.hr-nav a:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .12); }
.hr-sec .ev-h { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.hr-sec .ev-h::before { content: ""; flex: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; rotate: 45deg; background: var(--ev-accent); box-shadow: 6px -6px 0 -2px var(--ev-accent2); }
.hr-sec .ev-h h2 { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1.5vw, 2.3rem); }
.hr-sec .ev-kicker { display: none; }
.hr-sec--alt { background: var(--ev-surface); border-block: 6px solid var(--ev-accent2); border-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ev-accent) 0 18px, var(--ev-accent2) 18px 36px, var(--ev-text) 36px 42px) 6; }
.hr-fam { background: var(--ev-accent2); color: var(--ev-bg); text-align: center; }
.hr-fam .ev-kicker { color: var(--ev-accent); filter: brightness(1.4); }
.hr-fam .ev-text { margin: 0 auto 24px; color: inherit; opacity: .92; }
.hr-fam__list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .hr-fam__list { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); } }
.hr-fam__list li { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .3); display: grid; gap: 8px; justify-items: center; }
.hr-fam__mark { color: var(--ev-accent); filter: brightness(1.3); font-size: 1.4rem; }
.hr-fam h3 { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; font-size: 1.25rem; }
.d-heritage .ev-func { border-top: 6px solid var(--ev-accent); }
.d-heritage .ev-func h3 { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.d-heritage .ev-btn { border-radius: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .14em; font-size: .8125rem; }
.d-heritage .ev-count__cell { border-radius: 0; border-top: 4px solid var(--ev-accent); }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 5. CHAMPAGNE: midnight, gold foil, Art Deco fans, glass panels                               */
.d-champagne { --ev-w: 900px; --ev-radius: 4px; --ev-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 28%, transparent); }
.foil { background: linear-gradient(100deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 70%, #5a4210) 0%, #F7E7B4 22%, var(--ev-accent) 44%, #FFF3CF 58%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 80%, #3d2c08) 80%, var(--ev-accent) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .foil { animation: foil 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } }
@keyframes foil { to { background-position: 100% 0; } }
.foil .ev-amp, .foil .ev-name { background: inherit; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; }
.ch-hero { position: relative; min-height: 96svh; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; padding: 64px var(--ev-pad); text-align: center; background: radial-gradient(60% 50% at 50% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 18%, transparent), transparent 70%); }
.orn-fan { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 0; width: min(1100px, 140vw); translate: -50% 0; color: var(--ev-accent); opacity: .3; }
.ch-hero__in { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; }
.ch-names { font-size: clamp(3rem, 1.6rem + 7vw, 7rem); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; display: grid; }
.ch-names .ev-amp { font-size: .5em; margin: 8px 0; }
.orn-deco { width: 240px; color: var(--ev-accent); margin: 26px 0; }
.ch-date { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; font-size: .8125rem; letter-spacing: .3em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.ch-date b { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: 3.6rem; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 400; padding: 0 22px; border-inline: 1px solid var(--ev-line); }
.ch-place { margin: 14px 0 32px !important; color: var(--ev-muted); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .8125rem; }
.ch-nav { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-bg) 70%, transparent); }
.ch-nav a { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .2em; font-size: .6875rem; }
.ch-photo { max-width: 900px; margin: 48px auto 0; padding: 0 var(--ev-pad); }
.ch-photo .ev-photo { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); padding: 8px; background: none; }
.ch-body { padding: 24px 0 40px; }
.ch-sec { padding-block: 22px; }
.ch-glass .ev-sec__in { position: relative; padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 56px); border: 1px solid var(--ev-line); background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-surface) 70%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-surface) 40%, transparent)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.3); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.3); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .08), 0 40px 80px -50px rgb(0 0 0 / .8); }
.ch-glass .ev-sec__in::before, .ch-glass .ev-sec__in::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--ev-accent); }
.ch-glass .ev-sec__in::before { top: 10px; left: 10px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; }
.ch-glass .ev-sec__in::after { bottom: 10px; right: 10px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; }
.ch-sec .ev-h { text-align: center; }
.ch-sec .ev-h h2 { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 1.1rem + 1.4vw, 2.2rem); color: var(--ev-ink); }
.ch-sec .ev-kicker { display: none; }
.d-champagne .ev-btn { border-radius: 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .22em; font-size: .75rem; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .25), transparent 55%); }
.d-champagne .ev-count__cell { background: transparent; border-color: var(--ev-line); }
.d-champagne .ev-count__cell b { color: var(--ev-ink); }
.d-champagne .ev-input, .d-champagne .ev-radio span, .d-champagne .ev-check span, .d-champagne .ev-note, .d-champagne .ev-func, .d-champagne .ev-list li, .d-champagne .ev-contacts li, .d-champagne .ev-table, .d-champagne .ev-thanks { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-surface) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; }
.d-champagne .ev-radio input:checked + span, .d-champagne .ev-check input:checked + span { background: var(--ev-btn); }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 6. LINEA: contemporary minimalist, strict grid, label column, horizontal timeline           */
.d-linea { --ev-radius: 2px; }
.li-hero { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px var(--ev-pad) clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px); }
.li-hero__top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: clamp(48px, 10vw, 120px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ev-text); }
.li-mono { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.li-nav { position: static; flex: 1; background: none; border: 0; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; padding: 0; min-width: 0; }
.li-nav li:first-child { margin-left: auto; }
.li-nav li:last-child { margin-right: 0; }
.li-nav a { font-size: .8125rem; border-radius: 0; }
.li-names { font-size: clamp(3rem, 1.2rem + 8vw, 8.5rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.05em; line-height: .92; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 .2em; }
.li-names .ev-amp { color: var(--ev-accent); font-weight: 300; }
.li-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); margin: clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px) 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ev-text); }
.li-meta div { padding: 14px 16px 0 0; }
.li-meta div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--ev-line); padding-left: 16px; }
.li-meta dt { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--ev-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .14em; }
.li-meta dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 500; }
.li-photo { margin-top: 40px; }
.li-photo .ev-photo { aspect-ratio: 21 / 9; }
.li-body { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--ev-pad) 40px; }
.li-row { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px) 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ev-text); }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .li-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 4fr) minmax(0, 8fr); gap: 40px; } }
.li-row__label { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: baseline; }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .li-row__label { position: sticky; top: 24px; align-self: start; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } }
.li-row__n { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--ev-ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; }
.li-row__label h2 { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 1.3rem + 1.2vw, 2.3rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.li-row .ev-lead { font-family: var(--ev-body); font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.d-linea .ev-prog { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(180px, 1fr); overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; border-top: 2px solid var(--ev-text); padding-bottom: 8px; }
.d-linea .ev-prog__item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: none; gap: 8px; align-content: start; padding: 22px 16px 0 0; border: 0; position: relative; scroll-snap-align: start; }
.d-linea .ev-prog__item::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -7px; left: 0; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ev-bg); border: 2px solid var(--ev-text); }
.d-linea .ev-prog__item:last-child::before { background: var(--ev-accent); border-color: var(--ev-accent); }
.d-linea .ev-prog__item h4 { font-family: var(--ev-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; }
.d-linea .ev-btn { border-radius: 2px; }
.d-linea .ev-input, .d-linea .ev-radio span, .d-linea .ev-check span { border-radius: 2px; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 7. CONFETTI: pastel celebrations, paper shapes, rounded cards                               */
.d-confetti { --ev-radius: 26px; --ev-w: 1080px; }
.bg-pattern.d-confetti { background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 20%, transparent) 2px, transparent 2.5px), radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 22%, transparent) 2px, transparent 2.5px); background-size: 46px 46px, 46px 46px; background-position: 0 0, 23px 23px; }
.cf-hero { position: relative; padding: clamp(40px, 7vw, 80px) var(--ev-pad); overflow: hidden; }
.cf-sky { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.cf { position: absolute; display: block; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ev-accent); opacity: .75; }
.cf:nth-child(3n+1) { background: var(--ev-accent2); border-radius: 4px; rotate: 20deg; }
.cf:nth-child(4n+2) { width: 30px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 60%, #F6D365); rotate: -30deg; }
.cf:nth-child(5n) { width: 0; height: 0; background: none; border-left: 11px solid transparent; border-right: 11px solid transparent; border-bottom: 18px solid var(--ev-accent2); border-radius: 0; }
.cf-0 { top: 8%; left: 6%; } .cf-1 { top: 18%; left: 88%; } .cf-2 { top: 72%; left: 4%; } .cf-3 { top: 86%; left: 30%; } .cf-4 { top: 10%; left: 46%; }
.cf-5 { top: 60%; left: 92%; } .cf-6 { top: 40%; left: 2%; } .cf-7 { top: 90%; left: 74%; } .cf-8 { top: 30%; left: 72%; } .cf-9 { top: 5%; left: 70%; }
.cf-10 { top: 50%; left: 16%; } .cf-11 { top: 78%; left: 56%; } .cf-12 { top: 24%; left: 24%; } .cf-13 { top: 66%; left: 80%; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .cf { animation: cf-float 8s ease-in-out infinite; } .cf:nth-child(2n) { animation-duration: 11s; animation-delay: -3s; } }
@keyframes cf-float { 50% { translate: 0 -12px; } }
.cf-card { position: relative; max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(32px, 6vw, 64px) clamp(24px, 5vw, 56px); text-align: center; border-radius: 40px; background: var(--ev-surface); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 8%, transparent), 0 40px 80px -50px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 90%, transparent); }
.cf-names { font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 1.6rem + 5.6vw, 5.6rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.02em; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 0 .25em; }
.cf-names .ev-amp { color: var(--ev-accent); }
.cf-sticker { position: absolute; top: -22px; right: clamp(-8px, 2vw, 24px); display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; rotate: 12deg; background: var(--ev-accent2); color: var(--ev-text); font-family: var(--ev-display); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / .35); }
.cf-sticker b { font-size: 2.2rem; line-height: 1; }
.cf-sticker span { font-size: .875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; font-weight: 700; }
.cf-when { margin: 16px 0 26px !important; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ev-muted); }
.cf-nav { background: transparent; border: 0; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; position: relative; }
.cf-nav a { background: var(--ev-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 10%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }
.cf-photo { max-width: 860px; margin: 24px auto 0; padding: 0 var(--ev-pad); }
.cf-photo .ev-photo { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; border-radius: 30px; border: 10px solid var(--ev-surface); rotate: -1.5deg; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / .3); }
.cf-board { display: grid; gap: 22px; max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px var(--ev-pad) 24px; }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .cf-board { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: start; } .cf-sec--rsvp, .cf-sec--gallery, .cf-sec--invitation { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }
.cf-sec { padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 40px); border-radius: 32px; background: var(--ev-surface); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-text) 7%, transparent); }
.cf-sec::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 50%; width: 90px; height: 24px; translate: -50% 0; rotate: -3deg; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 3px; }
.cf-tone-1 { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 10%, var(--ev-surface)); }
.cf-tone-2 { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 12%, var(--ev-surface)); }
.cf-tone-1::before { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent) 40%, transparent); rotate: 4deg; }
.cf-sec .ev-h h2 { font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 1.3rem + 1.4vw, 2.4rem); }
.cf-sec .ev-kicker { display: none; }
.d-confetti .ev-note, .d-confetti .ev-func, .d-confetti .ev-list li, .d-confetti .ev-contacts li, .d-confetti .ev-table, .d-confetti .ev-thanks, .d-confetti .ev-count__cell { border-radius: 22px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-bg) 70%, var(--ev-surface)); border: 0; }
.d-confetti .ev-prog__item h4, .d-confetti .ev-menu__dish { font-weight: 600; }

/* =========================================================================================== */
/* 8. PULSE: bold modern, giant type, colour blocks, ticker                                    */
.d-pulse { --ev-radius: 0; --ev-w: 1280px; }
.pu-hero { padding: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px) var(--ev-pad) clamp(24px, 4vw, 40px); }
.pu-names { font-size: clamp(3.6rem, 1rem + 13vw, 15rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: .82; letter-spacing: -.06em; text-transform: uppercase; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 .14em; word-break: break-word; }
.pu-names .ev-amp { color: var(--ev-accent); }
.pu-date { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 18px 28px; margin-top: clamp(20px, 4vw, 40px); }
.pu-date b { font-family: var(--ev-display); font-size: clamp(5rem, 3rem + 10vw, 12rem); line-height: .78; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ev-accent2); letter-spacing: -.06em; }
.pu-date > span { font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 1rem + 1vw, 1.8rem); text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.1; }
.pu-date .ev-actions { margin: 0 0 0 auto; }
.pu-ticker { overflow: hidden; background: var(--ev-accent); color: #111; border-block: 2px solid var(--ev-text); }
.pu-ticker__track { display: flex; width: max-content; padding: 14px 0; font-family: var(--ev-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 1rem + 1vw, 1.6rem); text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
.pu-ticker__track span { padding-right: .5em; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .pu-ticker__track { animation: ticker 28s linear infinite; } }

@keyframes au-drift { 33% { translate: 8vw 6vh; scale: 1.08; } 66% { translate: -6vw 10vh; scale: .94; } 100% { translate: 4vw -6vh; scale: 1.04; } }

.cr-hero { margin-top: clamp(24px, 5vw, 56px); margin-inline: auto; padding: clamp(40px, 7vw, 72px) var(--ev-pad) 64px; text-align: center; display: grid; justify-items: center; width: calc(100% - 2 * 16px); }
.orn-moon { width: 200px; color: var(--ev-accent); margin-bottom: 8px; }

.cr-sec:nth-child(odd) { rotate: -.3deg; }

.cr-sec .ev-h h2 { font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 1.4rem + 1.6vw, 2.6rem); }
.orn-star { position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 22px; width: 22px; fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-accent2) 80%, transparent); stroke: none; }

.d-cradle .ev-note, .d-cradle .ev-func, .d-cradle .ev-list li, .d-cradle .ev-contacts li, .d-cradle .ev-table, .d-cradle .ev-thanks, .d-cradle .ev-count__cell { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ev-bg) 60%, var(--ev-surface)); border-style: dashed; }

/* phones: centre heroes */
@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .ev-prog__item { grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
  .d-pulse .ev-prog__item { grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .ev-count { gap: 6px; }
  .ev-count__cell span { font-size: .6875rem; letter-spacing: .06em; }

}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
}
@media print {
  .ev-nav, .ev-banner, .ev-ribbon, .au-field, .pu-ticker, .ev-rsvp { display: none !important; }
  .ev-banner--draft { display: flex !important; position: static; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
  .ev-watermark { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
  .ev { background: #fff; }
}
```

### `static/js/app.js`

<!-- FILE: static/js/app.js sha256=252a98e32a8b384436aedb46cb32ec47a0005870e33ab88200a9f84280a2951b nl=1 -->
```javascript
/* Aurelia site + app script: theme, header, drawer, reveal, toasts, copy, repeatable rows,
   colour sync, preview frames, tilt, confirm, autosave. No dependencies. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var doc = document, root = doc.documentElement;
  var csrf = (doc.querySelector('meta[name="csrf"]') || {}).content || "";
  var finePointer = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches;
  var reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  window.Aurelia = {
    csrf: csrf,
    post: function (url, data) {
      return fetch(url, {
        method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf, "Accept": "application/json", "X-Requested-With": "fetch" },
        body: JSON.stringify(data || {})
      }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (j) { if (!r.ok) { throw new Error(j.error || "Request failed"); } return j; }); });
    },
    toast: function (msg, kind) {
      var box = doc.querySelector(".toasts");
      if (!box) { box = doc.createElement("div"); box.className = "toasts"; doc.body.appendChild(box); }
      var t = doc.createElement("div");
      t.className = "toast toast--" + (kind || "success") + " glass glass--strong";
      t.setAttribute("role", "status");
      t.innerHTML = '<i class="i i--' + (kind === "error" ? "alert" : "check") + '" aria-hidden="true"></i><span></span><button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" data-dismiss>×</button>';
      t.querySelector("span").textContent = msg;
      box.appendChild(t);
      setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 5200);
    }
  };

  // Theme
  doc.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("[data-theme-toggle]");
    if (!b) return;
    var next = root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", next);
    try { localStorage.setItem("aurelia-theme-v1", next); } catch (err) {}
  });

  // Header glass after 40px
  var header = doc.querySelector("[data-header]");
  if (header) {
    var onScroll = function () { header.classList.toggle("is-scrolled", window.scrollY > 40); };
    onScroll();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
  }

  // Drawer
  var drawer = doc.getElementById("drawer"), opener = null;
  doc.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest("[data-drawer-open]") && drawer) { opener = e.target.closest("[data-drawer-open]"); drawer.showModal(); }
    if (e.target.closest("[data-drawer-close]") && drawer) { drawer.close(); }
    if (drawer && e.target === drawer) { drawer.close(); }
  });
  if (drawer) drawer.addEventListener("close", function () { if (opener) opener.focus(); });

  // Toasts
  doc.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var d = e.target.closest("[data-dismiss]");
    if (d) d.closest(".toast").remove();
  });
  doc.querySelectorAll(".toast").forEach(function (t) { setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 6500); });

  // Focus the first error summary
  var errs = doc.querySelector("[data-focus]");
  if (errs) errs.focus();

  // Reveal on scroll
  var reveals = doc.querySelectorAll("[data-reveal]");
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduce) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
        var el = en.target, parent = el.parentElement;
        if (parent && parent.hasAttribute("data-stagger")) {
          var idx = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(parent.children, el);
          el.style.transitionDelay = Math.min(idx, 4) * 60 + "ms";
        }
        el.classList.add("is-visible");
        io.unobserve(el);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: "0px 0px -10% 0px" });
    reveals.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    reveals.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("is-visible"); });
  }

  // Copy buttons: data-copy="text" or data-copy-target="#id"
  doc.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("[data-copy], [data-copy-target]");
    if (!b) return;
    var text = b.getAttribute("data-copy");
    if (!text) { var t = doc.querySelector(b.getAttribute("data-copy-target")); text = t ? (t.value || t.textContent) : ""; }
    var done = function () { Aurelia.toast(b.getAttribute("data-copied") || "Copied to clipboard"); };
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done, function () { fallback(text); done(); }); }
    else { fallback(text); done(); }
  });
  function fallback(text) {
    var ta = doc.createElement("textarea"); ta.value = text; ta.style.position = "fixed"; ta.style.opacity = "0";
    doc.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); try { doc.execCommand("copy"); } catch (err) {} ta.remove();
  }

  // Confirm before destructive submits
  doc.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    var f = e.target, msg = f.getAttribute("data-confirm");
    if (msg && !window.confirm(msg)) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    var btn = f.querySelector('button[type="submit"]:not([formnovalidate])');
    if (btn && !f.hasAttribute("data-no-busy")) { setTimeout(function () { btn.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true"); }, 0); }
  });
  doc.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var a = e.target.closest("[data-confirm-click]");
    if (a && !window.confirm(a.getAttribute("data-confirm-click"))) e.preventDefault();
  });

  // Colour inputs mirror their hex text field
  doc.querySelectorAll("input[type=color][data-sync]").forEach(function (c) {
    var t = c.parentElement.querySelector('input[name="' + c.getAttribute("data-sync") + '"]');
    c.addEventListener("input", function () { t.value = c.value.toUpperCase(); t.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true })); });
    t.addEventListener("input", function () { if (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(t.value)) c.value = t.value; });
  });

  // Repeatable rows: <div data-repeat="prefix"> with <template> and [data-add-row]
  doc.querySelectorAll("[data-repeat]").forEach(function (wrap) {
    var tpl = wrap.querySelector("template"), list = wrap.querySelector("[data-rows]");
    var add = wrap.querySelector("[data-add-row]");
    var max = parseInt(wrap.getAttribute("data-max") || "200", 10);
    function next() { var n = parseInt(wrap.getAttribute("data-next") || list.children.length, 10); wrap.setAttribute("data-next", n + 1); return n; }
    if (add) add.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (list.children.length >= max) { Aurelia.toast("Your package allows " + max + " here.", "error"); return; }
      var html = tpl.innerHTML.replace(/__i__/g, next());
      list.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", html);
      var first = list.lastElementChild.querySelector("input, select, textarea"); if (first) first.focus();
    });
    wrap.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var rm = e.target.closest("[data-remove-row]");
      if (rm) rm.closest(".repeat__row").remove();
    });
  });

  // Preview frame device toggle + refresh
  doc.querySelectorAll("[data-preview]").forEach(function (box) {
    var frame = box.querySelector("iframe");
    box.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest("[data-device]");
      if (b && b.tagName === "BUTTON") {
        box.setAttribute("data-device", b.getAttribute("data-device"));
        box.querySelectorAll("button[data-device]").forEach(function (x) { x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x === b ? "true" : "false"); });
      }
      if (e.target.closest("[data-refresh]")) { frame.src = frame.src; }
    });
  });

  // Scale fixed-size iframes (template thumbnails, showcase devices) to their box
  function fit() {
    doc.querySelectorAll("[data-fit]").forEach(function (box) {
      var f = box.querySelector("iframe"); if (!f) return;
      var w = parseInt(f.getAttribute("width"), 10) || 1280;
      var s = box.clientWidth / w;
      f.style.width = w + "px";
      f.style.height = Math.ceil(box.clientHeight / s) + "px";
      f.style.transform = "scale(" + s + ")";
    });
  }
  fit();
  window.addEventListener("resize", fit);

  // File drop zones show chosen file names
  doc.querySelectorAll(".file-drop").forEach(function (z) {
    var input = z.querySelector("input[type=file]"), label = z.querySelector("[data-files]");
    if (!input) return;
    ["dragenter", "dragover"].forEach(function (ev) { z.addEventListener(ev, function (e) { e.preventDefault(); z.classList.add("is-over"); }); });
    ["dragleave", "drop"].forEach(function (ev) { z.addEventListener(ev, function () { z.classList.remove("is-over"); }); });
    z.addEventListener("drop", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); input.files = e.dataTransfer.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); });
    input.addEventListener("change", function () {
      if (label) label.textContent = Array.prototype.map.call(input.files, function (f) { return f.name; }).join(", ") || "";
    });
  });

  // Auto-submit selects (filters)
  doc.querySelectorAll("[data-autosubmit]").forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener("change", function () { el.form.requestSubmit ? el.form.requestSubmit() : el.form.submit(); });
  });

  // Template gallery filter (client side)
  var filterBar = doc.querySelector("[data-filter-bar]");
  if (filterBar) {
    filterBar.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var b = e.target.closest("[data-filter]"); if (!b) return;
      var val = b.getAttribute("data-filter");
      filterBar.querySelectorAll("[data-filter]").forEach(function (x) { x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x === b ? "true" : "false"); });
      doc.querySelectorAll("[data-groups]").forEach(function (card) {
        card.hidden = !(val === "all" || card.getAttribute("data-groups").split(" ").indexOf(val) > -1);
      });
      fit();
      if (history.replaceState) history.replaceState(null, "", val === "all" ? location.pathname : "?category=" + val);
    });
  }

  // Hero orbit tilt (fine pointers only)
  var orbit = doc.querySelector("[data-tilt]");
  if (orbit && finePointer && !reduce) {
    var phone = orbit.querySelector(".phone"), tiles = orbit.querySelectorAll(".float-tile"), raf = 0, px = 0, py = 0;
    orbit.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
      var r = orbit.getBoundingClientRect();
      px = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - .5; py = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - .5;
      if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(apply);
    });
    orbit.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () { px = py = 0; if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(apply); });
    function apply() {
      raf = 0;
      phone.style.transform = "rotateY(" + (px * 10) + "deg) rotateX(" + (-py * 8) + "deg)";
      tiles.forEach(function (t, k) { var d = (k + 1) * 6; t.style.transform = "translate(" + (px * d) + "px," + (py * d) + "px)"; });
    }
  }

  // Count-up numbers
  var counters = doc.querySelectorAll("[data-count]");
  if (counters.length && "IntersectionObserver" in window && !reduce) {
    var co = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
        var el = en.target, end = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-count")), t0 = performance.now();
        (function step(t) {
          var p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 1200), v = Math.round(end * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3)));
          el.textContent = v.toLocaleString("en-ZA");
          if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
        })(t0);
        co.unobserve(el);
      });
    }, { threshold: .5 });
    counters.forEach(function (c) { co.observe(c); });
  }

  // Simple show/hide toggles: data-toggle="#id"
  doc.addEventListener("change", function (e) {
    var el = e.target;
    if (el.hasAttribute && el.hasAttribute("data-reveals")) {
      var target = doc.querySelector(el.getAttribute("data-reveals"));
      if (target) target.hidden = el.type === "checkbox" ? !el.checked : !el.value;
    }
  });
})();
```

### `static/js/eventsite.js`

<!-- FILE: static/js/eventsite.js sha256=9d65aaae5e49a78548425c7bd5a5988311b240b1d6241157dcce5025bdd39c90 nl=1 -->
```javascript
/* Event website behaviour: live countdown, show/hide attending details, focus the thank-you. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  document.documentElement.classList.add("js");

  // Countdown
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-countdown]").forEach(function (box) {
    var target = Date.parse(box.getAttribute("data-countdown"));
    if (isNaN(target)) return;
    var cells = {};
    box.querySelectorAll("[data-u]").forEach(function (b) { cells[b.getAttribute("data-u")] = b; });
    var done = box.parentElement.querySelector(".ev-count__done");
    function pad(n) { return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
    function tick() {
      var ms = target - Date.now();
      if (ms <= 0) {
        box.hidden = true;
        if (done) done.hidden = false;
        return false;
      }
      var s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
      cells.d.textContent = Math.floor(s / 86400);
      cells.h.textContent = pad(Math.floor(s % 86400 / 3600));
      cells.m.textContent = pad(Math.floor(s % 3600 / 60));
      cells.s.textContent = pad(s % 60);
      return true;
    }
    if (tick()) { var t = setInterval(function () { if (!tick()) clearInterval(t); }, 1000); }
  });

  // RSVP: hide attending-only fields when declining
  document.querySelectorAll(".ev-rsvp").forEach(function (form) {
    var block = form.querySelector("[data-attending]");
    if (!block) return;
    function sync() {
      var picked = form.querySelector('input[name="status"]:checked');
      block.hidden = !!picked && picked.value === "declined";
    }
    form.addEventListener("change", function (e) { if (e.target.name === "status") sync(); });
    sync();
  });

  var thanks = document.querySelector("[data-focus-me]");
  if (thanks) { thanks.focus({ preventScroll: false }); }
  var err = document.querySelector(".ev-errors");
  if (err) { err.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1"); err.focus(); }
})();
```

### `static/js/floorplan.js`

<!-- FILE: static/js/floorplan.js sha256=fa9edab5632bf9f0452256fbe119c78757a2e2c17200c0c8e5e9e86ef700f9a5 nl=1 -->
```javascript
/* Table-type drawings and a floor-plan sketch for the seating step (app wizard and static site).
   AureliaFloor.icon(kind) returns an SVG for one table type; AureliaFloor.plan(opts) returns a room sketch:
   opts = { top: "sweetheart" | "head" | "none", guest: "round" | "long" | "mixed", count: n, cap: seats,
            topLabel: "Couple", dance: true }. Colours use currentColor so light and dark themes both work. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  function chairsRound(cx, cy, r, n, rc) {
    var out = "";
    for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      var a = (Math.PI * 2 * k) / n - Math.PI / 2;
      out += '<circle cx="' + (cx + Math.cos(a) * r).toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + (cy + Math.sin(a) * r).toFixed(1) + '" r="' + rc + '" class="fp-chair"/>';
    }
    return out;
  }
  function chairsLine(x1, x2, y, n, rc) {
    var out = "", step = (x2 - x1) / (n - 1 || 1);
    for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) out += '<circle cx="' + (x1 + step * k).toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + y + '" r="' + rc + '" class="fp-chair"/>';
    return out;
  }
  function roundTable(cx, cy, r, seats) { return chairsRound(cx, cy, r + r * 0.42, seats, r * 0.26) + '<circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + r + '" class="fp-table"/>'; }
  function longTable(cx, cy, w, h, perSide, oneSide) {
    var x = cx - w / 2, y = cy - h / 2, rc = h * 0.32;
    return '<rect x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '" width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '" rx="' + (h * 0.18) + '" class="fp-table"/>' +
      (oneSide ? "" : chairsLine(x + w * 0.1, x + w * 0.9, y - rc * 1.6, perSide, rc)) + chairsLine(x + w * 0.1, x + w * 0.9, y + h + rc * 1.6, perSide, rc);
  }
  var ICONS = {
    sweetheart: function () { return '<rect x="34" y="30" width="52" height="18" rx="4" class="fp-table"/><circle cx="50" cy="60" r="6" class="fp-chair fp-chair--couple"/><circle cx="70" cy="60" r="6" class="fp-chair fp-chair--couple"/>'; },
    head: function () { return '<rect x="8" y="26" width="104" height="18" rx="4" class="fp-table"/>' + chairsLine(16, 42, 56, 3, 5) + chairsLine(78, 104, 56, 3, 5) +
      '<circle cx="54" cy="56" r="5" class="fp-chair fp-chair--couple"/><circle cx="66" cy="56" r="5" class="fp-chair fp-chair--couple"/>'; },
    none: function () { return roundTable(60, 40, 16, 8) + '<circle cx="60" cy="17.5" r="4.2" class="fp-chair fp-chair--couple"/><circle cx="76" cy="24" r="4.2" class="fp-chair fp-chair--couple"/>'; },
    round: function () { return roundTable(60, 40, 17, 10); },
    long: function () { return longTable(60, 40, 96, 16, 6, false); },
    mixed: function () { return roundTable(32, 40, 13, 8) + longTable(86, 40, 50, 12, 3, false); }
  };
  function icon(kind) {
    return '<svg class="fp" viewBox="0 0 120 80" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">' + (ICONS[kind] || ICONS.round)() + "</svg>";
  }
  function plan(o) {
    var count = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, +o.count || 10)), cap = Math.max(2, Math.min(20, +o.cap || 10)), W = 320, svg = "", y = 22;
    var cols = o.guest === "long" ? 2 : 4, rows = Math.ceil(count / cols), rowH = o.guest === "long" ? 46 : 54;
    var H = y + (o.top === "none" ? 0 : 54) + (o.dance ? 52 : 6) + rows * rowH + 10;
    svg += '<text x="' + W / 2 + '" y="12" class="fp-label" text-anchor="middle">' + (o.stage || "Front of the room") + "</text>";
    if (o.top === "sweetheart") { svg += '<rect x="' + (W / 2 - 26) + '" y="' + y + '" width="52" height="14" rx="3" class="fp-table fp-table--top"/>' + chairsLine(W / 2 - 9, W / 2 + 9, y + 24, 2, 5).replace(/fp-chair/g, "fp-chair fp-chair--couple"); y += 54; }
    else if (o.top === "head") { svg += '<rect x="' + (W / 2 - 90) + '" y="' + y + '" width="180" height="14" rx="3" class="fp-table fp-table--top"/>' + chairsLine(W / 2 - 80, W / 2 - 22, y + 24, 4, 4.6) + chairsLine(W / 2 + 22, W / 2 + 80, y + 24, 4, 4.6) +
      chairsLine(W / 2 - 7, W / 2 + 7, y + 24, 2, 4.8).replace(/fp-chair/g, "fp-chair fp-chair--couple"); y += 54; }
    if (o.dance) { svg += '<rect x="' + (W / 2 - 60) + '" y="' + (y - 2) + '" width="120" height="38" rx="6" class="fp-dance"/><text x="' + W / 2 + '" y="' + (y + 21) + '" class="fp-label" text-anchor="middle">Dance floor</text>'; y += 52; }
    for (var k = 0; k < count; k++) {
      var c = k % cols, r = Math.floor(k / cols), cx = (W / cols) * (c + 0.5), cy = y + r * rowH + rowH / 2 - 4;
      var isLong = o.guest === "long" || (o.guest === "mixed" && (k % 3 === 2));
      svg += isLong ? longTable(cx, cy, o.guest === "long" ? 120 : 52, 12, Math.min(8, Math.ceil(cap / 2)), false) : roundTable(cx, cy, 13, Math.min(cap, 12));
    }
    return '<svg class="fp fp--plan" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + " " + H + '" role="img" aria-label="Sketch of your room layout">' + svg + "</svg>";
  }
  window.AureliaFloor = { icon: icon, plan: plan };
})();
```
